15.4.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca ..
evaṃ saṃpūjitastena hariṇā brāhmaṇottamaḥ ..
uvāca parisantuṣṭo varaṃ brūhīti keśavam.. 1 ..
15.4.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ..
एवं संपूजितस्तेन हरिणा ब्राह्मणोत्तमः ..
उवाच परिसन्तुष्टो वरं ब्रूहीति केशवम्.. 1 ..
15.4.m: The venerable Prahlāda said: / Having been thus honored by Hari, that best of brahmins / spoke, highly delighted, to Keśava: 'Ask a boon.'

15.4.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavanyadi deyo varo mama ..
sthātavyamatra bhavatā na tyaktavyaṃ kadācana .. 2 ..
15.4.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि भगवन्यदि देयो वरो मम ..
स्थातव्यमत्र भवता न त्यक्तव्यं कदाचन .. 2 ..
15.4.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / 'If you are pleased, O venerable one, if a boon is to be given to me, / you must stay here; you must never depart.'

15.4.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
yadi tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇa tathā tvamapi keśava ..
tiṣṭhasva ṣoḍaśakalo nityaṃ madvacanena hi .. 3 ..
15.4.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
यदि तिष्ठाम्यहं कृष्ण तथा त्वमपि केशव ..
तिष्ठस्व षोडशकलो नित्यं मद्वचनेन हि .. 3 ..
15.4.m: Durvāsas said: / 'If I stay, O Kṛṣṇa, then you also, O Keśava, / stay, endowed with sixteen parts, perpetually by my word.'

15.4.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ye'tra paśyaṃti bhaktyā tvāṃ māṃ cāpi dvijasattama ..
kiṃ dāsyasi phalaṃ teṣāṃ bhāvināṃ bhagavanvada .. 4 ..
15.4.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
येऽत्र पश्यंति भक्त्या त्वां मां चापि द्विजसत्तम ..
किं दास्यसि फलं तेषां भाविनां भगवन्वद .. 4 ..
15.4.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Those who behold you and me here with devotion, O best of the twice-born: / what fruit will you give them in the future? Tell me, O venerable one.'

15.4.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
yaḥ snātvā saṃgame kṛṣṇa gomatyāḥ sāgarasya ca ..
tvāṃ māṃ samarcati naraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ samucyate ..5 ..
15.4.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
यः स्नात्वा संगमे कृष्ण गोमत्याः सागरस्य च ..
त्वां मां समर्चति नरः सर्वपापैः समुच्यते ..5 ..
15.4.m: Durvāsas said: / 'A person who, having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, O Kṛṣṇa, / worships you and me, is freed from all sins.

15.4.s:
tathānyacchṛṇu kṛṣṇātra snātvā dāsyati yaddhanam ..
mama dattasya deveśa prāpnuyātṣoḍaśottaram.. 6 ..
15.4.d:
तथान्यच्छृणु कृष्णात्र स्नात्वा दास्यति यद्धनम् ..
मम दत्तस्य देवेश प्राप्नुयात्षोडशोत्तरम्.. 6 ..
15.4.m: Likewise hear another thing, O Kṛṣṇa: whatever wealth one will give after bathing here, / O lord of the gods, he will obtain sixteen times what was given to me.'

15.4.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
yo naraḥ pūjayitvā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati māmiha ..
tasya muktiṃ pradāsyāmi yā surairapi durllabhā .. 7 ..
15.4.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
यो नरः पूजयित्वा त्वां पूजयिष्यति मामिह ..
तस्य मुक्तिं प्रदास्यामि या सुरैरपि दुर्ल्लभा .. 7 ..
15.4.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / 'To that person who, having worshipped you, shall worship me here, / I will grant liberation, which is hard even for the gods to attain.'

15.4.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
parasparaṃ varau dattvā kṛṣṇadurvāsasau mudā..
tataḥ prabhṛti viprendrāstasminsthāne hyatiṣṭhatām..
varadānamiti proktaṃ tattīrthaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 8 ..
15.4.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
परस्परं वरौ दत्त्वा कृष्णदुर्वाससौ मुदा..
ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्रास्तस्मिन्स्थाने ह्यतिष्ठताम्..
वरदानमिति प्रोक्तं तत्तीर्थं सर्वकामदम् .. 8 ..
15.4.m: Prahlāda said: / Having joyfully given boons to each other, Kṛṣṇa and Durvāsas / stayed in that place from that time on, O best of brahmins; / that sacred ford, granting all desires, is called Varadāna.

15.4.s:
varadāne naraḥ snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ..
viṣṇudurvāsasoryatra varadānamabhūtpurā .. 9 ..
15.4.d:
वरदाने नरः स्नातो गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ..
विष्णुदुर्वाससोर्यत्र वरदानमभूत्पुरा .. 9 ..
15.4.m: A man who bathes in Varadāna obtains the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows, / where the granting of boons between Viṣṇu and Durvāsas took place in ancient times.

15.4.s:
tadāprabhṛti viprendrāstiṣṭhate dvārakāṃ hariḥ ..
durvāsasā girā baddho na jahāti kadācana .. 7.4.4.10 ..
15.4.d:
तदाप्रभृति विप्रेन्द्रास्तिष्ठते द्वारकां हरिः ..
दुर्वाससा गिरा बद्धो न जहाति कदाचन .. 7.4.4.10 ..
15.4.m: From that time forward, O best of brahmins, Hari remains in Dvārakā; / bound by the word of Durvāsas, he never leaves it.

15.4.s:
yatra traivikramī mūrtirvahate yatra gomatī ..
narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti cakratīrthena saṃgatāḥ .. 11 ..
15.4.d:
यत्र त्रैविक्रमी मूर्तिर्वहते यत्र गोमती ..
नरा मुक्तिं प्रयास्यंति चक्रतीर्थेन संगताः .. 11 ..
15.4.m: Where the image of Trivikrama stands and where the Gomatī flows, / men united with the Cakra-tīrtha will go to liberation.

15.4.s:
kalevaraṃ parityaktaṃ prabhāse hariṇā yadā ..
kalābhiḥ sahitaṃ tejastasyāṃ mūrtau niveśitam .. 12 ..
15.4.d:
कलेवरं परित्यक्तं प्रभासे हरिणा यदा ..
कलाभिः सहितं तेजस्तस्यां मूर्तौ निवेशितम् .. 12 ..
15.4.m: When his mortal body was abandoned at Prabhāsa by Hari, / his splendor along with his sixteen parts was placed into that image.

15.4.s:
tasmātkaliyuge viprā nānyatra prāpyate hariḥ ..
yadi kāryyaṃ hi kṛṣṇena tatra gacchata mā ciram .. 13 ..
15.4.d:
तस्मात्कलियुगे विप्रा नान्यत्र प्राप्यते हरिः ..
यदि कार्य्यं हि कृष्णेन तत्र गच्छत मा चिरम् .. 13 ..
15.4.m: Therefore in the Kali age, O brahmins, Hari is not found anywhere else. / If you have business with Kṛṣṇa, go there without delay.'

15.4.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sādhu bhāgavataśreṣṭha sādhu mārgapradarśaka ..
yattvayā hi parijñātaṃ tanna jānāti kaścana .. 14 ..
15.4.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
साधु भागवतश्रेष्ठ साधु मार्गप्रदर्शक ..
यत्त्वया हि परिज्ञातं तन्न जानाति कश्चन .. 14 ..
15.4.m: The seers said: / 'Well said, O best of devotees of the Lord! Well said, O shower of the path! / That which has been understood by you, no one else knows.

15.4.s:
kiṃ phalaṃ gamane tasyāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ kṛṣṇadarśane ..
kāni tīrthāni tatraiva ke devāstadvadasva naḥ .. 15 ..
15.4.d:
किं फलं गमने तस्यां किं फलं कृष्णदर्शने ..
कानि तीर्थानि तत्रैव के देवास्तद्वदस्व नः .. 15 ..
15.4.m: What is the fruit of going to it? What is the fruit of beholding Kṛṣṇa? / Which sacred fords are right there, and which gods? Tell us that!'

15.4.s:
kasminmāse tithau kasyāṃ kasminparvaṇi mānavaiḥ ..
gantavyaṃ kāni deyāni dānāni danujarṣabha .. 16 ..
15.4.d:
कस्मिन्मासे तिथौ कस्यां कस्मिन्पर्वणि मानवैः ..
गन्तव्यं कानि देयानि दानानि दनुजर्षभ .. 16 ..
15.4.m: In which month, on which lunar day, on which conjunction should human beings / go, [and] what gifts should be given, O bull among Danujas? 16

15.4.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
iti pṛṣṭastadā taistu mahābhāgavato'suraḥ ..
kathayāmāsa viprebhyo bhagavadbhaktisaṃyutaḥ .. 17 ..
15.4.d:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
इति पृष्टस्तदा तैस्तु महाभागवतोऽसुरः ..
कथयामास विप्रेभ्यो भगवद्भक्तिसंयुतः .. 17 ..
15.4.m: Sūta said: / Thus asked then by them, that asura, the great devotee of the Lord, / endowed with devotion to the Lord, narrated to the brahmins. 17

15.4.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
bho bhūmidevāḥ śṛṇuta paraṃ guhyaṃ sanātanam ..
yatkasyacinna cākhyātaṃ tadvadāmi suvistarāt .. 18 ..
15.4.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
भो भूमिदेवाः शृणुत परं गुह्यं सनातनम् ..
यत्कस्यचिन्न चाख्यातं तद्वदामि सुविस्तरात् .. 18 ..
15.4.m: Prahlāda said: / O gods of the earth, listen to the supreme, eternal secret, / which has not been told to anyone; that I shall tell in full detail. 18

15.4.s:
yadā matiṃ ca kurute dvārakāgamanaṃ prati ..
tadā narakanirmuktā gāyanti pitaro divi .. 19 ..
15.4.d:
यदा मतिं च कुरुते द्वारकागमनं प्रति ..
तदा नरकनिर्मुक्ता गायन्ति पितरो दिवि .. 19 ..
15.4.m: When one sets one's mind toward going to Dvārakā, / then the ancestors, freed from hell, sing in heaven. 19

15.4.s:
yāvatpadāni kṛṣṇasya mārge gacchati mānavaḥ ..
padepade'śvamedhasya yajñasya labhate phalam .. 7.4.4.20 ..
15.4.d:
यावत्पदानि कृष्णस्य मार्गे गच्छति मानवः ..
पदेपदेऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य लभते फलम् .. 7.4.4.20 ..
15.4.m: For as many steps as a human being walks on the path of Kṛṣṇa, / at every step one obtains the fruit of the horse sacrifice. 20

15.4.s:
yātrārthaṃ devadevasya yaḥ prerayati cāparān ..
mānavānnātra sandeho labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam .. 21 ..
15.4.d:
यात्रार्थं देवदेवस्य यः प्रेरयति चापरान् ..
मानवान्नात्र सन्देहो लभते वैष्णवं पदम् .. 21 ..
15.4.m: And whoever urges other human beings to make the pilgrimage / to the God of gods—of this there is no doubt—attains the abode of Viṣṇu. 21

15.4.s:
dvārakāṃ gacchamānasya yo dadāti pratiśrayam ..
tathaiva madhurāṃ vācaṃ nandate krīḍate hi saḥ .. 22 ..
15.4.d:
द्वारकां गच्छमानस्य यो ददाति प्रतिश्रयम् ..
तथैव मधुरां वाचं नन्दते क्रीडते हि सः .. 22 ..
15.4.m: He who offers shelter to one traveling to Dvārakā, / as well as sweet speech, rejoices and plays indeed. 22

15.4.s:
adhvani śrāṃtadehasya vāhanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
haṃsayuktena sa naro vimānena divaṃ vrajet .. 23 ..
15.4.d:
अध्वनि श्रांतदेहस्य वाहनं यः प्रयच्छति ..
हंसयुक्तेन स नरो विमानेन दिवं व्रजेत् .. 23 ..
15.4.m: He who gives a conveyance to one whose body is exhausted on the path, / that man goes to heaven in an aerial chariot yoked with swans. 23

15.4.s:
yātrāyāṃ gacchamānasya madhyāhne kṣudhitasya ca ..
annaṃ dadāti yo bhaktyā śṛṇu tasyāpi yadbhavet .. 24 ..
15.4.d:
यात्रायां गच्छमानस्य मध्याह्ने क्षुधितस्य च ..
अन्नं ददाति यो भक्त्या शृणु तस्यापि यद्भवेत् .. 24 ..
15.4.m: To one traveling on the pilgrimage, hungry at midday, / whoever gives food with devotion—hear what comes to him as well: 24

15.4.s:
gayāśrāddhena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate mānavo bhuvi ..
annadānena tatpuṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptirakṣayā .. 25 ..
15.4.d:
गयाश्राद्धेन यत्पुण्यं लभते मानवो भुवि ..
अन्नदानेन तत्पुण्यं पितॄणां तृप्तिरक्षया .. 25 ..
15.4.m: Whatever merit a human being gains on earth by a śrāddha at Gayā, / that merit [is gained] by the giving of food, and inexhaustible satisfaction of the ancestors. 25

15.4.s:
upānahau tu yo dadyāddvārakāṃ prati gacchatām..
kṛṣṇaprasādātsa naro gajaskandhena gacchati .. ..26..
15.4.d:
उपानहौ तु यो दद्याद्द्वारकां प्रति गच्छताम्..
कृष्णप्रसादात्स नरो गजस्कन्धेन गच्छति .. ..26..
15.4.m: He who gives shoes to those traveling to Dvārakā, / through Kṛṣṇa's favor, that man rides on the shoulder of an elephant. 26

15.4.s:
vighnamācarate yastu dvārakāṃ prati gacchatām..
narake majjate mūḍhaḥ kalpamātraṃ tu raurave..27..
15.4.d:
विघ्नमाचरते यस्तु द्वारकां प्रति गच्छताम्..
नरके मज्जते मूढः कल्पमात्रं तु रौरवे..27..
15.4.m: But he who causes an obstacle to those traveling to Dvārakā, / that fool sinks into the Raurava hell for an entire kalpa. 27

15.4.s:
mārgasthitasya yo dhanyaḥ prayacchati kamaṇḍalum..
prapādānasahasrasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ..28..
15.4.d:
मार्गस्थितस्य यो धन्यः प्रयच्छति कमण्डलुम्..
प्रपादानसहस्रस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः..28..
15.4.m: The fortunate person who gives a water jar to someone on the road / obtains the fruit of a thousand water booths. 28

15.4.s:
yātrāyāṃ gacchamānasya pādabhyaṃgaṃ dadāti yaḥ..
pādaprakṣālanaṃ caiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 29 ..
15.4.d:
यात्रायां गच्छमानस्य पादभ्यंगं ददाति यः..
पादप्रक्षालनं चैव सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 29 ..
15.4.m: He who offers foot massage and washing of the feet / to one traveling on the pilgrimage shall attain all desires. 29

15.4.s:
gāthāṃ śṛṇoti yo viṣṇorgītaṃ ca gāyataḥ pathi ..
dānaṃ dadāti viprendrāstasmāddhanyataro na hi.. 7.4.4.30..
15.4.d:
गाथां शृणोति यो विष्णोर्गीतं च गायतः पथि ..
दानं ददाति विप्रेन्द्रास्तस्माद्धन्यतरो न हि.. 7.4.4.30..
15.4.m: He who listens to a song about Viṣṇu and sings praise on the road, / and gives gifts, O foremost of brahmins—none is more fortunate than he. 30

15.4.s:
kailāsaśikharāvāsaṃ śvetābhramiva nirmalam ..
prāsādaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya yaḥ paśyati narottamaḥ.. 31 ..
15.4.d:
कैलासशिखरावासं श्वेताभ्रमिव निर्मलम् ..
प्रासादं कृष्णदेवस्य यः पश्यति नरोत्तमः.. 31 ..
15.4.m: The best among men who beholds the temple of the divine Kṛṣṇa, / like an abode on the peak of Kailāsa, spotless like a white cloud, 31

15.4.s:
dūrāddhemamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kalaśaṃ dhvajasaṃyutam..
vāhanaṃ saṃparityajya luṭhate dharaṇīṃ gataḥ .. 32 ..
15.4.d:
दूराद्धेममयं दृष्ट्वा कलशं ध्वजसंयुतम्..
वाहनं संपरित्यज्य लुठते धरणीं गतः .. 32 ..
15.4.m: seeing from afar the golden pinnacle with its banner, / abandoning his conveyance, lies rolling on the ground. 32

15.4.s:
pañcasūnākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tathā'dharmakṛtaṃ ca yat ..
kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca nihatāḥ pathi gacchatā ..
parānnaṃ parapānīyamaspṛśya sparśasaṃgamam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāpnoti bhagavatketudarśanāt .. 34..
15.4.d:
पञ्चसूनाकृतं पापं तथाऽधर्मकृतं च यत् ..
कृमिकीटपतंगाश्च निहताः पथि गच्छता ..
परान्नं परपानीयमस्पृश्य स्पर्शसंगमम् ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमाप्नोति भगवत्केतुदर्शनात् .. 34..
15.4.m: The sin committed through the five slaughterhouses, and whatever was committed by unrighteousness, / the worms, insects, and moths killed while walking on the road, / the eating of another's food, drinking of another's water, and contact with the untouchable— / all that is destroyed by the darśana of the Lord's banner. 34

15.4.s:
paṭhennāmasahasraṃ tu stavarājamathāpi vā ..
gajendramokṣaṇaṃ caiva pathi gacchañchanaiḥ śanaiḥ .. 35 ..
15.4.d:
पठेन्नामसहस्रं तु स्तवराजमथापि वा ..
गजेन्द्रमोक्षणं चैव पथि गच्छञ्छनैः शनैः .. 35 ..
15.4.m: One should recite the thousand names, or the king of hymns, / or the liberation of the elephant king, walking slowly on the road, 35

15.4.s:
gāyamāno bhagavataḥ prādurbhāvānanekadhā ..
nṛtyadbhirharṣasaṃyuktairhṛṣyamāṇaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
svayaṃ nṛtyanharṣayukto bhakto gaccheddhareḥ puram .. 36 ..
15.4.d:
गायमानो भगवतः प्रादुर्भावाननेकधा ..
नृत्यद्भिर्हर्षसंयुक्तैर्हृष्यमाणः पुनःपुनः ..
स्वयं नृत्यन्हर्षयुक्तो भक्तो गच्छेद्धरेः पुरम् .. 36 ..
15.4.m: singing the manifold manifestations of the Lord, / rejoicing again and again with dancers filled with joy; / dancing oneself, filled with joy, the devotee should go to the city of Hari. 36

15.4.s:
viṣṇoḥ krīḍākaraṃ sthānaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam ..
yasmindṛṣṭe kalau nṝṇāṃ muktirevopajāyate .. 37 ..
15.4.d:
विष्णोः क्रीडाकरं स्थानं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् ..
यस्मिन्दृष्टे कलौ नॄणां मुक्तिरेवोपजायते .. 37 ..
15.4.m: A place of play for Viṣṇu, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation, / seen by men in the Kali age, liberation alone arises. 37

15.4.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
pūrvaṃ hi devarājena bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ..
praṇamya parayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭaśca sa mahāmatiḥ .. 38 ..
15.4.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
पूर्वं हि देवराजेन बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः ..
प्रणम्य परया भक्त्या पृष्टश्च स महामतिः .. 38 ..
15.4.m: Prahlāda said: / Formerly indeed, the noble-minded Bṛhaspati, having been bowed to with supreme devotion, / was asked by the king of the gods, that great-minded one. 38

15.4.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ ..
caturyugaṃ yathābhāgairdharmavṛddhiṃ jano labhet .. 39 ..
15.4.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं कथयस्व प्रसादतः ..
चतुर्युगं यथाभागैर्धर्मवृद्धिं जनो लभेत् .. 39 ..
15.4.m: Indra said: / Graciously tell the māhātmya of Dvārakā, / [and how] through the parts of the four ages people obtain the increase of righteousness. 39

15.4.s:
etacchrutvā mahendrasya vacanaṃ munisattamāḥ ..
bṛhaspatiruvācainaṃ mahendraṃ deva saṃvṛtam.. 7.4.4.40 ..
15.4.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्य वचनं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
बृहस्पतिरुवाचैनं महेन्द्रं देव संवृतम्.. 7.4.4.40 ..
15.4.m: Hearing these words of Mahendra, O best of sages, / Bṛhaspati spoke to that Mahendra surrounded by gods: 40

15.4.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśca surasattama ..
caturyugamidaṃ proktaṃ tattvato munisattamaiḥ .. 41 ..
15.4.d:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्च सुरसत्तम ..
चतुर्युगमिदं प्रोक्तं तत्त्वतो मुनिसत्तमैः .. 41 ..
15.4.m: Bṛhaspati said: / Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali, O best of gods— / this fourfold age has been explained according to reality by the best of sages. 41

15.4.s:
kṛte dharmaścatuṣpādo vedādiphalameva ca ..
tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tapo vidyā dhyānamāyurarogatā .. 42 ..
15.4.d:
कृते धर्मश्चतुष्पादो वेदादिफलमेव च ..
तीर्थं दानं तपो विद्या ध्यानमायुररोगता .. 42 ..
15.4.m: In the Kṛta age, dharma has four quarters, and the fruit of the Vedas and so forth, / sacred ford, gift, austerity, knowledge, meditation, long life, and freedom from disease. 42

15.4.s:
pādahīnaṃ sarvametadyugaṃ tretābhidhaṃ prabho ..
pādadvayaṃ dvāpare tu sarvasyaitasya vāsava .. 43 ..
15.4.d:
पादहीनं सर्वमेतद्युगं त्रेताभिधं प्रभो ..
पादद्वयं द्वापरे तु सर्वस्यैतस्य वासव .. 43 ..
15.4.m: All this is diminished by one quarter in the age named Tretā, O Lord; / in the Dvāpara age it has two quarters, of all this, O Vāsava. 43

15.4.s:
pādenaikena tatsarvaṃ vibhāge prathame kalau ..
ūrdhvaṃ vināśaḥ sarvasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 44 ..
15.4.d:
पादेनैकेन तत्सर्वं विभागे प्रथमे कलौ ..
ऊर्ध्वं विनाशः सर्वस्य भविष्यति न संशयः .. 44 ..
15.4.m: With one quarter all that remains in the first part of the Kali age; / thereafter will be the destruction of all, of this there is no doubt. 44

15.4.s:
mantrāstīrthāni yajñāśca tapo daivādikaṃ tathā ..
pragacchaṃti samucchedaṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi caiva hi ..45..
15.4.d:
मन्त्रास्तीर्थानि यज्ञाश्च तपो दैवादिकं तथा ..
प्रगच्छंति समुच्छेदं वेदाः शास्त्राणि चैव हि ..45..
15.4.m: Mantras, sacred fords, sacrifices, austerity, divine rites and so forth, / as well as the Vedas and the treatises, will go to complete destruction. 45

15.4.s:
mlecchaprāyāśca bhūpālā bhaviṣyantyamarādhipa..
lokaḥ kariṣyate nindāṃ sādhūnāṃ vratacāriṇām .. 46 ..
15.4.d:
म्लेच्छप्रायाश्च भूपाला भविष्यन्त्यमराधिप..
लोकः करिष्यते निन्दां साधूनां व्रतचारिणाम् .. 46 ..
15.4.m: Kings will be mostly barbarians, O ruler of the immortals; / the world will revile virtuous people and those observing vows. 46

15.4.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
śrutvā bṛhaspatervākyametattīrthasya bho dvijāḥ ..
prakaṃpitāḥ surāḥ sarve mleccha saṃsargajādbhayāt .. 47 ..
15.4.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा बृहस्पतेर्वाक्यमेतत्तीर्थस्य भो द्विजाः ..
प्रकंपिताः सुराः सर्वे म्लेच्छ संसर्गजाद्भयात् .. 47 ..
15.4.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing this speech of Bṛhaspati regarding the sacred ford, O twice-born, / all the gods trembled from fear arising from contact with barbarians. 47

15.4.s:
bṛhaspatiṃ suraguruṃ papracchurvinayānvitāḥ ..
mlecchasaṃsargajo doṣo gaṃgayāpi na pūyate .. 48 ..
15.4.d:
बृहस्पतिं सुरगुरुं पप्रच्छुर्विनयान्विताः ..
म्लेच्छसंसर्गजो दोषो गंगयापि न पूयते .. 48 ..
15.4.m: Endowed with humility, they asked Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods: / The defect born of contact with barbarians is not purified even by the Gaṅgā. 48

15.4.s:
kathayasva prasādena sthānaṃ kalivivarjitam ..
yatra gatvā nivatsyāmo yāsyāmo nirvṛtiṃ parām .. 49 ..
15.4.d:
कथयस्व प्रसादेन स्थानं कलिविवर्जितम् ..
यत्र गत्वा निवत्स्यामो यास्यामो निर्वृतिं पराम् .. 49 ..
15.4.m: Graciously describe a place free from the Kali age, / having gone to which we may dwell and attain supreme bliss, 49

15.4.s:
yena duḥkhavinirmuktā bhaviṣyāmo gatavyathāḥ ..
kṛpayā sumukho bhūtvā brūhi tīrthaṃ hitāya naḥ .. 7.4.4.50 ..
15.4.d:
येन दुःखविनिर्मुक्ता भविष्यामो गतव्यथाः ..
कृपया सुमुखो भूत्वा ब्रूहि तीर्थं हिताय नः .. 7.4.4.50 ..
15.4.m: by which, freed from sorrow, we may be rid of distress; / becoming gracious out of compassion, speak of a sacred ford for our welfare. 50

15.4.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
etacchrutvā surendrasya vākyamaṃgirasāṃ varaḥ ..
ciraṃ dhyātvā jagādedaṃ vākyaṃ devapurohitaḥ .. .. 51 ..
15.4.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा सुरेन्द्रस्य वाक्यमंगिरसां वरः ..
चिरं ध्यात्वा जगादेदं वाक्यं देवपुरोहितः .. .. 51 ..
15.4.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing this speech of the king of the gods, the best of the Aṅgirases, / having meditated for a long time, the priest of the gods spoke this word: 51

15.4.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
pañcakrośapramāṇaṃ hi tīrthaṃ tīrthavarottamam..
dvārakānāma vikhyātaṃ kalidoṣavivarjitam.. ..52..
15.4.d:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
पञ्चक्रोशप्रमाणं हि तीर्थं तीर्थवरोत्तमम्..
द्वारकानाम विख्यातं कलिदोषविवर्जितम्.. ..52..
15.4.m: Bṛhaspati said: / Five krośas in extent is the sacred ford, the best among excellent sacred fords, / famed by the name Dvārakā, free from the defects of the Kali age. 52

15.4.s:
viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ sthānaṃ lokasya gatidāyakam ..
muktidaṃ kalikāle tu jñānahīnajanasya ca ..53 ..
15.4.d:
विष्णुना निर्मितं स्थानं लोकस्य गतिदायकम् ..
मुक्तिदं कलिकाले तु ज्ञानहीनजनस्य च ..53 ..
15.4.m: A place fashioned by Viṣṇu, granting the supreme destination to people, / granting liberation in the Kali age even to people devoid of knowledge. 53

15.4.s:
ūṣaraṃ karmaṇāṃ kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ pāpavināśanam..
na prarohaṃti pāpāni punarnaṣṭāni tatra vai .. 54 ..
15.4.d:
ऊषरं कर्मणां क्षेत्रं पुण्यं पापविनाशनम्..
न प्ररोहंति पापानि पुनर्नष्टानि तत्र वै .. 54 ..
15.4.m: A saline ground for actions, a sacred field destroying sins; / sins, once destroyed there, do not sprout again indeed. 54

15.4.s: tisraḥ koṭayo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānīha mahītale .. 55 ..
15.4.d: तिस्रः कोटयोऽर्धकोटी च तीर्थानीह महीतले .. 55 ..
15.4.m: Three and a half crores of sacred fords are here on the surface of the earth; 55

15.4.s:
evaṃ tīrthayutā tatra dvārakā muktidāyakā ..
sevanīyā prayatnena prāpya mānuṣyamuttamam ..56..
15.4.d:
एवं तीर्थयुता तत्र द्वारका मुक्तिदायका ..
सेवनीया प्रयत्नेन प्राप्य मानुष्यमुत्तमम् ..56..
15.4.m: endowed with such sacred fords, Dvārakā, granting liberation there, / should be resorted to with effort, having obtained the excellent human birth. 56

15.4.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
bṛhaspatervacaḥ śrutvā śatakraturathā'bravīt ..
vācaspate mama ihi dvāravatyā mahodayam..
gamane kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya darśane .. 57 ..
15.4.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
बृहस्पतेर्वचः श्रुत्वा शतक्रतुरथाऽब्रवीत् ..
वाचस्पते मम इहि द्वारवत्या महोदयम्..
गमने किं फलं प्रोक्तं कृष्णदेवस्य दर्शने .. 57 ..
15.4.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing Bṛhaspati's words, the performer of a hundred sacrifices then said: / O Lord of speech, tell me the great rise of Dvāravatī: / what fruit is proclaimed for going [there] and for the darśana of the divine Kṛṣṇa? 57

15.4.s:
anyāni tatra tīrthāni mukhyāni vada me guro ..
yathābhiṣeke gomatyāḥ phalaṃ yadapi saṃgame ..58... ..
15.4.d:
अन्यानि तत्र तीर्थानि मुख्यानि वद मे गुरो ..
यथाभिषेके गोमत्याः फलं यदपि संगमे ..58... ..
15.4.m: Tell me of the other foremost sacred fords there, O guru, / and likewise what fruit comes from ritual ablution in the Gomatī and at its confluence.

15.4.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
śrūyatāṃ tāta vakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ dvārakodbhavam ..
manuṣyarūpo bhagavānyatra krīḍati keśavaḥ ..59..
15.4.d:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
श्रूयतां तात वक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं द्वारकोद्भवम् ..
मनुष्यरूपो भगवान्यत्र क्रीडति केशवः ..59..
15.4.m: Bṛhaspati said: / Listen, dear one, I shall declare the māhātmya originating from Dvārakā, / where the blessed Lord Keśava plays in human form.

15.4.s:
nārāyaṇaḥ sa īśāno dhyeyaścādau jaganmayaḥ ..
sa eva devatāmukhyaḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ sthitaḥ .. 7.4.4.60 ..
15.4.d:
नारायणः स ईशानो ध्येयश्चादौ जगन्मयः ..
स एव देवतामुख्यः पुरीं द्वारवतीं स्थितः .. 7.4.4.60 ..
15.4.m: Nārāyaṇa, that sovereign lord consisting of the universe, should be meditated upon in the beginning; / he alone, the foremost among deities, resides in the city of Dvāravatī.

15.4.s:
ekaikasminpade datte purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati ..
puṇyaṃ kratusahasreṇa kalau bhavati dehinām ..61..
15.4.d:
एकैकस्मिन्पदे दत्ते पुरीं द्वारवतीं प्रति ..
पुण्यं क्रतुसहस्रेण कलौ भवति देहिनाम् ..61..
15.4.m: With each single step taken toward the city of Dvāravatī, / in the Kali age, the merit of a thousand sacrifices accrues to embodied beings.

15.4.s:
kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye gacchaṃti narottamāḥ ..
kulakoṭiśatairyuktāste gacchanti hareḥ padam ..62..
15.4.d:
कलौ कृष्णपुरीं रम्यां ये गच्छंति नरोत्तमाः ..
कुलकोटिशतैर्युक्तास्ते गच्छन्ति हरेः पदम् ..62..
15.4.m: Those best of men who go to Kṛṣṇa's delightful city in the Kali age / go to the abode of Hari along with a hundred times ten million of their kinsmen.

15.4.s:
ye dhyāyaṃti manovṛttyā gamanaṃ dvārakāṃ prati ..
teṣāṃ vilīyate pāpaṃ pūrvajanmāyutaiḥ kṛtam .. 63 ..
15.4.d:
ये ध्यायंति मनोवृत्त्या गमनं द्वारकां प्रति ..
तेषां विलीयते पापं पूर्वजन्मायुतैः कृतम् .. 63 ..
15.4.m: Those who mentally contemplate going toward Dvārakā— / their sin committed across ten thousand previous births is dissolved.

15.4.s:
kṛṣṇasya darśane buddhirjāyate yasya dehinaḥ ..
vaktrāvalokanāttasya pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā .. 64 ..
15.4.d:
कृष्णस्य दर्शने बुद्धिर्जायते यस्य देहिनः ..
वक्त्रावलोकनात्तस्य पापं याति सहस्रधा .. 64 ..
15.4.m: That embodied being in whom the intention arises to have the darśana of Kṛṣṇa— / from looking upon his face, their sin is shattered into a thousand pieces.

15.4.s:
ye gatā dvārakāyāṃ ca ye mṛtāḥ kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ..65..
15.4.d:
ये गता द्वारकायां च ये मृताः कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ..65..
15.4.m: Those who have gone to Dvārakā and those who have died in the presence of Kṛṣṇa— / there is no return for them as long as the dissolution of all beings lasts.

15.4.s:
sulabhā mathurā kāśī hyavantī ca tathā surāḥ ..
ayodhyā sulabhā loke durlabhā dvārakā kalau .. 66 ..
15.4.d:
सुलभा मथुरा काशी ह्यवन्ती च तथा सुराः ..
अयोध्या सुलभा लोके दुर्लभा द्वारका कलौ .. 66 ..
15.4.m: Mathurā, Kāśī, and Avantī are easy to reach, O gods; / Ayodhyā is easy to reach in this world, but Dvārakā is hard to reach in the Kali age.

15.4.s:
gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ṣaṇmāsātkṛṣṇasaṃnidhau..
jīvanmuktāstu te jñeyāḥ satyametatsurottama .. 67 ..
15.4.d:
गत्वा कृष्णपुरीं रम्यां षण्मासात्कृष्णसंनिधौ..
जीवन्मुक्तास्तु ते ज्ञेयाः सत्यमेतत्सुरोत्तम .. 67 ..
15.4.m: Having gone to Kṛṣṇa's delightful city and staying six months in Kṛṣṇa's presence, / they are to be known as liberated while living; this is the truth, O best of gods.

15.4.s:
kṛṣṇakrīḍākaraṃ sthānaṃ vāñchanti manasā priye ..
teṣāṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ pāpaṃ kṣālayetpretanāyakaḥ .. 68 ..
15.4.d:
कृष्णक्रीडाकरं स्थानं वाञ्छन्ति मनसा प्रिये ..
तेषां हृदि स्थितं पापं क्षालयेत्प्रेतनायकः .. 68 ..
15.4.m: Those who desire with their mind the place that is the site of Kṛṣṇa's sports, O dear one— / the Lord of the Dead washes away the sin residing in their hearts.

15.4.s:
atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhanti vigrahe ..
yāvanna gacchati naraḥ kalau dvāravatīṃ prati .. 69 ..
15.4.d:
अत्युग्राण्यपि पापानि तावत्तिष्ठन्ति विग्रहे ..
यावन्न गच्छति नरः कलौ द्वारवतीं प्रति .. 69 ..
15.4.m: Even exceedingly terrible sins remain in the body only so long / as a person does not go toward Dvāravatī in the Kali age.

15.4.s:
puṇyasaṃkhyā ca tīrthānāṃ brahmaṇā vihitā purā ..
dānādhyayana saṃjñānāṃ muktvā dvāravatīṃ kalau .. 7.4.4.70 ..
15.4.d:
पुण्यसंख्या च तीर्थानां ब्रह्मणा विहिता पुरा ..
दानाध्ययन संज्ञानां मुक्त्वा द्वारवतीं कलौ .. 7.4.4.70 ..
15.4.m: A tally of the merit of sacred fords, / called gifts and study, was laid down long ago by Brahmā—excepting Dvāravatī in the Kali age.

15.4.s:
cakratīrthe tu yo gacchetprasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ ..
kulaikaviṃśatiyutaḥ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam .. 71 ..
15.4.d:
चक्रतीर्थे तु यो गच्छेत्प्रसंगेनापि मानवः ..
कुलैकविंशतियुतः स गच्छेत्परमं पदम् .. 71 ..
15.4.m: Whatever person goes to Cakratīrtha, even by chance, / accompanied by twenty-one generations of his family, he goes to the supreme abode.

15.4.s:
lobhenā'pyaparādhena dambhena kapaṭena vā ..
cakratīrthaṃ ca yo gacchenna punarviśate bhavam .. 72 ..
15.4.d:
लोभेनाऽप्यपराधेन दम्भेन कपटेन वा ..
चक्रतीर्थं च यो गच्छेन्न पुनर्विशते भवम् .. 72 ..
15.4.m: Whether out of greed, wrongdoing, hypocrisy, or deceit, / whoever goes to Cakratīrtha does not enter mundane existence again.

15.4.s:
prayāge hyasthipātena yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam ..
tadeva śatasāhasraṃ cakratīrthāsthipātanāt .. 73 ..
15.4.d:
प्रयागे ह्यस्थिपातेन यत्फलं परिकीर्तितम् ..
तदेव शतसाहस्रं चक्रतीर्थास्थिपातनात् .. 73 ..
15.4.m: Whatever fruit is proclaimed by casting bones [of the dead] at Prayāga, / that very same fruit is a hundred-thousandfold from casting bones at Cakratīrtha.

15.4.s:
pṛthivyāṃ caiva tattīrthaṃ paramaṃ parikīrtitam ..
cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam .. 74 ..
15.4.d:
पृथिव्यां चैव तत्तीर्थं परमं परिकीर्तितम् ..
चक्रतीर्थमिति ख्यातं ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् .. 74 ..
15.4.m: And that sacred ford is proclaimed supreme upon the earth; / known as Cakratīrtha, it destroys [the sin of] killing a brahmin.

15.4.s:
ye ye kule bhaviṣyaṃti tatpūrvaṃ mānavāḥ kṣitau ..
sarve viṣṇupuraṃ yāṃti cakratīrthāsthipātanāt .. 75 ..
15.4.d:
ये ये कुले भविष्यंति तत्पूर्वं मानवाः क्षितौ ..
सर्वे विष्णुपुरं यांति चक्रतीर्थास्थिपातनात् .. 75 ..
15.4.m: Whatever people shall come in the family, as well as those before them on earth— / all go to the city of Viṣṇu from the casting of bones at Cakratīrtha.

15.4.s:
kiṃ jātairbahubhiḥ putrairgaṇanāpūrakātmakaiḥ ..
varameko bhavetputraścakratīrthaṃ tu yo vrajet .. 76 ..
15.4.d:
किं जातैर्बहुभिः पुत्रैर्गणनापूरकात्मकैः ..
वरमेको भवेत्पुत्रश्चक्रतीर्थं तु यो व्रजेत् .. 76 ..
15.4.m: What is the use of many sons born merely to fill out a number? / Better would be a single son who goes to Cakratīrtha.

15.4.s:
tapasā kiṃ prataptena dānenādhyayanena kim ..
sarvāvastho'pi mucyeta gataḥ kṛṣṇapurīṃ yadi .. 77 ..
15.4.d:
तपसा किं प्रतप्तेन दानेनाध्ययनेन किम् ..
सर्वावस्थोऽपि मुच्येत गतः कृष्णपुरीं यदि .. 77 ..
15.4.m: What is the use of austerity severely performed? What of giving, or of study? / In any condition whatsoever one is freed, if one has gone to Kṛṣṇa's city.

15.4.s:
kalikāla kṛtairdoṣairatyugrairapi mānavaḥ ..
kalau kṛṣṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā lipyate na kadācana .. 78 ..
15.4.d:
कलिकाल कृतैर्दोषैरत्युग्रैरपि मानवः ..
कलौ कृष्णमुखं दृष्ट्वा लिप्यते न कदाचन .. 78 ..
15.4.m: Even by the most terrible faults caused by the Kali age, a person / is never tainted, once he has looked upon the face of Kṛṣṇa in the Kali age.

15.4.s:
dānaṃ cādhyayanaṃ śaucaṃ kāraṇaṃ na hi putraka ..
hīnavarṇo'pi pāpātmā gataḥ kṛṣṇapurīṃ yadi .. 79 ..
15.4.d:
दानं चाध्ययनं शौचं कारणं न हि पुत्रक ..
हीनवर्णोऽपि पापात्मा गतः कृष्णपुरीं यदि .. 79 ..
15.4.m: Giving, study, and ritual purity are of no consequence, dear son; / even an outcaste or a sinful soul is freed, if he has gone to Kṛṣṇa's city.

15.4.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre narmadāyāṃ ca yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ nimiṣārdhena dvāravatyāṃ dinedine .. 7.4.4.80 ..
15.4.d:
वाराणस्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे नर्मदायां च यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं निमिषार्धेन द्वारवत्यां दिनेदिने .. 7.4.4.80 ..
15.4.m: Whatever fruit is gained at Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, and on the Narmadā— / that fruit is obtained in half a twinkling of an eye day after day in Dvāravatī.

15.4.s:
dhanyānāmapi dhanyāste devānāmapi devatāḥ ..
kṛṣṇopari matiryeṣāṃ hīyate na kadācana .. 81 ..
15.4.d:
धन्यानामपि धन्यास्ते देवानामपि देवताः ..
कृष्णोपरि मतिर्येषां हीयते न कदाचन .. 81 ..
15.4.m: Fortunate among the fortunate are they, gods among the gods, / whose mind fixed on Kṛṣṇa is never diminished.

15.4.s:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
snātvā kṛṣṇasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā lipyate naiva sa kvacit .. 82 ..
15.4.d:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नात्वा कृष्णसुतं दृष्ट्वा लिप्यते नैव स क्वचित् .. 82 ..
15.4.m: On the conjunction of the Śravaṇā twelfth day, at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / having bathed and looked upon the son of Kṛṣṇa, one is never tainted anywhere.

15.4.s:
yasya kasyāpi māsasya dvādaśī prāpya mānavaḥ ..
kṛṣṇakrīḍāpurīṃ dṛṣṭvā muktaḥ saṃsāragahvarāt .. 83 ..
15.4.d:
यस्य कस्यापि मासस्य द्वादशी प्राप्य मानवः ..
कृष्णक्रीडापुरीं दृष्ट्वा मुक्तः संसारगह्वरात् .. 83 ..
15.4.m: Reaching the twelfth day of whatever month, / and seeing the city of Kṛṣṇa's sports, a person is freed from the chasm of saṃsāra.

15.4.s:
yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇālaye prāṇā gatāḥ surapate kalau ..
svargānna teṣāmāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 84 ..
15.4.d:
येषां कृष्णालये प्राणा गताः सुरपते कलौ ..
स्वर्गान्न तेषामावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .. 84 ..
15.4.m: Those whose vital breaths depart in Kṛṣṇa's abode in the Kali age, O lord of gods— / there is no return for them from heaven, even after hundreds of millions of kalpas.

15.4.s:
vijñeyā mānuṣā vatsa garbhasthāste mahītale ..
dvāravatyāṃ na yairdevo dṛṣṭaḥ kaṃsaniṣūdanaḥ .. 85 ..
15.4.d:
विज्ञेया मानुषा वत्स गर्भस्थास्ते महीतले ..
द्वारवत्यां न यैर्देवो दृष्टः कंसनिषूदनः .. 85 ..
15.4.m: Human beings on earth by whom the god who slew Kaṃsa has not been seen / in Dvāravatī are to be regarded, dear one, as still trapped in the womb.

15.4.s:
durlabho dvārakāvāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
durlabhaṃ gomatīsnānaṃ durlabho rukmiṇīpatiḥ .. 86 ..
15.4.d:
दुर्लभो द्वारकावासो दुर्लभं कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
दुर्लभं गोमतीस्नानं दुर्लभो रुक्मिणीपतिः .. 86 ..
15.4.m: Hard to obtain is dwelling in Dvārakā, hard to obtain is the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, / hard to obtain is ritual ablution in the Gomatī, hard to obtain is the husband of Rukmiṇī.

15.4.s:
tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate ..
dvāpare tu paro yajñaḥ kalau keśavakīrtanam .. 87 ..
15.4.d:
तपः परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां ज्ञानमुच्यते ..
द्वापरे तु परो यज्ञः कलौ केशवकीर्तनम् .. 87 ..
15.4.m: Austerity is said to be supreme in the Kṛta age, knowledge in the Tretā, / but sacrifice is supreme in the Dvāpara, and the praise of Keśava in the Kali age.

15.4.s:
hemabhārasahasraistu dattairyatphalamāpyate ..
dṛṣṭvā tatkoṭi guṇitaṃ hareḥ sarvapradaṃ mukham .. 88 ..
15.4.d:
हेमभारसहस्रैस्तु दत्तैर्यत्फलमाप्यते ..
दृष्ट्वा तत्कोटि गुणितं हरेः सर्वप्रदं मुखम् .. 88 ..
15.4.m: Whatever fruit is obtained by giving thousands of bhāras of gold, / that is multiplied ten-millionfold upon seeing Hari's face, which bestows all things.

15.4.s:
dvārakāyāṃ ca yaddattaṃ śaṃkhoddhāre tathaiva ca ..
piṃḍārake mahātīrthe dattaṃ caivākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 89 ..
15.4.d:
द्वारकायां च यद्दत्तं शंखोद्धारे तथैव च ..
पिंडारके महातीर्थे दत्तं चैवाक्षयं भवेत् .. 89 ..
15.4.m: What is given at Dvārakā and likewise at Śaṅkhoddhāra, / and what is given at the great sacred ford Piṇḍāraka becomes imperishable.

15.4.s:
gomahiṣyādi yaddattaṃ suvarṇavasanāni ca ..
vṛṣo bhūmigraho rūpyaṃ kanyādānaṃ tathaiva ca .. 7.4.4.90 ..
15.4.d:
गोमहिष्यादि यद्दत्तं सुवर्णवसनानि च ..
वृषो भूमिग्रहो रूप्यं कन्यादानं तथैव च .. 7.4.4.90 ..
15.4.m: Whatever cows, female buffaloes, gold, and garments are given, / as well as a bull, a gift of land, silver, and the gifting of a maiden in marriage—

15.4.s:
yaccānyadapi devendra triṣu sthāneṣu yacchati ..
tanmuktikārakaṃ proktaṃ pitṝṇāmātmanastathā .. 91 ..
15.4.d:
यच्चान्यदपि देवेन्द्र त्रिषु स्थानेषु यच्छति ..
तन्मुक्तिकारकं प्रोक्तं पितॄणामात्मनस्तथा .. 91 ..
15.4.m: and whatever else one gives in these three places, O lord of the gods, / that is declared to bring liberation to the ancestors and to oneself.

15.4.s:
ūṣaraṃ hi yato loke kṣetrametatprakīrtitam ..
ato muktikaraṃ sarvaṃ dānaṃ coktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ .. 92 ..
15.4.d:
ऊषरं हि यतो लोके क्षेत्रमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् ..
अतो मुक्तिकरं सर्वं दानं चोक्तं महर्षिभिः .. 92 ..
15.4.m: Because this sacred field is renowned in the world as sterile soil, / therefore every gift [given here] is declared by the great seers to grant liberation.

15.4.s:
yatkiṃcitkurute tatra dānaṃ krīḍāvagāhanam ..
tadanantaphalaṃ prāha bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ .. 93 ..
15.4.d:
यत्किंचित्कुरुते तत्र दानं क्रीडावगाहनम् ..
तदनन्तफलं प्राह भगवान्मधुसूदनः .. 93 ..
15.4.m: Whatever slight gift, sport, or plunge [into the waters] one performs there, / that yields infinite fruit, so the blessed Lord Madhusūdana declared.

15.4.s:
pretatvaṃ naiva tasyāsti na yāmyā nārakī vyathā ..
yena dvāravatīṃ gatvā kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇā'valokanam .. 94 ..
15.4.d:
प्रेतत्वं नैव तस्यास्ति न याम्या नारकी व्यथा ..
येन द्वारवतीं गत्वा कृतं कृष्णाऽवलोकनम् .. 94 ..
15.4.m: There is no state of being a ghost for him, nor the torment of Yama's hell, / by whom, having gone to Dvāravatī, the sight of Kṛṣṇa was attained.

15.4.s:
vārimātreṇa gomatyāṃ piṇḍadāne kṛte kalau ..
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 95 ..
15.4.d:
वारिमात्रेण गोमत्यां पिण्डदाने कृते कलौ ..
पितॄणां जायते तृप्तिर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 95 ..
15.4.m: When a funerary cake is offered in the Kali age with merely the water of the Gomatī, / satisfaction comes to the ancestors for as long as the dissolution of all beings lasts.

15.4.s:
nityaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye smaranti gṛhasthitāḥ ..
namasyāḥ sarvalokānāṃ devānāṃ ca surottama .. 96 ..
15.4.d:
नित्यं कृष्णपुरीं रम्यां ये स्मरन्ति गृहस्थिताः ..
नमस्याः सर्वलोकानां देवानां च सुरोत्तम .. 96 ..
15.4.m: Those who, dwelling in their homes, daily remember the charming city of Kṛṣṇa / are worthy of worship by all worlds and by the gods, O best of gods.

15.4.s:
brahmajñānaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ maraṇaṃ gograheṣu ca ..
vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ dvārakāyāṃ muktireṣā caturvidhā .. 97 ..
15.4.d:
ब्रह्मज्ञानं गयाश्राद्धं मरणं गोग्रहेषु च ..
वासः पुंसां द्वारकायां मुक्तिरेषा चतुर्विधा .. 97 ..
15.4.m: Knowledge of Brahman, śrāddha at Gayā, death while defending cattle, / and residence in Dvārakā for men—this is the fourfold liberation.

15.4.s:
brahmajñānena mucyante prayāge maraṇena vā ..
athavā snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. 98 ..
15.4.d:
ब्रह्मज्ञानेन मुच्यन्ते प्रयागे मरणेन वा ..
अथवा स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां कृष्णसंनिधौ .. 98 ..
15.4.m: They are liberated by knowledge of Brahman, or by death at Prayāga, / or simply by ritual ablution in the Gomatī in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.4.s:
kṛtārthaḥ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ bravītyevaṃ mahodadhiḥ ..
pavitritaṃ ca madgātraṃ gomatīvārisaṃplavāt .. 99 ..
15.4.d:
कृतार्थः कृतपुण्योऽहं ब्रवीत्येवं महोदधिः ..
पवित्रितं च मद्गात्रं गोमतीवारिसंप्लवात् .. 99 ..
15.4.m: ‘I have accomplished my goal, I have accumulated merit,’ so says the great ocean; / ‘and my body is purified by the rushing waters of the Gomatī.’

15.4.s:
atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhaṃti vigrahe ..
yāvatsnānaṃ na gomatyāṃ vāriṇā pāpahāriṇā .. 7.4.4.100 ..
15.4.d:
अत्युग्राण्यपि पापानि तावत्तिष्ठंति विग्रहे ..
यावत्स्नानं न गोमत्यां वारिणा पापहारिणा .. 7.4.4.100 ..
15.4.m: Even exceedingly terrible sins remain in the body only so long / as there is no ritual ablution in the Gomatī with its sin-removing water.

15.4.s:
cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā gomatyāṃ rukmiṇīhrade ..
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ ramyaṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam .. 101 ..
15.4.d:
चक्रतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोमत्यां रुक्मिणीह्रदे ..
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमुखं रम्यं कुलानां तारयेच्छतम् .. 101 ..
15.4.m: A man who has bathed at Cakratīrtha, in the Gomatī, and in the pool of Rukmiṇī, / and has looked upon Kṛṣṇa's charming face, redeems a hundred families.

15.4.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ ca ye dvāravatīṃ manuṣyāḥ smaraṃti nityaṃ haribhaktiyuktāḥ ..
vidhūtapāpāḥ kila saṃbhavāṃte gacchaṃti lokaṃ paramaṃ murāreḥ .. 102 ..
15.4.d:
कृष्णं च ये द्वारवतीं मनुष्याः स्मरंति नित्यं हरिभक्तियुक्ताः ..
विधूतपापाः किल संभवांते गच्छंति लोकं परमं मुरारेः .. 102 ..
15.4.m: And those people who constantly remember Kṛṣṇa and Dvāravatī, endowed with devotion to Hari, / their sins shaken off, at the end of their lives certainly go to the supreme realm of Murāri.

15.4.s:
adhautapādaḥ prathamaṃ namaskuryādgaṇeśvaram ..
sarvavighravināśaśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 103 ..
15.4.d:
अधौतपादः प्रथमं नमस्कुर्याद्गणेश्वरम् ..
सर्वविघ्रविनाशश्च जायते नात्र संशयः .. 103 ..
15.4.m: With unwashed feet, one should first bow down to the Lord of Gaṇas (Gaṇeśa); / and the destruction of all obstacles occurs, there is no doubt about this.

15.4.s:
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ devakinandanam ..
daṇḍavatpraṇametprītyā praṇamedagrajaṃ punaḥ .. 104 ..
15.4.d:
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामं कृष्णं देवकिनन्दनम् ..
दण्डवत्प्रणमेत्प्रीत्या प्रणमेदग्रजं पुनः .. 104 ..
15.4.m: To Kṛṣṇa, dark as the petal of a blue lotus, the son of Devakī, / one should bow down like a staff with love, and then bow down to his elder brother.

15.4.s:
bālye ca yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kaumāre yauvane tathā ..
darśanātkṛṣṇadevasya tannaśyennātra saṃśayaḥ .. 105 ..
15.4.d:
बाल्ये च यत्कृतं पापं कौमारे यौवने तथा ..
दर्शनात्कृष्णदेवस्य तन्नश्येन्नात्र संशयः .. 105 ..
15.4.m: And whatever sin was committed in childhood, boyhood, as well as in youth, / that is destroyed by the darśana of Lord Kṛṣṇa; there is no doubt about this.

15.4.s:
vāṇyā'tha manasā yacca karmaṇā samupārjitam ..
pāpaṃ janmasahasreṇa tannaśyennātra saṃśayaḥ .. 106 ..
15.4.d:
वाण्याऽथ मनसा यच्च कर्मणा समुपार्जितम् ..
पापं जन्मसहस्रेण तन्नश्येन्नात्र संशयः .. 106 ..
15.4.m: And whatever sin has been accumulated by speech, mind, or action / through a thousand births, that is destroyed; there is no doubt about this.

15.4.s:
hemabhārasahasraistu dattairyatphalamāpyate ..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokanāt .. 107 ..
15.4.d:
हेमभारसहस्रैस्तु दत्तैर्यत्फलमाप्यते ..
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं कृष्णवक्त्रावलोकनात् .. 107 ..
15.4.m: Whatever fruit is obtained by giving thousands of bhāras of gold, / that fruit is multiplied ten-millionfold by beholding the face of Kṛṣṇa.

15.4.s:
namaskṛtya ca deveśaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam ..
durvāsasaṃ maheśānaṃ dvārakāparirakṣakam ..108..
15.4.d:
नमस्कृत्य च देवेशं पुण्डरीकाक्षमच्युतम् ..
दुर्वाससं महेशानं द्वारकापरिरक्षकम् ..108..
15.4.m: And having bowed to the Lord of the gods, the lotus-eyed, the imperishable Acyuta, / to Durvāsas, the great lord who guards Dvārakā,

15.4.s:
praṇamya parayā bhaktyā vainateyasamanvitam .'.
dvāramāgatya ca punaḥ svargadvāropamaṃ śubham.. 109 ..
15.4.d:
प्रणम्य परया भक्त्या वैनतेयसमन्वितम् .'.
द्वारमागत्य च पुनः स्वर्गद्वारोपमं शुभम्.. 109 ..
15.4.m: and having bowed with supreme devotion [to the lord] accompanied by the son of Vinatā (Garuḍa), / coming again to the auspicious gate resembling the gateway of heaven,

15.4.s:
viśramya ca muhūrttārddhaṃ suhṛdbhirbāndhavairvṛtaḥ ..
tatrāśritānsamāhūya brāhmaṇānmantrakovidān ..
pūjādravyaṃ samānīya tatastīrthaṃ vrajedbudhaḥ .. 7.4.4.110 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāyātrāvidhivarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ .. 4 .. .. cha ..
15.4.d:
विश्रम्य च मुहूर्त्तार्द्धं सुहृद्भिर्बान्धवैर्वृतः ..
तत्राश्रितान्समाहूय ब्राह्मणान्मन्त्रकोविदान् ..
पूजाद्रव्यं समानीय ततस्तीर्थं व्रजेद्बुधः .. 7.4.4.110 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकायात्राविधिवर्णनंनाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः .. 4 .. .. छ ..
15.4.m:
and having rested for half a muhūrta surrounded by friends and relatives, / calling together the brahmins residing there who are skilled in mantras, / having brought the articles of worship, the wise man should then proceed to the tīrtha.
Thus ends the fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rules for the Dvārakā Pilgrimage', in the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.5.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā gomatīṃ kṛṣṇasaṃśrayām ..
yasyā darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt.. 1 ..
15.5.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा गोमतीं कृष्णसंश्रयाम् ..
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः कृष्णसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्.. 1 ..
15.5.m: Prahlāda said: / Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go to the Gomatī which rests in Kṛṣṇa, / by the mere sight of which one is freed from all sins; / freed from all sins, one attains union with Kṛṣṇa.

15.5.s:
duritaughakṣayakaramamaṃgalyavināśanam ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ praṇamedgomatījalam .. 2 ..
15.5.d:
दुरितौघक्षयकरममंगल्यविनाशनम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदं नॄणां प्रणमेद्गोमतीजलम् .. 2 ..
15.5.m: Which causes the destruction of the flood of misfortunes, which destroys all inauspiciousness, / which grants all desires to mortals—one should bow to the water of the Gomatī.

15.5.s:
mahāpāpakṣayakaramagatīnāṃgatipradam ..
pūrvapuṇyavaśātprāptaṃ praṇamedgomatījalam .. 3 ..
15.5.d:
महापापक्षयकरमगतीनांगतिप्रदम् ..
पूर्वपुण्यवशात्प्राप्तं प्रणमेद्गोमतीजलम् .. 3 ..
15.5.m: Which destroys great sins, which provides a refuge to the helpless, / attained by the power of past merits—one should bow to the water of the Gomatī.

15.5.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
daityendra saṃśayo'smākaṃ taṃ tvaṃ chettumihārhasi ..
iyaṃ kā gomatī tatra kenānītā mahāmate .. 4 ..
15.5.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
दैत्येन्द्र संशयोऽस्माकं तं त्वं छेत्तुमिहार्हसि ..
इयं का गोमती तत्र केनानीता महामते .. 4 ..
15.5.m: The seers said: / O Lord of Daityas, we have a doubt; you ought to resolve it here. / What is this Gomatī, and by whom was she brought there, O highly intelligent one?

15.5.s:
kena kāryavaśeneha saṃprāptā varuṇālayam ..
sarvaṃ bhāgavataśreṣṭha hyetadvistarato vada .. 5 ..
15.5.d:
केन कार्यवशेनेह संप्राप्ता वरुणालयम् ..
सर्वं भागवतश्रेष्ठ ह्येतद्विस्तरतो वद .. 5 ..
15.5.m: On account of what purpose did she reach here, the abode of Varuṇa (the ocean)? / O best of the devotees of the Blessed One, tell all this in detail.

15.5.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
ekārṇave purā bhūte naṣṭe sthāvara jaṃgame ..
tadā brahmā samabhavadviṣṇornābhisaroruhāt .. 6 ..
15.5.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एकार्णवे पुरा भूते नष्टे स्थावर जंगमे ..
तदा ब्रह्मा समभवद्विष्णोर्नाभिसरोरुहात् .. 6 ..
15.5.m: Prahlāda said: / Formerly, when there was a single vast ocean and moving and unmoving things had perished, / Brahmā then arose from the navel-lotus of Viṣṇu.

15.5.s:
ādiṣṭaḥ prabhuṇā brahmā sṛjasva vividhāḥ prajāḥ ..
iti dhātā samādiṣṭo hariṇā sṛṣṭi kāraṇe .. 7 ..
15.5.d:
आदिष्टः प्रभुणा ब्रह्मा सृजस्व विविधाः प्रजाः ..
इति धाता समादिष्टो हरिणा सृष्टि कारणे .. 7 ..
15.5.m: Brahmā was instructed by the Lord: 'Create diverse living beings.' / Thus was the creator instructed by Hari for the purpose of creation.

15.5.s:
uktvā bāḍhamiti brahmā tataḥ sṛṣṭau mano dadhe ..
sasarja mānasātsadyaḥ sanakādyānkumārakān ..
uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā prajāḥ sṛjata putrakāḥ .. 8 ..
15.5.d:
उक्त्वा बाढमिति ब्रह्मा ततः सृष्टौ मनो दधे ..
ससर्ज मानसात्सद्यः सनकाद्यान्कुमारकान् ..
उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा प्रजाः सृजत पुत्रकाः .. 8 ..
15.5.m: Saying 'Very well', Brahmā then directed his mind toward creation. / From his mind he immediately created the Kumāras headed by Sanaka. / Brahmā spoke the word: 'My sons, create offspring.'

15.5.s:
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā te kṛtāṃjalayo'bruvan ..
bhagavanbhagavadrūpaṃ draṣṭukāmā vayaṃ prabho .. 9 ..
15.5.d:
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा ते कृतांजलयोऽब्रुवन् ..
भगवन्भगवद्रूपं द्रष्टुकामा वयं प्रभो .. 9 ..
15.5.m: Hearing the word of Brahmā, they said with joined palms: / 'O Blessed Lord, we wish to see the form of the Blessed One, O master.

15.5.s:
na bandhamanuvarttāmaḥ sṛṣṭirūpaṃ durāsadam..
ityuktvā te yayuḥ sarve sanakādyā kumārakāḥ .. 7.4.5.10..
15.5.d:
न बन्धमनुवर्त्तामः सृष्टिरूपं दुरासदम्..
इत्युक्त्वा ते ययुः सर्वे सनकाद्या कुमारकाः .. 7.4.5.10..
15.5.m: We will not follow the bond in the form of creation, which is hard to overcome.' / Having spoken thus, they all, the Kumāras headed by Sanaka, departed.

15.5.s:
paścimāṃ diśamāsthāya tīre nadanadīpateḥ ..
tejomayasya rūpasya draṣṭukāmā mahātmanaḥ ..
tasminmānasamādhāya tepire paramaṃ tapaḥ .. 11 ..
15.5.d:
पश्चिमां दिशमास्थाय तीरे नदनदीपतेः ..
तेजोमयस्य रूपस्य द्रष्टुकामा महात्मनः ..
तस्मिन्मानसमाधाय तेपिरे परमं तपः .. 11 ..
15.5.m: Proceeding to the western direction, on the shore of the ocean (lord of rivers and streams), / desiring to behold the radiant form of the Great Soul, / fixing their minds upon him, they performed supreme austerity.

15.5.s:
bahuvarṣasahasraistu prasanne dharaṇīdhare ..
bhittvā jalaṃ samuttasthau tejorūpaṃ durāsadam .. .. 12 ..
15.5.d:
बहुवर्षसहस्रैस्तु प्रसन्ने धरणीधरे ..
भित्त्वा जलं समुत्तस्थौ तेजोरूपं दुरासदम् .. .. 12 ..
15.5.m: After many thousands of years, when the Supporter of the Earth (Viṣṇu) was pleased, / splitting the waters, a radiant form arose, difficult to approach,

15.5.s:
anekadaityadamanaṃ bahuyaṃtravidāraṇam ..
sūryakoṭiprabhābhāsaṃ sahasrāraṃ sudarśanam .. 13 ..
15.5.d:
अनेकदैत्यदमनं बहुयंत्रविदारणम् ..
सूर्यकोटिप्रभाभासं सहस्रारं सुदर्शनम् .. 13 ..
15.5.m: subduing many Daityas, shattering many [mystic] weapons, / shining with the brilliance of ten million suns, the thousand-spoked Sudarśana.

15.5.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve brahmaputrāḥ parasparam ..
vīkṣamāṇā bhagavataḥ paramāyudhamuttamam .. 14 ..
15.5.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मपुत्राः परस्परम् ..
वीक्षमाणा भगवतः परमायुधमुत्तमम् .. 14 ..
15.5.m: Seeing it, all the sons of Brahmā were amazed among themselves, / beholding the supreme, excellent weapon of the Blessed One.

15.5.s:
tānvilokya tathābhūtānvāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
bho brahmaputrā bhagavāñchrīghramāvirbhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
15.5.d:
तान्विलोक्य तथाभूतान्वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
भो ब्रह्मपुत्रा भगवाञ्छ्रीघ्रमाविर्भविष्यति .. 15 ..
15.5.m: Beholding them in that condition, a bodiless voice spoke: / 'O sons of Brahmā, the Blessed One will soon manifest himself.

15.5.s:
arhaṇārthaṃ bhagavataḥ śīghramarghyaṃ prakalpyatām..
āyudhaṃ lokanāthasya dvijāḥ śīghraṃ prasādyatām .. 16 ..
tacchrutvā''kāśavacanaṃ tuṣṭuvuste sudarśanam .. 1 ..
15.5.d:
अर्हणार्थं भगवतः शीघ्रमर्घ्यं प्रकल्प्यताम्..
आयुधं लोकनाथस्य द्विजाः शीघ्रं प्रसाद्यताम् .. 16 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा'ऽकाशवचनं तुष्टुवुस्ते सुदर्शनम् .. 1 ..
15.5.m:
Quickly prepare the arghya offering for honoring the Blessed One. / O twice-born, quickly propitiate the weapon of the Lord of the worlds.'
Hearing that speech from the sky, they praised Sudarśana.

15.5.s:
ṛṣaya ucuḥ .. ..
jyotirmaya namaste'stu namaste harivallabha ..
sudarśana namaste'stu sahasrārā'kṣarā'vyaya ..18..
15.5.d:
ऋषय उचुः .. ..
ज्योतिर्मय नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते हरिवल्लभ ..
सुदर्शन नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्राराऽक्षराऽव्यय ..18..
15.5.m: The seers said: / O you who consist of light, homage to you; homage to you, the beloved of Hari! / O Sudarśana, homage to you, thousand-spoked, imperishable, immutable!

15.5.s:
namaste sūryarūpāya brahma rūpāya te namaḥ ..
amoghāya namastubhyaṃ rathāṃgāya namonamaḥ .. 19 ..
15.5.d:
नमस्ते सूर्यरूपाय ब्रह्म रूपाय ते नमः ..
अमोघाय नमस्तुभ्यं रथांगाय नमोनमः .. 19 ..
15.5.m: Homage to you whose form is the sun, homage to you whose form is Brahman! / Homage to you, the unfailing one; homage, homage to the discus!

15.5.s:
evaṃ te pūjayāmāsuḥ sumanobhistathā'kṣataiḥ .. 7.4.5.20 ..
stavairnānāvidhaiḥ stutvā praṇemurharivallabham ..
tatprasādya sunābhaṃ tu prabhusaṃdarśanotsukāḥ .. 20 ..
15.5.d:
एवं ते पूजयामासुः सुमनोभिस्तथाऽक्षतैः .. 7.4.5.20 ..
स्तवैर्नानाविधैः स्तुत्वा प्रणेमुर्हरिवल्लभम् ..
तत्प्रसाद्य सुनाभं तु प्रभुसंदर्शनोत्सुकाः .. 20 ..
15.5.m:
Thus they worshipped [it] with flowers as well as unbroken grains of rice.
Having praised the beloved of Hari with various hymns, they bowed down. / Having then propitiated Sunābha, eager for the vision of the Lord,

15.5.s:
asmaranmanasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pitaraṃ svakam ..
teṣāṃ tu ciṃtitaṃ jñātvā brahmā gaṃgāmathābravīt .. 21 ..
15.5.d:
अस्मरन्मनसा देवं ब्रह्माणं पितरं स्वकम् ..
तेषां तु चिंतितं ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मा गंगामथाब्रवीत् .. 21 ..
15.5.m: they remembered in their minds the god Brahmā, their own father. / Knowing their thought, Brahmā then said to the Gaṅgā:

15.5.s:
yāhi śīghraṃ saricchreṣṭhe pṛthivyāṃ harikāraṇāt ..
gāṃ gatā tvaṃ mahābhāge tato bahumatā'si me .. 22 ..
15.5.d:
याहि शीघ्रं सरिच्छ्रेष्ठे पृथिव्यां हरिकारणात् ..
गां गता त्वं महाभागे ततो बहुमताऽसि मे .. 22 ..
15.5.m: 'Go quickly to the earth, O best of rivers, for the sake of Hari. / Because you go to the earth, O highly fortunate one, you are therefore greatly esteemed by me.

15.5.s: urvyāṃ te gomatī nāma suprasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 23 ..
15.5.d: उर्व्यां ते गोमती नाम सुप्रसिद्धं भविष्यति .. 23 ..
15.5.m: On earth your name will become very famous as Gomatī.

15.5.s:
vasiṣṭhasyānugā bhūtvā yāhi śīghraṃ dharātalam ..
tātaṃ putrīvānuyātā vasiṣṭhatanayā bhava .. 24 ..
15.5.d:
वसिष्ठस्यानुगा भूत्वा याहि शीघ्रं धरातलम् ..
तातं पुत्रीवानुयाता वसिष्ठतनया भव .. 24 ..
15.5.m: Following Vasiṣṭha, go quickly to the surface of the earth. / Following like a daughter follows her father, become the daughter of Vasiṣṭha.'

15.5.s:
bāḍhamityeva sā devī prasthitā varuṇālayam ..
vasiṣṭhastvagrato yāti taṃ gaṃgā pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt .. 25 ..
15.5.d:
बाढमित्येव सा देवी प्रस्थिता वरुणालयम् ..
वसिष्ठस्त्वग्रतो याति तं गंगा पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात् .. 25 ..
15.5.m: Saying 'Very well', that goddess set out for the abode of Varuṇa (the ocean). / Vasiṣṭha went ahead, and Gaṅgā followed behind him.

15.5.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manujāḥ sarve vasiṣṭhena samanvitām ..
namaścakrurmahābhāgāṃ gacchato paścimārṇavam .. 26 ..
15.5.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा मनुजाः सर्वे वसिष्ठेन समन्विताम् ..
नमश्चक्रुर्महाभागां गच्छतो पश्चिमार्णवम् .. 26 ..
15.5.m: Seeing her accompanied by Vasiṣṭha, all the mortals / bowed to the highly fortunate one as she was going to the western ocean.

15.5.s:
āvirbabhūva tatraiva yatra te munayaḥ sthitāḥ ..
draṣṭukāmā hare rūpaṃ śriyā juṣṭaṃ caturbhujam .. 27 ..
15.5.d:
आविर्बभूव तत्रैव यत्र ते मुनयः स्थिताः ..
द्रष्टुकामा हरे रूपं श्रिया जुष्टं चतुर्भुजम् .. 27 ..
15.5.m: She manifested right there where those sages were staying, / who were desiring to see the four-armed form of Hari served by Śrī.

15.5.s:
dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhamanugāmāyāntīṃ surapāvanīm ..
avākiranmahābhāgāṃ sumanobhiśca sarvaśaḥ .. 28 ..
15.5.d:
दृष्ट्वा वसिष्ठमनुगामायान्तीं सुरपावनीम् ..
अवाकिरन्महाभागां सुमनोभिश्च सर्वशः .. 28 ..
15.5.m: Seeing her who purifies the gods arriving as a follower of Vasiṣṭha, / they showered the highly fortunate one completely with flowers.

15.5.s:
divyairmālyaiḥ sugandhaiśca gandhadhūpaistathā'kṣataiḥ ..
saṃpūjya hṛṣṭamanasaḥ sādhusādhviti cābruvan .. 29 ..
15.5.d:
दिव्यैर्माल्यैः सुगन्धैश्च गन्धधूपैस्तथाऽक्षतैः ..
संपूज्य हृष्टमनसः साधुसाध्विति चाब्रुवन् .. 29 ..
15.5.m: Having worshipped [her] with divine garlands, sweet fragrances, incense, scents, and unbroken grains of rice, / with joyful minds, they said, 'Excellent, excellent!'

15.5.s:
vasiṣṭhaṃ te'gragaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyudatiṣṭhaṃstato dvijāḥ ..
arghyādisatkriyāṃ kṛtvā prahṛṣṭā idamabruvan .. .. 7.4.5.30 ..
15.5.d:
वसिष्ठं तेऽग्रगं दृष्ट्वा ह्युदतिष्ठंस्ततो द्विजाः ..
अर्घ्यादिसत्क्रियां कृत्वा प्रहृष्टा इदमब्रुवन् .. .. 7.4.5.30 ..
15.5.m: Seeing Vasiṣṭha going ahead, the twice-born then stood up. / Having performed hospitality with arghya and other offerings, highly delighted, they said this:

15.5.s:
yasmāttvayā samānītā hyasmim̐lloke saridvarā ..
tasmāttava sutetyevaṃ khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati .. 31 ..
15.5.d:
यस्मात्त्वया समानीता ह्यस्मिम्̐ल्लोके सरिद्वरा ..
तस्मात्तव सुतेत्येवं ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति .. 31 ..
15.5.m: 'Because the best of rivers has been brought to this world by you, / therefore she will attain fame in the world as your daughter.'

15.5.s:
goḥ svargādāgatā yasmādidaṃ sthānaṃ matī matā ..
tasmāddhi gomatīnāma khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati .. 32 ..
15.5.d:
गोः स्वर्गादागता यस्मादिदं स्थानं मती मता ..
तस्माद्धि गोमतीनाम ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति .. 32 ..
15.5.m: "Because this wise river has come to this place from heaven by the cow's power, / therefore she shall indeed be famed in the world by the name Gomatī.

15.5.s:
asyā darśanamātreṇa muktiṃ yāsyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
kiṃ punaḥ snāna dānādi kṛtvā yāṃti hareḥ padam .. 33 ..
15.5.d:
अस्या दर्शनमात्रेण मुक्तिं यास्यंति मानवाः ..
किं पुनः स्नान दानादि कृत्वा यांति हरेः पदम् .. 33 ..
15.5.m: Mortals will attain liberation merely by the sight of her; / what then of performing ritual ablution, giving gifts, and the like, by which they attain the abode of Hari?"

15.5.s:
tāmeva cārghyaṃ dattvā te yogīṃdrā īḍire harim ..
paraṃ puruṣasūktena puruṣaṃ śeṣaśāyinam .. 34 ..
15.5.d:
तामेव चार्घ्यं दत्त्वा ते योगींद्रा ईडिरे हरिम् ..
परं पुरुषसूक्तेन पुरुषं शेषशायिनम् .. 34 ..
15.5.m: Offering arghya to her, those lords among yogins praised Hari, / the supreme Puruṣa resting on Śeṣa, with the Puruṣasūkta.

15.5.s:
iti saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāṃ harirāvirbabhūva ha ..
pītakauśeyavasano vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ..
divyamālyānuliptāṃgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 35 ..
15.5.d:
इति संस्तुवतां तेषां हरिराविर्बभूव ह ..
पीतकौशेयवसनो वनमालाविभूषितः ..
दिव्यमाल्यानुलिप्तांगो दिव्याभरणभूषितः .. 35 ..
15.5.m: As they were thus praising him, Hari manifested himself: / wearing yellow silken garments, adorned with a garland of forest flowers, / his limbs smeared with divine unguent, adorned with divine ornaments,

15.5.s:
śeṣāsanagataṃ devaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham ..
jvalatkirīṭamukuṭaṃ sphuranmakarakuṃḍalam .. 36 ..
15.5.d:
शेषासनगतं देवं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ..
ज्वलत्किरीटमुकुटं स्फुरन्मकरकुंडलम् .. 36 ..
15.5.m: the God seated upon the seat of Śeṣa, brandishing numerous divine weapons, / wearing a blazing diadem-crown, with shimmering fish-shaped earrings,

15.5.s:
bhaktābhayapradaṃ śāṃtaṃ śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābhujam ..
sadā prasannavadanaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ caturbhujam .. 37 ..
15.5.d:
भक्ताभयप्रदं शांतं श्रीवत्सांकं महाभुजम् ..
सदा प्रसन्नवदनं घनश्यामं चतुर्भुजम् .. 37 ..
15.5.m: granting fearlessness to his devotees, peaceful, marked with the Śrīvatsa, mighty-armed, / ever with a smiling face, dark as a raincloud, four-armed,

15.5.s:
pādasaṃvāhanāsaktalakṣmyā juṣṭaṃ manoharam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve harṣotkarṣasamanvitāḥ ..
viṣṇuṃ te viṣṇusūktaiśca tuṣṭuvurvedasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 38 ..
15.5.d:
पादसंवाहनासक्तलक्ष्म्या जुष्टं मनोहरम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे हर्षोत्कर्षसमन्विताः ..
विष्णुं ते विष्णुसूक्तैश्च तुष्टुवुर्वेदसंभवैः .. 38 ..
15.5.m: attended by charming Lakṣmī, devoted to massaging his feet. / Seeing him, all the sages, filled with the utmost joy, / praised Viṣṇu with the Viṣṇusūktas born of the Veda.

15.5.s:
evaṃ saṃstuvatā teṣāṃ viṣṇurdīnānukaṃpakaḥ ..
uvāca suprasannena manasā dvijasattamān .. 39 ..
15.5.d:
एवं संस्तुवता तेषां विष्णुर्दीनानुकंपकः ..
उवाच सुप्रसन्नेन मनसा द्विजसत्तमान् .. 39 ..
15.5.m: As they were thus praising him, Viṣṇu, compassionate to the wretched, / spoke to the best among brahmins with a gracious mind.

15.5.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
bhobhoḥ kumārāstuṣṭo'haṃ pradāsyāmi yathepsitam ..
bhaviṣyatha jñānayutā aspṛṣṭā mama māyayā .. 7.4.5.40 ..
15.5.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
भोभोः कुमारास्तुष्टोऽहं प्रदास्यामि यथेप्सितम् ..
भविष्यथ ज्ञानयुता अस्पृष्टा मम मायया .. 7.4.5.40 ..
15.5.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "O youths! I am pleased; I will grant whatever is desired. / You shall be endowed with knowledge, untouched by my māyā.

15.5.s:
yasmānmokṣārthibhirviprā jalenāhaṃ prasāditaḥ ..
tasmādidaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ param .. 41 ..
15.5.d:
यस्मान्मोक्षार्थिभिर्विप्रा जलेनाहं प्रसादितः ..
तस्मादिदं परं तीर्थं सर्वकामप्रदं परम् .. 41 ..
15.5.m: Because I was propitiated with water by you who seek liberation, O brahmins, / therefore this supreme sacred ford shall be supreme, granting all desires.

15.5.s:
anugrahāya bhavatāṃ yatra cakraṃ sudarśanam ..
niḥsṛtaṃ prathamaṃ viprā jalaṃ bhittvā mamāgrataḥ .. .. 42 ..
15.5.d:
अनुग्रहाय भवतां यत्र चक्रं सुदर्शनम् ..
निःसृतं प्रथमं विप्रा जलं भित्त्वा ममाग्रतः .. .. 42 ..
15.5.m: O brahmins, where the Sudarśana discus first emerged before me, / cleaving the waters to show favor to you,

15.5.s:
cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati ..
mamāpi niyataṃ vāso bhaviṣyati mahārṇave .. 43 ..
15.5.d:
चक्रतीर्थमिति ख्यातं तस्मादेतद्भविष्यति ..
ममापि नियतं वासो भविष्यति महार्णवे .. 43 ..
15.5.m: therefore this shall be known as Cakra-tīrtha. / And my dwelling too shall be perpetual in the great ocean.

15.5.s:
ye'tra snānaṃ prakurvaṃti prasaṃgenāpi mānavāḥ ..
cakratīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ muktiḥ kare sthitā .. 44 ..
15.5.d:
येऽत्र स्नानं प्रकुर्वंति प्रसंगेनापि मानवाः ..
चक्रतीर्थे द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तेषां मुक्तिः करे स्थिता .. 44 ..
15.5.m: Those men who take a bath here in Cakra-tīrtha, even by chance, / O best of brahmins, liberation rests in their hand.

15.5.s:
bhavato'pi sadā hyatra tiṣṭhadhvaṃ ca dvijarṣabhāḥ ..
vāyubhūtāṃtarikṣasthāḥ sarvakāmasya dāyakāḥ .. 45 ..
15.5.d:
भवतोऽपि सदा ह्यत्र तिष्ठध्वं च द्विजर्षभाः ..
वायुभूतांतरिक्षस्थाः सर्वकामस्य दायकाः .. 45 ..
15.5.m: You two also, O foremost brahmins, dwell here perpetually, / becoming the wind, dwelling in the sky, granting all desires."

15.5.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā hṛṣṭamanasaḥ kṛtvārghyaṃ surapāvanīm ..
avanijya hareḥ pādau mūrdhnā'paścāpyadhārayan .. .. 46 ..
15.5.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा हृष्टमनसः कृत्वार्घ्यं सुरपावनीम् ..
अवनिज्य हरेः पादौ मूर्ध्नाऽपश्चाप्यधारयन् .. .. 46 ..
15.5.m: Prahlāda said: / Having heard that, with joyful minds they made the purifier of gods into arghya, / washed Hari's feet, and bore the water upon their heads.

15.5.s:
prakṣālya sā hareḥ pādau praviṣṭā varuṇālayam ..
tasminmahāpāpaharā gomatī sāgaraṃ gatā .. 47 ..
15.5.d:
प्रक्षाल्य सा हरेः पादौ प्रविष्टा वरुणालयम् ..
तस्मिन्महापापहरा गोमती सागरं गता .. 47 ..
15.5.m: Having washed Hari's feet, she entered the abode of Varuṇa; / destroying great sins, that Gomatī went to the ocean.

15.5.s:
varaṃ dattvā tato viṣṇustatraivāntara dhīyata ..
sanakādyā brahmasutāstasthustatra samāhitāḥ .. 48 ..
15.5.d:
वरं दत्त्वा ततो विष्णुस्तत्रैवान्तर धीयत ..
सनकाद्या ब्रह्मसुतास्तस्थुस्तत्र समाहिताः .. 48 ..
15.5.m: Having granted the boon, Viṣṇu then vanished right there; / Sanaka and the other sons of Brahmā remained there, collected in meditation.

15.5.s:
evaṃ sā gomatī tatra saṃjātā sāgaraṃgamā ..
sarvapāpaharā proktā pūrvagaṃgeti yā śrutā .. .. 49 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmyaṃ sanatkumāratapobalena bhagavatprādurbhāva vṛttāntavarṇanapuraḥsara gomatyutpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 5 ..
15.5.d:
एवं सा गोमती तत्र संजाता सागरंगमा ..
सर्वपापहरा प्रोक्ता पूर्वगंगेति या श्रुता .. .. 49 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्यं सनत्कुमारतपोबलेन भगवत्प्रादुर्भाव वृत्तान्तवर्णनपुरःसर गोमत्युत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चमोऽध्यायः .. 5 ..
15.5.m:
Thus the Gomatī flowed there, going to the ocean; / she who is heard of as the 'Eastern Gaṅgā' is declared to remove all sins.
Thus ends the fifth chapter, titled "Description of the Origin and Greatness of the Gomatī along with the Narrative of the Blessed Lord's Manifestation by the Power of Sanatkumāra's Austerities," in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.6.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sādhusādhu mahābhāga prahlādā surasattama ..
yena naḥ kalimadhye tu darśito bhagavānhariḥ .. 1 ..
15.6.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
साधुसाधु महाभाग प्रह्लादा सुरसत्तम ..
येन नः कलिमध्ये तु दर्शितो भगवान्हरिः .. 1 ..
15.6.m: The seers said: / "Bravo, bravo, O fortunate Prahlāda, best among the Asuras! / By you the Blessed Lord Hari was revealed to us in the midst of the Kali age.

15.6.s:
tvanmukhakṣīrasiṃdhūtthā katheyamamṛtopamā ..
karṇābhyāṃ pibatāṃ tṛptirmunīnāṃ na prajāyate ..
kathayasva mahābāho tīrthayātrāṃ suvistarām .. 2 .
15.6.d:
त्वन्मुखक्षीरसिंधूत्था कथेयममृतोपमा ..
कर्णाभ्यां पिबतां तृप्तिर्मुनीनां न प्रजायते ..
कथयस्व महाबाहो तीर्थयात्रां सुविस्तराम् .. 2 .
15.6.m: This story, rising like nectar from the milk-ocean of your mouth— / the sages do not reach satiety when drinking it with their ears. / Recount in full detail, O mighty-armed one, the pilgrimage to the sacred ford!

15.6.s:
asmābhistatra gaṃtavyaṃ vahate yatra gomatī ..
tiṣṭhate yatra bhagavāṃścakratīrthāvalokakaḥ .. ..3 ..
15.6.d:
अस्माभिस्तत्र गंतव्यं वहते यत्र गोमती ..
तिष्ठते यत्र भगवांश्चक्रतीर्थावलोककः .. ..3 ..
15.6.m: We must go there, where the Gomatī flows, / where the Blessed Lord stands looking upon the Cakra-tīrtha.

15.6.s:
bhavābdhau patitāṃstāta uddharasva bhavārṇavāt ..
tīrthayātrāvidhānaṃ ca kathayasva mahāmate .. 4 ..
15.6.d:
भवाब्धौ पतितांस्तात उद्धरस्व भवार्णवात् ..
तीर्थयात्राविधानं च कथयस्व महामते .. 4 ..
15.6.m: Deliver those fallen into the ocean of worldly existence from the ocean of worldly existence, O dear one! / And recount, O high-minded one, the procedure for the pilgrimage to the sacred ford."

15.6.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
gatvā tu gomatītīre praṇameddaṃḍavacca tām ..
prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān .. 5 ..
15.6.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
गत्वा तु गोमतीतीरे प्रणमेद्दंडवच्च ताम् ..
प्रक्षाल्य पाणिपादौ च कृत्वा च करयोः कुशान् .. 5 ..
15.6.m: Prahlāda said: / Having gone to the bank of the Gomatī, one should bow down to her like a staff; / having washed hands and feet, and holding kuśa grasses in one's hands,

15.6.s:
gṛhītvā tu phalaṃ śubhramakṣataiśca samanvitam ..
prāṅmukhaḥ prayato bhūtvā dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 6 ..
15.6.d:
गृहीत्वा तु फलं शुभ्रमक्षतैश्च समन्वितम् ..
प्राङ्मुखः प्रयतो भूत्वा दद्यादर्घ्यं विधानतः .. 6 ..
15.6.m: taking an auspicious fruit along with unbroken grains of rice, / facing eastward and being purified, one should offer the arghya according to rule:

15.6.s:
brahmalokātsamāyāte vasiṣṭhatanaye śubhe ..
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ dadāmyarghyaṃ tu gomati .. 7 ..
15.6.d:
ब्रह्मलोकात्समायाते वसिष्ठतनये शुभे ..
सर्वपापविशुद्ध्यर्थं ददाम्यर्घ्यं तु गोमति .. 7 ..
15.6.m: "O auspicious one arrived from the world of Brahmā, O daughter of Vasiṣṭha! / I offer this arghya for the purification of all sins, O Gomatī!

15.6.s:
vasiṣṭhatanaye devi suravaṃdye yaśasvini ..
trailokyavaṃdite devi pāpaṃ me hara gomati .. 8 ..
15.6.d:
वसिष्ठतनये देवि सुरवंद्ये यशस्विनि ..
त्रैलोक्यवंदिते देवि पापं मे हर गोमति .. 8 ..
15.6.m: O daughter of Vasiṣṭha, O goddess praised by the gods, O renowned one, / O goddess praised by the three worlds, remove my sin, O Gomatī!"

15.6.s:
ityuccāryya dvijaśreṣṭhā mṛdamālabhya pāṇinā ..
viṣṇuṃ saṃsmṛtya manasā maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 9 ..
15.6.d:
इत्युच्चार्य्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा मृदमालभ्य पाणिना ..
विष्णुं संस्मृत्य मनसा मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 9 ..
15.6.m: Having spoken thus, O best of brahmins, smearing clay with one's hand, / meditating on Viṣṇu in one's mind, one should recite this mantra:

15.6.s:
aśvakrāṃte rathakrāṃte viṣṇukrāṃte vasuṃdhare ..
uddhṛtā'si varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā .. 7.4.6.10 ..
15.6.d:
अश्वक्रांते रथक्रांते विष्णुक्रांते वसुंधरे ..
उद्धृताऽसि वराहेण कृष्णेन शतबाहुना .. 7.4.6.10 ..
15.6.m: "O earth, traversed by horses, traversed by chariots, traversed by Viṣṇu! / You were lifted up by the Boar, by the hundred-armed Kṛṣṇa.

15.6.s:
mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā pūrvasaṃcitam ..
tvayā hatena pāpena pūtaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ bhavet ..11..
15.6.d:
मृत्तिके हर मे पापं यन्मया पूर्वसंचितम् ..
त्वया हतेन पापेन पूतः संवत्सरं भवेत् ..11..
15.6.m: O clay, remove my sin that was accumulated previously by me! / With sin struck down by you, may I become purified for a full year."

15.6.s:
ityevaṃ mṛdamālipya snānaṃ kuryyādyathāvidhi ..
āpo asmāniti snātvā śṛṇudhvaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet .. 12 ..
15.6.d:
इत्येवं मृदमालिप्य स्नानं कुर्य्याद्यथाविधि ..
आपो अस्मानिति स्नात्वा शृणुध्वं यत्फलं लभेत् .. 12 ..
15.6.m: Having thus smeared oneself with clay, one should perform the ritual ablution according to rule. / Having bathed with the verse beginning 'āpo asmān...', hear what fruit one obtains:

15.6.s:
kurukṣetre ca yatpuṇyaṃ rāhugraste divākare ..
snānamātreṇa tatpuṇyaṃ gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 13 ..
15.6.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रे च यत्पुण्यं राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे ..
स्नानमात्रेण तत्पुण्यं गोमत्यां कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 13 ..
15.6.m: Whatever merit is found at Kurukṣetra when the sun is seized by Rāhu, / that very merit is attained by merely taking a bath in the Gomatī in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.6.s:
bhaktyā snātvā tu tatraivaṃ kuryātkarma yathoditam..
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥ .. 14 ..
15.6.d:
भक्त्या स्नात्वा तु तत्रैवं कुर्यात्कर्म यथोदितम्..
देवान्पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च तर्पयेद्भावसंयुतः .. 14 ..
15.6.m: Having bathed there with devotion in this manner, one should perform the prescribed rites; / filled with pious feeling, one should offer water to the gods, the ancestors, and men.

15.6.s:
ye ca rauravasaṃsthā hi ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ ..
gomatīnīradānena muktiṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
15.6.d:
ये च रौरवसंस्था हि ये च कीटत्वमागताः ..
गोमतीनीरदानेन मुक्तिं यांति न संशयः .. 15 ..
15.6.m: Those who abide in Raurava hell, and those who have become worms— / by the offering of water from the Gomatī they attain liberation, there is no doubt.

15.6.s:
vināpyakṣatadarbhairvā vinā bhāvanayā tathā ..
vārimātreṇa gomatyāṃ gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet .. 16 ..
15.6.d:
विनाप्यक्षतदर्भैर्वा विना भावनया तथा ..
वारिमात्रेण गोमत्यां गयाश्राद्धफलं लभेत् .. 16 ..
15.6.m: Even without unbroken rice or darbha grass, and even without meditation, / merely with the water of the Gomatī one obtains the fruit of a śrāddha performed at Gayā.

15.6.s:
tataśca viprānāhūya vedajñāṃstīrasaṃśrayān ..
viśvedevādi saṃpūjya pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret .. 17 ..
15.6.d:
ततश्च विप्रानाहूय वेदज्ञांस्तीरसंश्रयान् ..
विश्वेदेवादि संपूज्य पितॄणां श्राद्धमाचरेत् .. 17 ..
15.6.m: Then, inviting brahmins who know the Vedas and reside on the bank, / having worshiped the Viśvedevas and others, one should perform the ancestral śrāddha.

15.6.s:
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ..
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 18 ..
15.6.d:
श्रद्धया परया युक्तः श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानतः ..
दक्षिणां च ततो दद्यात्सुवर्णं रजतं तथा .. 18 ..
15.6.m: Endowed with supreme faith, having performed the śrāddha according to rule, / one should then give a sacrificial fee: gold and silver,

15.6.s:
suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ rājatakhurabhūṣitām ..
ratnapucchāṃ vastrayutāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ savatsakām .. 29 ..
dadyādvipraṃ samabhyarcya vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
saptadhānyayutāṃ dadyādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 7.4.6.20 ..
āsīmāṃtaṃ visṛjyaitānbrāhmaṇānniyateṃdriyaḥ ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ .. 21 ..
gomatī gomayasnānaṃ godānaṃ gopicandanam ..
darśanaṃ gopināthasya gakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ .. 22 ..
tasmāccaiva prakartavyaṃ godānaṃ gomatītaṭe ..
evaṃ kṛtvā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ .. 23 ..
ye gatā narakaṃ ghoraṃ ye ca pretatvamāgatāḥ ..
pūrvakarmavipākena sthāvaratvaṃ gatāśca ye .. 24 ..
pitṛpakṣe ca ye kecinmātṛpakṣe kulodbhavāḥ ..
sarve te muktimāyāṃti gomatyā darśanātkalau .. 25 ..
15.6.d:
सुवर्णशृंगसहितां राजतखुरभूषिताम् ..
रत्नपुच्छां वस्त्रयुतां ताम्रपृष्ठां सवत्सकाम् .. 29 ..
दद्याद्विप्रं समभ्यर्च्य वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः ..
सप्तधान्ययुतां दद्याद्विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति .. 7.4.6.20 ..
आसीमांतं विसृज्यैतान्ब्राह्मणान्नियतेंद्रियः ..
दीनांधकृपणेभ्यश्च दानं दद्यात्स्वशक्तितः .. 21 ..
गोमती गोमयस्नानं गोदानं गोपिचन्दनम् ..
दर्शनं गोपिनाथस्य गकाराः पंच दुर्लभाः .. 22 ..
तस्माच्चैव प्रकर्तव्यं गोदानं गोमतीतटे ..
एवं कृत्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः .. 23 ..
ये गता नरकं घोरं ये च प्रेतत्वमागताः ..
पूर्वकर्मविपाकेन स्थावरत्वं गताश्च ये .. 24 ..
पितृपक्षे च ये केचिन्मातृपक्षे कुलोद्भवाः ..
सर्वे ते मुक्तिमायांति गोमत्या दर्शनात्कलौ .. 25 ..
15.6.m:
and [a cow] endowed with golden horns, adorned with silver hooves, / with a tail of jewels, accompanied by a cloth, with a copper back, along with her calf.
One should give it after worshiping the brahmin with garments and ornaments; / one should give it along with the seven grains, saying: 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me.'
Having escorted these brahmins to the boundary, self-controlled in senses, / one should give gifts according to one's capacity to the poor, the blind, and the destitute.
The Gomatī, bathing in cow dung, the gift of a cow, gopīcandana clay, / and the darśana of Gopīnātha—these five things starting with the letter 'ga' are rare to obtain.
Therefore, the gift of a cow should indeed be made on the bank of the Gomatī; / having done so, O best of the twice-born, a man accomplishes all his goals.
Those who have gone to terrible hell, those who have become spirits of the dead, / and those who have attained the state of stationary objects due to the ripening of past deeds,
and whoever has been born into one's family on the father's or the mother's side— / all of them attain liberation in the Kali age by the darśana of the Gomatī.

15.6.s:
kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ narairyaistu gomatyāṃ bhūsurottamāḥ ..
hayamedhasya yajñasya phalamāyāṃtyasaṃśayam .. 26 ..
gaṃgāsnānena yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge parikīrttitam ..
tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti gomatyāṃ śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ .. 27 ..
viṣṇulokaṃ hi gacchaṃti pitarastatkulodbhavāḥ ..
anekajanmasāhasraṃ pāpaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ .. 28 ..
vācā ca yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā tathā..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti gomatīdarśanena hi..29..
15.6.d:
कृतं श्राद्धं नरैर्यैस्तु गोमत्यां भूसुरोत्तमाः ..
हयमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलमायांत्यसंशयम् .. 26 ..
गंगास्नानेन यत्पुण्यं प्रयागे परिकीर्त्तितम् ..
तत्पुण्यं समवाप्नोति गोमत्यां श्राद्धकृन्नरः .. 27 ..
विष्णुलोकं हि गच्छंति पितरस्तत्कुलोद्भवाः ..
अनेकजन्मसाहस्रं पापं याति न संशयः .. 28 ..
वाचा च यत्कृतं पापं कर्मणा मनसा तथा..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति गोमतीदर्शनेन हि..29..
15.6.m:
The śrāddha performed by men at the Gomatī, O best of brahmins, / yields without doubt the fruit of the horse sacrifice.
Whatever merit is proclaimed by ritual ablution in the Gaṅgā at Prayāga, / that same merit a man attains who performs a śrāddha at the Gomatī.
The ancestors born of his family indeed go to the world of Viṣṇu; / the sin of many thousands of births departs, of this there is no doubt.
Whatever sin has been committed by speech, action, or thought, / all of that vanishes through the darśana of the Gomatī.

15.6.s:
yo naraḥ kārttike snānaṃ gomatyāṃ kurute dvijāḥ..
prasanno bhagavāṃstasya lakṣmyā saha na saṃśayaḥ..7.4.6.30..
15.6.d:
यो नरः कार्त्तिके स्नानं गोमत्यां कुरुते द्विजाः..
प्रसन्नो भगवांस्तस्य लक्ष्म्या सह न संशयः..7.4.6.30..
15.6.m: The person who takes a ritual ablution in the Gomatī during the month of Kārttika, O twice-born, / the Lord, along with Lakṣmī, is pleased with him without doubt.

15.6.s:
pratyahaṃ hutam̐ bhoktāraṃ tarpayetsusamāhitaḥ..
pratyahaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ deyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dvijātaye..31..
15.6.d:
प्रत्यहं हुतम्̐ भोक्तारं तर्पयेत्सुसमाहितः..
प्रत्यहं षड्रसं देयं भोजनं च द्विजातये..31..
15.6.m: Every day, with a concentrated mind, he should satisfy the fire, the consumer of offerings; / every day, food of the six tastes should be given to a twice-born.

15.6.s:
pūjayetkṛṣṇadevaṃ ca pratyahaṃ bhaktitatparaḥ ..
yena kenāpi viprendrāḥ sthātavyaṃ niyamena tu ..32..
15.6.d:
पूजयेत्कृष्णदेवं च प्रत्यहं भक्तितत्परः ..
येन केनापि विप्रेन्द्राः स्थातव्यं नियमेन तु ..32..
15.6.m: And devoted to devotion, he should worship Lord Kṛṣṇa every day; / O foremost of brahmins, he must remain steadfast in his observance by whatever means.

15.6.s:
brāhmaṇānujñayā tatra gṛhṇīyānniyamānnaraḥ ..
saṃpūrṇe kārttike māsi saṃprāpte bodhavāsare .. 33 ..
15.6.d:
ब्राह्मणानुज्ञया तत्र गृह्णीयान्नियमान्नरः ..
संपूर्णे कार्त्तिके मासि संप्राप्ते बोधवासरे .. 33 ..
15.6.m: With the permission of brahmins, a person should undertake the vows there; / when the month of Kārttika is complete, upon the arrival of the awakening day [Prabodhinī Ekādaśī],

15.6.s:
paṃcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpayettīrthavāriṇā ..
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṃkumonmiśraṃ mṛganābhisamanvitam ..
vilepayecca deveśaṃ bhaktyā dāmodaraṃ harim .. 34 ..
15.6.d:
पंचामृतेन देवेशं स्नापयेत्तीर्थवारिणा ..
श्रीखण्डं कुंकुमोन्मिश्रं मृगनाभिसमन्वितम् ..
विलेपयेच्च देवेशं भक्त्या दामोदरं हरिम् .. 34 ..
15.6.m: he should bathe the Lord of gods with the five nectars and water from the sacred ford; / with devotion he should anoint the Lord of gods, Dāmodara Hari, / with sandalwood paste mixed with saffron and containing musk.

15.6.s:
kusumairvārisaṃbhūtaistulasyā karavīrakaiḥ ..
taddeśasaṃbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam .. 35 ..
15.6.d:
कुसुमैर्वारिसंभूतैस्तुलस्या करवीरकैः ..
तद्देशसंभवैः पुष्पैः पूजयेद्गरुडध्वजम् .. 35 ..
15.6.m: With water-born flowers, with tulasī, with oleanders, / and with blossoms produced in that region, he should worship the Garuḍa-bannered Lord.

15.6.s:
naivedyaṃ ruciraṃ dadyādvi ṣṇurme prīyatāmiti ..
gītavādyādinṛtyena tathā pustakavācanaiḥ .. 36 ..
15.6.d:
नैवेद्यं रुचिरं दद्याद्वि ष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति ..
गीतवाद्यादिनृत्येन तथा पुस्तकवाचनैः .. 36 ..
15.6.m: Saying, 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me,' he should offer delicious food offerings, / along with singing, instrumental music, dancing, and the recitation of sacred books.

15.6.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryyaṃ stotrairnānāvidhairapi ..
āhūya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā bhojayecca svaśaktitaḥ .. 37 ..
15.6.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कार्य्यं स्तोत्रैर्नानाविधैरपि ..
आहूय ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या भोजयेच्च स्वशक्तितः .. 37 ..
15.6.m: A night-vigil should be kept with various kinds of hymns; / having summoned brahmins with devotion, he should feed them according to his capacity.

15.6.s:
tato rathasthitaṃ devaṃ pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam ..
kārttikāṃte ca vipreṃdrā gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 38 ..
15.6.d:
ततो रथस्थितं देवं पूजयेद्गरुडध्वजम् ..
कार्त्तिकांते च विप्रेंद्रा गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 38 ..
15.6.m: Then he should worship the Garuḍa-bannered Lord standing upon a chariot; / and at the end of Kārttika, O foremost of brahmins, at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean,

15.6.s:
snātvā pitṝṃśca saṃtarpya pūjayecca janārddanam ..
suvastrairbhūṣaṇaiścāpi samabhyarcya ramāpatim ..
anujñayā tu viprāṇāṃ vrataṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ nayet .. 39 ..
15.6.d:
स्नात्वा पितॄंश्च संतर्प्य पूजयेच्च जनार्द्दनम् ..
सुवस्त्रैर्भूषणैश्चापि समभ्यर्च्य रमापतिम् ..
अनुज्ञया तु विप्राणां व्रतं संपूर्णतां नयेत् .. 39 ..
15.6.m: having taken a ritual ablution, satisfied the ancestors, and worshipped Janārdana, / and having honoured the Lord of Ramā with fine garments and ornaments, / he should bring the vow to completion with the permission of the brahmins.

15.6.s:
evaṃ yaḥ snāti viprendrāḥ kārttike kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ..7.4.6.40..
15.6.d:
एवं यः स्नाति विप्रेन्द्राः कार्त्तिके कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ..7.4.6.40..
15.6.m: Whoever bathes in this manner in Kārttika in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, O foremost of brahmins, / freed from all sins, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

15.6.s:
māghasnānaṃ naro bhaktyā gomatyāṃ kurute tu yaḥ ..
vainateyodaye nityaṃ saṃtuṣṭaḥ saha bhāryayā .. 41 ..
15.6.d:
माघस्नानं नरो भक्त्या गोमत्यां कुरुते तु यः ..
वैनतेयोदये नित्यं संतुष्टः सह भार्यया .. 41 ..
15.6.m: The man who with devotion takes a ritual ablution in the Gomatī during the month of Māgha, / ever contented, together with his wife, at sunrise,

15.6.s:
tilā hiraṇyasahitā deyā brāhmaṇasattame ..
modakā guḍasaṃmiśrāḥ pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇānvitāḥ .. 42 ..
15.6.d:
तिला हिरण्यसहिता देया ब्राह्मणसत्तमे ..
मोदका गुडसंमिश्राः प्रत्यहं दक्षिणान्विताः .. 42 ..
15.6.m: sesame seeds accompanied by gold should be given to an excellent brahmin, / and sweetmeat balls mixed with molasses, every day accompanied by a priestly gift.

15.6.s:
tilairājyāplutairhomaḥ karttavyaḥ pratyahaṃ naraiḥ ..
homārthaṃ sevayedvahniṃ na śītārthaṃ kadācana ..43..
15.6.d:
तिलैराज्याप्लुतैर्होमः कर्त्तव्यः प्रत्यहं नरैः ..
होमार्थं सेवयेद्वह्निं न शीतार्थं कदाचन ..43..
15.6.m: Oblations should be performed daily by men with sesame seeds steeped in ghee; / one should approach the fire for the sake of sacrifice, never merely for the sake of warmth.

15.6.s:
gomatyāṃ snāti yo bhaktyā māghaṃ mādhavavallabham ..
samāptau raktavastrāṇi kañcukoṣṇīṣameva ca .. 44 ..
15.6.d:
गोमत्यां स्नाति यो भक्त्या माघं माधववल्लभम् ..
समाप्तौ रक्तवस्त्राणि कञ्चुकोष्णीषमेव च .. 44 ..
15.6.m: He who with devotion bathes in the Gomatī throughout Māgha, which is dear to Mādhava, / upon its completion, red garments, a jacket, and a turban,

15.6.s:
dadyādupānahau bhaktyā kuṃkumaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
kambalaṃ tailapakvaṃ ca viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 45 ..
15.6.d:
दद्यादुपानहौ भक्त्या कुंकुमं च विशेषतः ..
कम्बलं तैलपक्वं च विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति .. 45 ..
15.6.m: shoes, and especially saffron, he should bestow with devotion, / as well as a blanket and oil-cooked food, saying, 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me.'

15.6.s:
svāmikāryyamṛtānāṃ ca saṃgrāme śastrasaṃkule ..
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca mṛtānāṃ yā gatiḥ smṛtā .. 46 ..
15.6.d:
स्वामिकार्य्यमृतानां च संग्रामे शस्त्रसंकुले ..
गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे च मृतानां या गतिः स्मृता .. 46 ..
15.6.m: Whatever destiny is taught for those who die in the master's service in a battle thick with weapons, / and for those who die for the sake of cows or for the sake of brahmins,

15.6.s:
māghasnāne ca sā proktā gomatyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya sarva tīrthaphalaṃ tathā .. 47 ..
15.6.d:
माघस्नाने च सा प्रोक्ता गोमत्यां नात्र संशयः ..
सर्वदानफलं तस्य सर्व तीर्थफलं तथा .. 47 ..
15.6.m: that same destiny is declared for one who bathes in the Gomatī in Māgha; there is no doubt about this; / his is the fruit of all gifts, and likewise the fruit of all sacred fords.

15.6.s:
māghasnānānnaro yāti viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti samabhyarcya janārddanam .. 48..
15.6.d:
माघस्नानान्नरो याति विष्णुलोकं सनातनम् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति समभ्यर्च्य जनार्द्दनम् .. 48..
15.6.m: Through the Māgha ritual ablution, a man goes to the eternal world of Viṣṇu; / having worshipped Janārdana, he obtains all desires.

15.6.s:
māghaṃ yaḥ kṣapate sarvaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
brāhmaṇānujñayā viprāḥ sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ vrajet .. 49 ..
15.6.d:
माघं यः क्षपते सर्वं गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
