ब्राह्मणानुज्ञया विप्राः सर्वं संपूर्णतां व्रजेत् .. 49 ..
15.6.m: For one who spends the entire month of Māgha at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / all becomes complete through the permission of brahmins, O brahmins.

15.6.s:
pāpino'pi dvijaśreṣṭhā ye snātā gomatījale ..
yajvināṃ ca gatiṃ yāṃti prasādāccakrapāṇinaḥ .. 7.4.6.50 ..
15.6.d:
पापिनोऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठा ये स्नाता गोमतीजले ..
यज्विनां च गतिं यांति प्रसादाच्चक्रपाणिनः .. 7.4.6.50 ..
15.6.m: Even sinners, O best of the twice-born, who have bathed in the waters of the Gomatī, / attain the destiny of sacrificers by the grace of the Discus-wielder.

15.6.s:
brahmarudrapadādūrdhvaṃ yatpadaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ ..
snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ tatproktaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. 51 ..
15.6.d:
ब्रह्मरुद्रपदादूर्ध्वं यत्पदं चक्रपाणिनः ..
स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां तत्प्रोक्तं कृष्णसंनिधौ .. 51 ..
15.6.m: That abode of the Discus-wielder which is higher than the abode of Brahmā and Rudra / is said to be attained merely by bathing in the Gomatī in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.6.s:
mitradrohe ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ gurughātini ..
tatpāpaṃ samavāpnoti yātrābhaṃgaṃ karoti yaḥ ..52..
15.6.d:
मित्रद्रोहे च यत्पापं यत्पापं गुरुघातिनि ..
तत्पापं समवाप्नोति यात्राभंगं करोति यः ..52..
15.6.m: Whatever sin is incurred in betraying a friend, whatever sin in slaying a guru, / that sin he incurs who breaks or disrupts a pilgrimage.

15.6.s:
brahmasvahāriṇaḥ pāpāstathā devasvahāriṇaḥ ..
snānamātreṇa śuddhyaṃti gomatyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 53 ..
15.6.d:
ब्रह्मस्वहारिणः पापास्तथा देवस्वहारिणः ..
स्नानमात्रेण शुद्ध्यंति गोमत्यां नात्र संशयः .. 53 ..
15.6.m: Those who steal the property of brahmins and those sinners who steal the property of gods / are purified merely by bathing in the Gomatī; there is no doubt of this.

15.6.s:
bhītā'bhayapradānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ ..
tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti gomatyāṃ snānamātrataḥ .. 54 ..
15.6.d:
भीताऽभयप्रदानेन यत्पुण्यं लभते नरः ..
तत्पुण्यं समवाप्नोति गोमत्यां स्नानमात्रतः .. 54 ..
15.6.m: Whatever merit a man obtains by granting fearlessness to the frightened, / that same merit he obtains merely by taking a ritual ablution in the Gomatī.

15.6.s:
bhītābhaya pradānena putrāniṣṭānna saṃśayaḥ ..
dhanakāmastu vipulaṃ labhate dhanamūrjitam.. 55 ..
15.6.d:
भीताभय प्रदानेन पुत्रानिष्टान्न संशयः ..
धनकामस्तु विपुलं लभते धनमूर्जितम्.. 55 ..
15.6.m: By granting fearlessness to the frightened, one attains desired sons, without doubt; / and one desiring wealth obtains abundant, mighty wealth.

15.6.s:
prāpnuyādīpsitānkāmāngomatīnīrasaṃgame ..
kṛtakṛtyo bhavedviprā ṛṇānmucyeta paitṛkāt .. 56 ..
15.6.d:
प्राप्नुयादीप्सितान्कामान्गोमतीनीरसंगमे ..
कृतकृत्यो भवेद्विप्रा ऋणान्मुच्येत पैतृकात् .. 56 ..
15.6.m: At the confluence of the Gomatī's waters, he would attain his desired wishes; / he would accomplish his goals, O brahmins, and be freed from his ancestral debt.

15.6.s:
manasā vacasā caiva karmaṇā yadupārjitam ..
tatsarvaṃ naśyate pāpaṃ gomatīnīrasaṃgamāt .. 57 ..
15.6.d:
मनसा वचसा चैव कर्मणा यदुपार्जितम् ..
तत्सर्वं नश्यते पापं गोमतीनीरसंगमात् .. 57 ..
15.6.m: Whatever sin has been accumulated by mind, by speech, and by action, / all of that is destroyed by contact with the waters of the Gomatī.

15.6.s:
pītāṃbaradharo bhūtvā tathā garuḍavāhanaḥ ..
vanamālī caturbāhurdivyagandhānulepanaḥ ..
yāti viṣṇvālayaṃ viprā apunarbhavalakṣaṇam .. 58 ..
15.6.d:
पीतांबरधरो भूत्वा तथा गरुडवाहनः ..
वनमाली चतुर्बाहुर्दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः ..
याति विष्ण्वालयं विप्रा अपुनर्भवलक्षणम् .. 58 ..
15.6.m: Wearing yellow garments, mounted upon Garuḍa, / wearing a forest garland, four-armed, anointed with divine perfume, / he goes, O brahmins, to the abode of Viṣṇu, marked by freedom from rebirth.

15.6.s:
gomatīsnānamātreṇa mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇuṃ sanātanam .. 59 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatyudadhisaṃgame snānadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ .. 6 ..
15.6.d:
गोमतीस्नानमात्रेण मानवो नात्र संशयः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो याति विष्णुं सनातनम् .. 59 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमत्युदधिसंगमे स्नानदानादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः .. 6 ..
15.6.m:
Merely by a ritual ablution in the Gomatī, a mortal, beyond any doubt, / freed from all sins, goes to the eternal Viṣṇu.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Greatness of Ablution, Gifting, and Other Rites at the Confluence of the Gomatī and the Ocean', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.7.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā rathāṃgākhyaṃ mahodadhim ..
cakrāṃkā yatra pāṣāṇā dṛśyaṃte muktidāyakāḥ .. 1 ..
15.7.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा रथांगाख्यं महोदधिम् ..
चक्रांका यत्र पाषाणा दृश्यंते मुक्तिदायकाः .. 1 ..
15.7.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Then, O best of the twice-born, one should proceed to the great ocean named Rathāṅga, / where stones marked with discuses are seen, bestowing liberation,

15.7.s:
yaiḥ pūjyate jagannāthaḥ pratyahaṃ bhāva saṃyutaiḥ ..
sadā netrairanimiṣairvīkṣyate ca janārdanaḥ .. 2 ..
15.7.d:
यैः पूज्यते जगन्नाथः प्रत्यहं भाव संयुतैः ..
सदा नेत्रैरनिमिषैर्वीक्ष्यते च जनार्दनः .. 2 ..
15.7.m: by which the Lord of the world is worshipped every day by those endowed with devotion, / and Janārdana is ever beheld with unblinking eyes.

15.7.s:
yacca sākṣādbhagavatā dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena dṛṣṭitaḥ ..
tattīrthaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ cakrākhyaṃ paramaṃ hareḥ .. 3 ..
15.7.d:
यच्च साक्षाद्भगवता दृष्टं कृष्णेन दृष्टितः ..
तत्तीर्थं सर्वपापघ्नं चक्राख्यं परमं हरेः .. 3 ..
15.7.m: And that sacred ford which was beheld directly by Lord Kṛṣṇa with his own gaze, / is Hari's supreme sacred ford named Cakra, destroying all sins,

15.7.s:
yasya prasiddhiḥ paramā trailokye sacarācare ..
prayāgādadhikaṃ yacca muktidaṃ hyasti pāvanam .. 4 ..
15.7.d:
यस्य प्रसिद्धिः परमा त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
प्रयागादधिकं यच्च मुक्तिदं ह्यस्ति पावनम् .. 4 ..
15.7.m: whose supreme fame is spread through the three worlds, both moving and unmoving, / and which is greater than Prayāga, purifying and bestowing liberation.

15.7.s:
surairapi prapūjyaṃte yatrāṃgāni śarīriṇām ..
aṃkitāni ca cakreṇa ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
15.7.d:
सुरैरपि प्रपूज्यंते यत्रांगानि शरीरिणाम् ..
अंकितानि च चक्रेण षण्मासान्नात्र संशयः .. 5 ..
15.7.m: Where even the limbs of embodied beings marked by the discus / are worshipped by the gods within six months; of this there is no doubt.

15.7.s:
yaddṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpātprasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ ..
tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ pravaraṃ smṛtam.. .. 6 ..
15.7.d:
यद्दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते पापात्प्रसंगेनापि मानवः ..
तत्तीर्थं सर्वतीर्थानां पावनं प्रवरं स्मृतम्.. .. 6 ..
15.7.m: Having seen which a man is freed from sin even by chance, / that sacred ford is considered the most purifying and supreme among all sacred fords.

15.7.s:
tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prakṣālya caraṇau mudā ..
karau cāsyaṃ caiva punaḥ praṇameddaṃḍavatpunaḥ .. 7 ..
15.7.d:
तत्र गत्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ मुदा ..
करौ चास्यं चैव पुनः प्रणमेद्दंडवत्पुनः .. 7 ..
15.7.m: Going there, O best of the twice-born, having washed feet with joy, / as well as hands and face, one should bow down prostrate like a staff again.

15.7.s:
praṇipatya gṛhītvārghyaṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitam ..
sapuṣpākṣatagaṃdhaiśca phalahemasucaṃdanaiḥ .. 8 ..
15.7.d:
प्रणिपत्य गृहीत्वार्घ्यं पंचरत्नसमन्वितम् ..
सपुष्पाक्षतगंधैश्च फलहेमसुचंदनैः .. 8 ..
15.7.m: Having bowed down and taken an offering of water accompanied by the five gems, / along with flowers, unbroken grains, perfumes, fruits, gold, and fine sandalwood,

15.7.s:
saṃpannamarghyamādāya maṃtrametamudīrayet ..
pratyaṅmukhaḥ suniyataḥ saṃmukho vā mahodadheḥ ..9..
15.7.d:
संपन्नमर्घ्यमादाय मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ..
प्रत्यङ्मुखः सुनियतः संमुखो वा महोदधेः ..9..
15.7.m: having taken the prepared offering, one should recite this mantra, / facing west, well-restrained, or facing the great ocean:

15.7.s:
oṃ namo viṣṇu rūpāya viṣṇucakrāya te namaḥ ..
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmaprado bhava .. 7.4.7.10 ..
15.7.d:
ओं नमो विष्णु रूपाय विष्णुचक्राय ते नमः ..
गृहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं सर्वकामप्रदो भव .. 7.4.7.10 ..
15.7.m: “Om, homage to you whose form is Viṣṇu, to the discus of Viṣṇu homage! / Accept the offering given by me, and grant all desires!”

15.7.s:
agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca rudro retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ ..
etadbruvanvāḍavāḥ satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām ..11..
15.7.d:
अग्निश्च तेजो मृडया च रुद्रो रेतोधा विष्णुरमृतस्य नाभिः ..
एतद्ब्रुवन्वाडवाः सत्यवाक्यं ततोऽवगाहेत पतिं नदीनाम् ..11..
15.7.m: “Agni is splendor, and Rudra brings joy; Viṣṇu, who implants the seed, is the navel of immortality.” / Uttering this true statement, O brahmins, one should then plunge into the lord of rivers [the ocean].

15.7.s:
mṛdamālabhya sajalāṃ viprā devakaracyutām ..
dhārayitvā tu śirasā snānaṃ kuryyādyathāvidhi .. 12 ..
15.7.d:
मृदमालभ्य सजलां विप्रा देवकरच्युताम् ..
धारयित्वा तु शिरसा स्नानं कुर्य्याद्यथाविधि .. 12 ..
15.7.m: Taking wet clay fallen from the divine hand, O brahmins, / and placing it upon one's head, one should perform the ritual ablution according to rule.

15.7.s:
tarpayecca pitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathākramam ..
tarpayitvā havirdravyaṃ prokṣayitvā ca bhaktitaḥ .. 13 ..
15.7.d:
तर्पयेच्च पितॄन्देवान्मनुष्यांश्च यथाक्रमम् ..
तर्पयित्वा हविर्द्रव्यं प्रोक्षयित्वा च भक्तितः .. 13 ..
15.7.m: And one should offer water-libations to the ancestors, gods, and men in due order; / having offered water-libations, and having sprinkled the sacrificial substance with devotion,

15.7.s:
aśvamedhasahasreṇa samyagyaṣṭena yatphalam ..
snānamātreṇa tatproktaṃ cakratīrthe dvijottamāḥ .. 14 ..
15.7.d:
अश्वमेधसहस्रेण सम्यग्यष्टेन यत्फलम् ..
स्नानमात्रेण तत्प्रोक्तं चक्रतीर्थे द्विजोत्तमाः .. 14 ..
15.7.m: The fruit that is attained by properly sacrificing a thousand horse-sacrifices, / that is said [to be obtained] merely by a ritual ablution at Cakratīrtha, O best of the twice-born.

15.7.s:
prayāge yatphalaṃ proktaṃ māghyāṃ mādhavapūjane ..
snānamātreṇa tatproktaṃ cakra tīrthe dvijottamāḥ .. 15 ..
15.7.d:
प्रयागे यत्फलं प्रोक्तं माघ्यां माधवपूजने ..
स्नानमात्रेण तत्प्रोक्तं चक्र तीर्थे द्विजोत्तमाः .. 15 ..
15.7.m: The fruit that is proclaimed at Prayāga for the worship of Mādhava on the full moon of Māgha, / that is said [to be obtained] merely by a ritual ablution at Cakratīrtha, O best of the twice-born.

15.7.s:
kārayecca tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
viśvedevānsuvarṇena rājatena tathā pitṝn .. 16 ..
15.7.d:
कारयेच्च ततः श्राद्धं पितॄणां श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
विश्वेदेवान्सुवर्णेन राजतेन तथा पितॄन् .. 16 ..
15.7.m: And then, endowed with faith, one should cause a śrāddha to be performed for the ancestors: / [honouring] the Viśvedevas with gold, and likewise the ancestors with silver.

15.7.s:
saṃtarpya bhojanenaiva vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ..
dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ.. 17..
15.7.d:
संतर्प्य भोजनेनैव वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः..
दीनान्धकृपणेभ्यश्च दानं देयं स्वशक्तितः.. 17..
15.7.m: Having satisfied [them] with food, garments, and ornaments, / a gift should be given according to one's means to the poor, the blind, and the destitute.

15.7.s:
cakratīrthe tīrthavare viśeṣāddvijasattamāḥ..
ratnadānaṃ prakurvīta prīṇanārthaṃ jagatpateḥ .. 18 ..
15.7.d:
चक्रतीर्थे तीर्थवरे विशेषाद्द्विजसत्तमाः..
रत्नदानं प्रकुर्वीत प्रीणनार्थं जगत्पतेः .. 18 ..
15.7.m: Especially at Cakratīrtha, the best among sacred fords, O best of the twice-born, / one should give gifts of gems to please the Lord of the Universe.

15.7.s:
gantrīmanaḍuhā yuktāṃ sarvāstaraṇasaṃyutām ..
sopaskarāṃ ca dadyādvai viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti.. 19 ..
15.7.d:
गन्त्रीमनडुहा युक्तां सर्वास्तरणसंयुताम् ..
सोपस्करां च दद्याद्वै विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति.. 19 ..
15.7.m: One should give a cart yoked with oxen, furnished with all coverings, / and accompanied by utensils, [saying,] “May Viṣṇu be pleased with me!”

15.7.s:
suvinītaṃ śīlayutaṃ tathā sopaskaraṃ hayam ..
bhūṣayitvā ca viprāya dadyāddakṣiṇayā saha .. 7.4.7.20 ..
15.7.d:
सुविनीतं शीलयुतं तथा सोपस्करं हयम् ..
भूषयित्वा च विप्राय दद्याद्दक्षिणया सह .. 7.4.7.20 ..
15.7.m: And having adorned a well-trained, well-tempered horse equipped with gear, / one should give it to a brahmin together with a priestly fee.

15.7.s:
evaṃ kṛte dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ..
muktiṃ prayāṃti tasyaiva pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ .. 21 ..
15.7.d:
एवं कृते द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः..
मुक्तिं प्रयांति तस्यैव पितरस्त्रिकुलोद्भवाः .. 21 ..
15.7.m: When this is done, O best of the twice-born, a person becomes one who has accomplished his duty; / his ancestors born of the three families attain liberation.

15.7.s:
pretayoniṃ gatā ye ca ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ ..
pacyaṃte narake ye ca mahārauravasaṃjñake .. 22 ..
15.7.d:
प्रेतयोनिं गता ये च ये च कीटत्वमागताः ..
पच्यंते नरके ये च महारौरवसंज्ञके .. 22 ..
15.7.m: Those who have gone to the state of ghosts, and those who have become worms, / and those who are being cooked in the hell named Mahāraurava—

15.7.s:
te sarve tṛptimāyāṃti cakatīrtha prabhāvataḥ ..
śrāddhe kṛte dvijaśreṣṭhā gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet .. 23 ..
15.7.d:
ते सर्वे तृप्तिमायांति चकतीर्थ प्रभावतः ..
श्राद्धे कृते द्विजश्रेष्ठा गयाश्राद्धफलं लभेत् .. 23 ..
15.7.m: all of them attain satisfaction through the power of Cakratīrtha. / When a śrāddha is performed [here], O best of the twice-born, one obtains the fruit of a śrāddha at Gayā.

15.7.s:
yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ yajvanāṃ yā gatiḥ smṛtā ..
cakratīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ snātvā tāṃ labhate naraḥ .. 24 ..
15.7.d:
या गतिर्मातृभक्तानां यज्वनां या गतिः स्मृता ..
चक्रतीर्थे द्विजश्रेष्ठाः स्नात्वा तां लभते नरः .. 24 ..
15.7.m: Whatever destination is for those devoted to their mothers, whatever destination is remembered for sacrificers, / a person obtains that after bathing at Cakratīrtha, O best of the twice-born.

15.7.s:
śrāddhaṃ praśastaṃ vipreṃdrāḥ saṃprāpte caṃdrasaṃkṣaye ..
sūryagrahe viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetraphalaṃ smṛtam ..
śrāddhe snāne tathā dāne pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe tathā.. 25 ..
15.7.d:
श्राद्धं प्रशस्तं विप्रेंद्राः संप्राप्ते चंद्रसंक्षये ..
सूर्यग्रहे विशेषेण कुरुक्षेत्रफलं स्मृतम् ..
श्राद्धे स्नाने तथा दाने पितॄणां तर्पणे तथा.. 25 ..
15.7.m: A śrāddha is praised, O chiefs of brahmins, when the conjunction of the new moon arrives; / in a solar eclipse especially, it is considered equal in fruit to Kurukṣetra. / In śrāddha, ritual ablution, and gift-giving, as well as in water-libation to the ancestors,

15.7.s: praśastaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā .. 26 ..
15.7.d: प्रशस्तं चक्रतीर्थं च नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा .. 26 ..
15.7.m: Cakratīrtha is praised; no doubt should be entertained on this point.

15.7.s:
sarvadā pāvanaṃ viprāścakratīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
yastu śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta yātrāyāmāgato naraḥ .. 27 ..
15.7.d:
सर्वदा पावनं विप्राश्चक्रतीर्थं न संशयः ..
यस्तु श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत यात्रायामागतो नरः .. 27 ..
15.7.m: Cakratīrtha is always purifying, O brahmins, without doubt. / A person who, having arrived on pilgrimage, performs a śrāddha,

15.7.s:
cakratīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ saṃpūjya madhusūdanam ..
pūjiteṣu dvijeṃdreṣu viṣṇusāṃnidhyamāpnuyāt .. 28 ..
15.7.d:
चक्रतीर्थे द्विजश्रेष्ठाः संपूज्य मधुसूदनम् ..
पूजितेषु द्विजेंद्रेषु विष्णुसांनिध्यमाप्नुयात् .. 28 ..
15.7.m: worshipping Madhusūdana at Cakratīrtha, O best of the twice-born, / when the foremost brahmins are worshipped, obtains the presence of Viṣṇu.

15.7.s:
vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasāṃ samupārjitam ..
snānamātreṇa tatpāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatyudadhisaṃgamatīrasthacakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 7 ..
15.7.d:
वाचा कृतं कर्मकृतं मनसां समुपार्जितम् ..
स्नानमात्रेण तत्पापं नश्यते नात्र संशयः .. 29 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमत्युदधिसंगमतीरस्थचक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः .. 7 ..
15.7.m:
Sin committed by speech, committed by action, or amassed by the mind— / merely by a ritual ablution that sin is destroyed; there is no doubt about this.
Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Cakratīrtha Situated on the Bank of the Confluence of the Gomatī and the Ocean', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section], in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.8.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
mā gacchadhvaṃ suranadīṃ kāliṃdīṃ mā sarasvatīm ..
gacchadhvaṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhā gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 1 ..
15.8.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
मा गच्छध्वं सुरनदीं कालिंदीं मा सरस्वतीम् ..
गच्छध्वं च द्विजश्रेष्ठा गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 1 ..
15.8.m: Prahlāda said: / Do not go to the river of the gods [Gaṅgā], nor to the Kālindī, nor to the Sarasvatī; / go, O best of the twice-born, to the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean,

15.8.s:
prāpyate helayā yatra sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ ..
gomatījalakallolaiḥ krīḍate yatra sāgaraḥ .. 2 ..
15.8.d:
प्राप्यते हेलया यत्र सर्वे कामा न संशयः ..
गोमतीजलकल्लोलैः क्रीडते यत्र सागरः .. 2 ..
15.8.m: where all desires are obtained effortlessly, there is no doubt; / where the ocean plays with the billows of the waters of the Gomatī.

15.8.s:
pāpaghnaṃ gomatītīraṃ prāpyate puṇyavannaraiḥ ..
sāgareṇa ca saṃmiśraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 3 ..
15.8.d:
पापघ्नं गोमतीतीरं प्राप्यते पुण्यवन्नरैः ..
सागरेण च संमिश्रं महापातकनाशनम् .. 3 ..
15.8.m: The sin-destroying bank of the Gomatī is reached by meritorious people; / joined with the ocean, it destroys great sins.

15.8.s:
gomatī saṃgatā yatra sāgareṇa dvijottamāḥ ..
muktidvāraṃ tu tatproktaṃ kalikāle na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
15.8.d:
गोमती संगता यत्र सागरेण द्विजोत्तमाः ..
मुक्तिद्वारं तु तत्प्रोक्तं कलिकाले न संशयः .. 4 ..
15.8.m: Where the Gomatī unites with the ocean, O best of the twice-born, / that is declared to be the door to liberation in the Kali age, without doubt.

15.8.s:
yatpuṇyaṃ labhate tūrṇaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame ..
tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 5 ..
15.8.d:
यत्पुण्यं लभते तूर्णं गंगासागरसंगमे ..
तत्पुण्यं समवाप्नोति गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 5 ..
15.8.m: Whatever merit one quickly obtains at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean, / that same merit one obtains at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.

15.8.s:
namaskṛtya ca toyeśaṃ gomatīṃ ca saridvarām ..
arghyaṃ dadyādvidhānena kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān .. 6 ..
15.8.d:
नमस्कृत्य च तोयेशं गोमतीं च सरिद्वराम् ..
अर्घ्यं दद्याद्विधानेन कृत्वा च करयोः कुशान् .. 6 ..
15.8.m: Having bowed to the lord of waters [ocean] and to the Gomatī, the best of rivers, / one should offer an offering of water according to the rule, placing kuśa grass in both hands.

15.8.s:
maṃtreṇānena vipreṃdrā dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃgatya sadā tattīrthavāsibhiḥ .. 7 ..
15.8.d:
मंत्रेणानेन विप्रेंद्रा दद्यादर्घ्यं विधानतः ..
ब्राह्मणैः सह संगत्य सदा तत्तीर्थवासिभिः .. 7 ..
15.8.m: With this mantra, O chiefs of brahmins, one should offer the offering of water according to rule, / having assembled with the brahmins who always dwell at that sacred ford:

15.8.s:
bhaktyā cārghyaṃ pradāsyāmi devāya paramā tmane ..
trāhi māṃ pāpinaṃ ghoraṃ namaste surarūpiṇe .. 8 ..
15.8.d:
भक्त्या चार्घ्यं प्रदास्यामि देवाय परमा त्मने ..
त्राहि मां पापिनं घोरं नमस्ते सुररूपिणे .. 8 ..
15.8.m: “With devotion I give this offering of water to the god, the Supreme Self. / Protect me, a terrible sinner; homage to you who possess the form of gods!”

15.8.s:
tīrtharāja namastubhyaṃ ratnākara mahārṇava ..
gomatyā saha goviṃda gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te .. 9..
15.8.d:
तीर्थराज नमस्तुभ्यं रत्नाकर महार्णव ..
गोमत्या सह गोविंद गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते .. 9..
15.8.m: “O King of sacred fords, homage to you, the mine of jewels, the great ocean! / Together with the Gomatī, O Govinda, accept this offering of water; homage be to you!”

15.8.s:
dattvā cārghyaṃ śikhāṃ baddhvā saṃsmṛtya jalaśāyinam ..
kuryācca prāṅmukhaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ pratyaṅmukhastathā.. 7.4.8.10..
15.8.d:
दत्त्वा चार्घ्यं शिखां बद्ध्वा संस्मृत्य जलशायिनम् ..
कुर्याच्च प्राङ्मुखः स्नानं ततः प्रत्यङ्मुखस्तथा.. 7.4.8.10..
15.8.m: Having offered the offering of water, tied one's topknot, and remembered the one who reclines upon the waters [Viṣṇu], / one should perform the ritual ablution facing east, and then facing west.

15.8.s:
snātvā ca parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsaṃtarpayettataḥ ..
viśvedevādi saṃpūjya pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret .. 11 ..
15.8.d:
स्नात्वा च परया भक्त्या पितॄन्संतर्पयेत्ततः ..
विश्वेदेवादि संपूज्य पितॄणां श्राद्धमाचरेत् .. 11 ..
15.8.m: Having bathed with supreme devotion, one should then satisfy the ancestors with water-libations; / having worshipped the Viśvedevas and others, one should perform the śrāddha for the ancestors.

15.8.s:
yathoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti ..
viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ suvarṇaṃ viprasattamāḥ .. 12 ..
15.8.d:
यथोक्तां दक्षिणां दद्याद्विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति ..
विशेषतः प्रदातव्यं सुवर्णं विप्रसत्तमाः .. 12 ..
15.8.m: One should give the prescribed priestly fee, [saying,] “May Viṣṇu be pleased with me!” / Gold should especially be given, O best of brahmins,

15.8.s:
daṃpatyorvāsasī caiva kaṃcukoṣṇīṣameva ca ..
lakṣmyā saha jagannātho viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 13 ..
15.8.d:
दंपत्योर्वाससी चैव कंचुकोष्णीषमेव च ..
लक्ष्म्या सह जगन्नाथो विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति .. 13 ..
15.8.m: as well as garments for a husband and wife, a bodice, and a turban, / [saying,] “May Viṣṇu, the Lord of the Universe, together with Lakṣmī, be pleased with me!”

15.8.s:
mahādānāni sarvāṇi gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
saptadvīpapatirbhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 14 ..
15.8.d:
महादानानि सर्वाणि गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
सप्तद्वीपपतिर्भूत्वा विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 14 ..
15.8.m: All the great gifts [given] at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean / cause one to become ruler of the seven continents and be glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

15.8.s:
yastulāpuruṣaṃ dadyādgomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
saptadvīpapatirbhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 15 ..
15.8.d:
यस्तुलापुरुषं दद्याद्गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
सप्तद्वीपपतिर्भूत्वा विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 15 ..
15.8.m: He who gives the gift of a man’s weight [in gold or goods] at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / having become ruler of the seven continents, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

15.8.s:
ātmānaṃ tolayedyastu svarṇena rajatena vā ..
vastrairvā kuṃkumairvāpi phalairvāpi tathā rasaiḥ .. 16 ..
15.8.d:
आत्मानं तोलयेद्यस्तु स्वर्णेन रजतेन वा ..
वस्त्रैर्वा कुंकुमैर्वापि फलैर्वापि तथा रसैः .. 16 ..
15.8.m: He who weighs himself against gold or silver, / or against clothes, saffron, fruits, or juices—

15.8.s:
bhuktvā bhogānsuvipulāṃstathā kāmānmanoharān ..
saṃpūjyamānastridaśairyāti viṣṇvālayaṃ naraḥ .. 17 ..
15.8.d:
भुक्त्वा भोगान्सुविपुलांस्तथा कामान्मनोहरान् ..
संपूज्यमानस्त्रिदशैर्याति विष्ण्वालयं नरः .. 17 ..
15.8.m: After enjoying vast pleasures and charming desires, / that man, worshiped by the thirty gods, goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.

15.8.s:
hiraṇyarūpyadānaṃ ca hyaśvaṃ dhenuṃ tathaiva ca ..
gomatīsaṃgame dattvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 18 ..
15.8.d:
हिरण्यरूप्यदानं च ह्यश्वं धेनुं तथैव च ..
गोमतीसंगमे दत्त्वा सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 18 ..
15.8.m: And by giving gold and silver, a horse, and likewise a cow / at the confluence of the Gomatī, one obtains all desires.

15.8.s:
bhūmidānaṃ ca yo dadyādgomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
snātvā śucirhariṃ smṛtvā tasmāddhanyataro nahi .. 19 ..
15.8.d:
भूमिदानं च यो दद्याद्गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नात्वा शुचिर्हरिं स्मृत्वा तस्माद्धन्यतरो नहि .. 19 ..
15.8.m: And he who gives a gift of land at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / having bathed, being pure, and remembering Hari—none is more fortunate than he.

15.8.s:
kanyādānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādvidyādānamathāpi vā ..
gomatyāḥ saṃgame snātvā yāti brahmapadaṃ naraḥ .. 7.4.8.20 ..
15.8.d:
कन्यादानं च यः कुर्याद्विद्यादानमथापि वा ..
गोमत्याः संगमे स्नात्वा याति ब्रह्मपदं नरः .. 7.4.8.20 ..
15.8.m: And a man who gives away a maiden or indeed gives the gift of knowledge, / having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī, goes to the state of Brahman.

15.8.s:
yo dadyātsvarṇadhenuṃ ca ghṛtadhenuṃ samāhitaḥ ..
brahmāṇḍadānamapi vā tasya puṇyamanaṃtakam .. 21 ..
15.8.d:
यो दद्यात्स्वर्णधेनुं च घृतधेनुं समाहितः ..
ब्रह्माण्डदानमपि वा तस्य पुण्यमनंतकम् .. 21 ..
15.8.m: He who, composed in mind, gives a golden cow, a ghee-cow, / or even the gift of the cosmic egg—his merit is endless.

15.8.s:
tathā lavaṇadhenuṃ ca jaladhenumathāpi vā ..
dattvā yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 22 ..
15.8.d:
तथा लवणधेनुं च जलधेनुमथापि वा ..
दत्त्वा याति परं स्थानं गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 22 ..
15.8.m: Likewise, having given a salt-cow or indeed a water-cow / at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, he goes to the supreme abode.

15.8.s:
yugādiṣu ca sarveṣu gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
snātvā saṃtarpya ca pitṝnakṣayaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 23 ..
15.8.d:
युगादिषु च सर्वेषु गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नात्वा संतर्प्य च पितॄनक्षयं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 23 ..
15.8.m: On all the Yuga-beginnings, at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / having bathed and satiated the ancestors, one attains an imperishable world.

15.8.s:
āṣāḍhyāṃ ca tathā māghyāṃ kārtikyāṃ saṃgame naraḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ pāvakapūjanam ..
kuryāccaiva tathā dānaṃ yadīcchedakṣayaṃ padam .. 24 ..
15.8.d:
आषाढ्यां च तथा माघ्यां कार्तिक्यां संगमे नरः ..
पितॄणां तर्पणं स्नानं श्राद्धं पावकपूजनम् ..
कुर्याच्चैव तथा दानं यदीच्छेदक्षयं पदम् .. 24 ..
15.8.m: And on the full-moon day of Āṣāḍha, likewise of Māgha, and of Kārttika, at the confluence, a man / should perform the satiation of the ancestors, ritual ablution, a śrāddha, worship of fire, / and likewise give gifts, if he desires the imperishable state.

15.8.s:
pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptirgayāśrāddhena vai yathā ..
tadvacchrāddhānmahābhāga gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 25 ..
15.8.d:
पितॄणां चाक्षया तृप्तिर्गयाश्राद्धेन वै यथा ..
तद्वच्छ्राद्धान्महाभाग गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 25 ..
15.8.m: Just as the ancestors find imperishable satisfaction through a śrāddha at Gayā, / so it is through a śrāddha at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, O highly fortunate one.

15.8.s:
kuryyātsnānaṃ tathā dānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ..
pañcakāsu dvijaśreṣṭhāstathā caivāṣṭakāsu ca .. 26 ..
15.8.d:
कुर्य्यात्स्नानं तथा दानं पितॄणां तर्पणं तथा ..
पञ्चकासु द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तथा चैवाष्टकासु च .. 26 ..
15.8.m: O best of brahmins, one should perform ritual ablution, giving of gifts, and satiation of the ancestors / during the Pañcakas and likewise during the Aṣṭakās,

15.8.s:
vaidhṛtau ca vyatīpāte chāyāyāṃ kuṃjarasya ca ..
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca kapilākhyāyāṃ tathā hi dvādaśīṣu ca .. 27 ..
15.8.d:
वैधृतौ च व्यतीपाते छायायां कुंजरस्य च ..
षष्ठ्यां च कपिलाख्यायां तथा हि द्वादशीषु च .. 27 ..
15.8.m: on Vaidhṛti and Vyatīpāta, during the elephant's shadow, / on the sixth lunar day called Kapilā, and likewise on the twelfth lunar days.

15.8.s:
gomatyāṃ saṃgame snātvā dadyāddānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
nirmalaṃ sthānamāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati .. 28 ..
15.8.d:
गोमत्यां संगमे स्नात्वा दद्याद्दानं विशेषतः ..
निर्मलं स्थानमाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति .. 28 ..
15.8.m: Having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī, one should especially make gifts; / one attains the stainless abode, going to which one does not grieve.

15.8.s:
śrāddhapakṣe tvamāvāsyāṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
helayā prāpyate puṇyaṃ dattvā piṇḍaṃ gayāsamam .. 29 ..
15.8.d:
श्राद्धपक्षे त्वमावास्यां गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
हेलया प्राप्यते पुण्यं दत्त्वा पिण्डं गयासमम् .. 29 ..
15.8.m: On the new moon day during the fortnight of śrāddha, at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / merit equal to [that of] Gayā is easily obtained by offering a rice ball.

15.8.s:
tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena tvamāvāsyāṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ hi pitṛpakṣāṃte kāryyaṃ gomatisaṃgame .. 7.4.8.30 ..
15.8.d:
तस्मात्सर्वं प्रयत्नेन त्वमावास्यां द्विजोत्तमाः ..
श्राद्धं हि पितृपक्षांते कार्य्यं गोमतिसंगमे .. 7.4.8.30 ..
15.8.m: Therefore, O best of brahmins, by every effort, on the new moon day / at the end of the ancestors' fortnight, a śrāddha must be performed at the confluence of the Gomatī.

15.8.s:
yadyapyaśrotriyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yadyapyupahataṃ bhavet ..
pakṣaśrāddhakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ dinenaikena labhyate .. 31 ..
15.8.d:
यद्यप्यश्रोत्रियं श्राद्धं यद्यप्युपहतं भवेत् ..
पक्षश्राद्धकृतं पुण्यं दिनेनैकेन लभ्यते .. 31 ..
15.8.m: Even if the śrāddha lacks a Vedic scholar, even if it is flawed, / the merit produced by a fortnight's śrāddha is obtained in a single day.

15.8.s:
śraddhāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ pātrahīnamathāpi vā ..
dravyahīnaṃ kālahīnaṃ manasaḥ svāsthyavarjitam .. 32 ..
15.8.d:
श्रद्धाहीनं मन्त्रहीनं पात्रहीनमथापि वा ..
द्रव्यहीनं कालहीनं मनसः स्वास्थ्यवर्जितम् .. 32 ..
15.8.m: Even if devoid of faith, devoid of mantras, devoid of a worthy recipient, / devoid of wealth, devoid of the proper time, and lacking composure of mind,

15.8.s:
śrāddhapakṣe hyamāyāṃ tu gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
paripūrṇaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptirakṣayā .. 33 ..
15.8.d:
श्राद्धपक्षे ह्यमायां तु गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
परिपूर्णं भवेत्सर्वं पितॄणां तृप्तिरक्षया .. 33 ..
15.8.m: on the new moon day in the fortnight of śrāddha at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / everything becomes complete, and the ancestors' satisfaction is imperishable.

15.8.s:
gomatī kamalā caiva caṃdrabhāgā tathaiva ca ..
tisrastu saṃgatā nadyaḥ praviṣṭā varuṇālayam .. 34 ..
15.8.d:
गोमती कमला चैव चंद्रभागा तथैव च ..
तिस्रस्तु संगता नद्यः प्रविष्टा वरुणालयम् .. 34 ..
15.8.m: Gomatī, Kamalā, and likewise Candrabhāgā— / these three rivers united enter the ocean, the abode of Varuṇa.

15.8.s:
gayāyāṃ piṃḍadānena prayāge hyasthipātane ..
tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti pakṣāṃte śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ .. 35 ..
15.8.d:
गयायां पिंडदानेन प्रयागे ह्यस्थिपातने ..
तत्पुण्यं समवाप्नोति पक्षांते श्राद्धकृन्नरः .. 35 ..
15.8.m: The merit [gained] by offering a rice ball at Gayā, or by throwing bones at Prayāga— / that very merit is attained by a man who performs a śrāddha at the end of the fortnight.

15.8.s:
yadīcchetsarvatīrtheṣu helayā tvabhiṣecanam ..
snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktyā vai gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 36 ..
15.8.d:
यदीच्छेत्सर्वतीर्थेषु हेलया त्वभिषेचनम् ..
स्नानं कुर्वीत भक्त्या वै गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 36 ..
15.8.m: If one should desire with ease a bath in all sacred fords, / one should perform ritual ablution with devotion at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.

15.8.s:
pakṣepakṣe samagrā tu pitṛpūjā kṛtā ca yaiḥ ..
sampūrṇā jāyate teṣāṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 317 ..
śrāddhe kṛte tvamāvasyāṃ pitṛpakṣe ca vai dvijāḥ ..
aputrā caiva yā nārī kākavaṃdhyā ca yā bhavet .. 38 ..
mṛtaputrā tathā viprāḥ saṃgame snānamācaret ..
doṣaiḥ pramucyate sarvairgomapyudadhisaṃgame ..
snātvā sukhamavāpnoti prajāṃ ca cirajīvinīm .. 39 ..
yāni kāni ca dānāni pṛthivyāṃ sambhavaṃti hi ..
tāni sarvāṇi deyāni gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 7.4.8.40 ..
sarvadaiva ca viprendrā viśeṣātsarvaparvasu ..
snānaṃ kurvīta niyato gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 41 ..
darśanādeva pāpasya kṣayo bhavati bho dvijāḥ ..
praṇāme manasastuṣṭirmuktiścaivāvagāhane .. 42 ..
śrāddhe kṛte pitṝṇāṃ tu tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ..
dāne manorathāvāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 43 ..
15.8.d:
पक्षेपक्षे समग्रा तु पितृपूजा कृता च यैः ..
सम्पूर्णा जायते तेषां गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 317 ..
श्राद्धे कृते त्वमावस्यां पितृपक्षे च वै द्विजाः ..
अपुत्रा चैव या नारी काकवंध्या च या भवेत् .. 38 ..
मृतपुत्रा तथा विप्राः संगमे स्नानमाचरेत् ..
दोषैः प्रमुच्यते सर्वैर्गोमप्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नात्वा सुखमवाप्नोति प्रजां च चिरजीविनीम् .. 39 ..
यानि कानि च दानानि पृथिव्यां सम्भवंति हि ..
तानि सर्वाणि देयानि गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 7.4.8.40 ..
सर्वदैव च विप्रेन्द्रा विशेषात्सर्वपर्वसु ..
स्नानं कुर्वीत नियतो गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 41 ..
दर्शनादेव पापस्य क्षयो भवति भो द्विजाः ..
प्रणामे मनसस्तुष्टिर्मुक्तिश्चैवावगाहने .. 42 ..
श्राद्धे कृते पितॄणां तु तृप्तिर्भवति शाश्वती ..
दाने मनोरथावाप्तिर्जायते नात्र संशयः .. 43 ..
15.8.m:
The worship of the ancestors performed fortnight after fortnight in its entirety / becomes complete for them at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.
When a śrāddha is performed on the new moon day in the ancestors' fortnight, O brahmins, / a woman who is childless, or one whose children die,
or one whose sons have died, O brahmins, should bathe at the confluence. / At the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, she is freed from all afflictions; / having bathed, she attains happiness and long-lived offspring.
Whatever gifts exist upon the earth, / all of them should be given at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.
Always, O best of brahmins, and especially on all festive days, / one should, restrained, perform ritual ablution at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.
From mere darśana, O brahmins, there is destruction of sin; / in bowing down, there is satisfaction of mind; and in plunging in, liberation itself.
When a śrāddha is performed, there is eternal satisfaction for the ancestors; / in giving, the attainment of desires takes place—there is no doubt about this.

15.8.s:
kṛtakṛtyāstu te dhanyā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ..
śrāddhaṃ ca ṛṣiśārdūlā gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 44 ..
pitṛpakṣe ca vai kecinmātṛpakṣe tathaiva ca ..
tathā śvaśurapakṣe ca ye cānye mitrabāṃdhavāḥ .. 45 ..
sthāvaratvaṃ gatā ye ca pudgalatvaṃ ca ye gatāḥ ..
piśācatvaṃ gatā ye ca ye ca pretatvamāgatāḥ .. 46 ..
tiryyagyonigatā ye ca ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ ..
snānamātreṇa te sarve muktiṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
kiṃ punaḥ śrāddhadānādi gomatīsaṃgame tathā ..
kṛtvā muktimavāpnoti mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 48 ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
snātvā muktimavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati .. 49 ..
santyajya sarvatīrthāni gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
snānaṃ kṛtvā tathā śrāddhaṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ ..
paraṃ lokamavāpnoti hyarcayitvā tu vāmanam .. 7.4.8.50 ..
15.8.d:
कृतकृत्यास्तु ते धन्या यैः कृतं पितृतर्पणम् ..
श्राद्धं च ऋषिशार्दूला गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 44 ..
पितृपक्षे च वै केचिन्मातृपक्षे तथैव च ..
तथा श्वशुरपक्षे च ये चान्ये मित्रबांधवाः .. 45 ..
स्थावरत्वं गता ये च पुद्गलत्वं च ये गताः ..
पिशाचत्वं गता ये च ये च प्रेतत्वमागताः .. 46 ..
तिर्य्यग्योनिगता ये च ये च कीटत्वमागताः ..
स्नानमात्रेण ते सर्वे मुक्तिं यांति न संशयः .. 47 ..
किं पुनः श्राद्धदानादि गोमतीसंगमे तथा ..
कृत्वा मुक्तिमवाप्नोति मानवो नात्र संशयः .. 48 ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नात्वा मुक्तिमवाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति .. 49 ..
सन्त्यज्य सर्वतीर्थानि गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नानं कृत्वा तथा श्राद्धं कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः ..
परं लोकमवाप्नोति ह्यर्चयित्वा तु वामनम् .. 7.4.8.50 ..
15.8.m:
Accomplished in their purpose and fortunate are they by whom satiation of the ancestors / and a śrāddha are performed at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, O tigers among seers.
Those on the father's side, and likewise those on the mother's side, / and those on the father-in-law's side, as well as other friends and relatives,
those who have become immovable objects, those who have become physical bodies, / those who have become piśācas, and those who have become ghosts,
those born as animals, and those who have become insects— / all of them attain liberation by the mere ritual ablution; there is no doubt.
What more [to say]? Having performed śrāddha, gifts, and the like at the confluence of the Gomatī, / a mortal attains liberation; there is no doubt about this.
At the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, at the conjunction of Śravaṇā-dvādaśī, / having bathed, one attains liberation, going to which one does not grieve.
Forsaking all sacred fords, having performed ritual ablution / and likewise a śrāddha at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, a man becomes accomplished in his purpose; / and having worshiped Vāmana, he attains the supreme world.

15.8.s:
samyaksnātvā naro yastu pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam ..
pītāṃbaradharo bhūtvā divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 51 ..
vīkṣyamāṇaḥ surastrībhirnāgārikṛtaketanaḥ ..
caturbhujadharo bhūtvā vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ..
saṃstūyamāno munibhiryāti viṣṇvālayaṃ naraḥ .. 52 ..
gomatīsaṃgame snātvā kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ ..
yatra daityavadhaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā .. 53 ..
cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇena svayameva hi ..
tenaiva cakratīrthaṃ hi khyātaṃ lokatraye dvijāḥ .. 54 ..
bhavaṃti yatra pāṣāṇāścakrāṃkā muktidāyakāḥ ..
yaiḥ pūjitairjagannāthaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāṃnidhyamāvrajet .. 55 ..
tatraiva yadi labhyeta cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ saha .. 56 ..
dvādaśātmā sa vijñeyo mokṣadaḥ sarvadehinām ..
ekacakrāṃkito yastu dvāravatyāṃ suśobhanaḥ .. 57 ..
15.8.d:
सम्यक्स्नात्वा नरो यस्तु पूजयेद्गरुडध्वजम् ..
पीतांबरधरो भूत्वा दिव्याभरणभूषितः .. 51 ..
वीक्ष्यमाणः सुरस्त्रीभिर्नागारिकृतकेतनः ..
चतुर्भुजधरो भूत्वा वनमालाविभूषितः ..
संस्तूयमानो मुनिभिर्याति विष्ण्वालयं नरः .. 52 ..
गोमतीसंगमे स्नात्वा कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः ..
यत्र दैत्यवधं कृत्वा विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना .. 53 ..
चक्रं प्रक्षालितं पूर्वं कृष्णेन स्वयमेव हि ..
तेनैव चक्रतीर्थं हि ख्यातं लोकत्रये द्विजाः .. 54 ..
भवंति यत्र पाषाणाश्चक्रांका मुक्तिदायकाः ..
यैः पूजितैर्जगन्नाथः कृष्णः सांनिध्यमाव्रजेत् .. 55 ..
तत्रैव यदि लभ्येत चक्रैर्द्वादशभिः सह .. 56 ..
द्वादशात्मा स विज्ञेयो मोक्षदः सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
एकचक्रांकितो यस्तु द्वारवत्यां सुशोभनः .. 57 ..
15.8.m:
A man who, having bathed properly, worships the one whose banner is Garuḍa, / becomes clad in yellow garments, adorned with divine ornaments,
gazed upon by celestial women, with Garuḍa as his emblem; / having taken on four arms and adorned with a garland of forest flowers, / praised by sages, that man goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.
Having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī, a man becomes accomplished in his purpose. / Where, having slain the demons, by the all-powerful Viṣṇu,
the discus was washed in ancient times by Kṛṣṇa himself, / therefore, O brahmins, it is renowned in the three worlds as Cakratīrtha.
Where there are stones marked with the discus, granting liberation, / by worshiping which Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of the World, enters their presence.
If [a stone] is found right there with twelve discuses,
it should be known as twelve-formed, granting liberation to all embodied beings. / That very auspicious one in Dvāravatī which is marked with a single discus,

15.8.s:
sudarśanābhidhāno'sau mokṣaikaphalado hi saḥ ..
lakṣmīnārāyaṇo dvābhyāṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ .. 58 ..
tribhistrivikramaścaiva trivargaphaladāyakaḥ ..
śrīprado ripuhantā ca caturbhiḥ saṃyutaḥ sa hi .. 59 ..
pañcabhirvāsudevastu janmamṛtyubhayāpahaḥ ..
pradyumnaḥ ṣaḍbhirevāsau lakṣmīṃ kāṃtiṃ dadāti yaḥ .. 7.4.8.60 ..
saptabhirbalabhadraśca cakrago'tra prakīrtitaḥ ..
lācchitaścāṣṭabhirbhaktiṃ dadāti puruṣottamaḥ .. 61 ..

ekādaśabhiraiśvaryaṃ cakragaḥ saṃprayacchati ..

yato'tra te ca pāṣāṇāḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa citritāḥ .. 64 ..
15.8.d:
सुदर्शनाभिधानोऽसौ मोक्षैकफलदो हि सः ..
लक्ष्मीनारायणो द्वाभ्यां भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः .. 58 ..
त्रिभिस्त्रिविक्रमश्चैव त्रिवर्गफलदायकः ..
श्रीप्रदो रिपुहन्ता च चतुर्भिः संयुतः स हि .. 59 ..
पञ्चभिर्वासुदेवस्तु जन्ममृत्युभयापहः ..
प्रद्युम्नः षड्भिरेवासौ लक्ष्मीं कांतिं ददाति यः .. 7.4.8.60 ..
सप्तभिर्बलभद्रश्च चक्रगोऽत्र प्रकीर्तितः ..
लाच्छितश्चाष्टभिर्भक्तिं ददाति पुरुषोत्तमः .. 61 ..
सर्वं दद्यान्नवव्यूहो दुर्लभो यः सुरैरपि ..
दशावतारो दशमी राज्यदो नात्र संशयः ..62 ..
एकादशभिरैश्वर्यं चक्रगः संप्रयच्छति ..
निर्वाणं द्वादशात्मा च द्वादशभिर्ददाति च .. 63 ..
अत ऊर्ध्वं महाभागाः सौख्यमोक्षप्रदायकाः ..
यतोऽत्र ते च पाषाणाः कृष्णचक्रेण चित्रिताः .. 64 ..
15.8.m:
is named Sudarśana; it yields liberation alone as its fruit. / With two [discuses], it is Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, bestowing both enjoyment and liberation.
With three [discs], he is Trivikrama, bestowing the fruit of the three aims of life. / Endowed with four, he indeed gives prosperity and slays enemies. 59.
With five, he is Vāsudeva, taking away the fear of birth and death. / With six, he is Pradyumna, who gives fortune and radiance. 60.
With seven, Balabhadra is celebrated here as abiding in the disc. / Marked with eight, Puruṣottama grants devotion. 61.
The ninefold manifestation, hard to attain even for the gods, grants everything. / The tenth is the Ten Avatāras, which grants kingship—of this there is no doubt. 62.
With eleven, abiding in the disc, he bestows sovereignty. / And as the twelvefold soul, with twelve, he grants liberation. 63.
Beyond this, O fortunate ones, they bestow happiness and liberation,
since these stones are marked here with Kṛṣṇa's discus. 64.

15.8.s:
teṣāṃ sparśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..

tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti sakṛccakrāṃkadarśanāt .. 67 ..

tatra caiva harikṣetraṃ muktidaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 68 ..

15.8.d:
तेषां स्पर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ..
चक्रतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा कृष्णचक्रेण चिह्नितः .. 65 ..
पूजयित्वा चक्रधरं हरिं ध्यायेत्सनातनम् ..
नापुत्रो नाधनो रोगी न स संजायते नरः .. 66 ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं मनोवाक्कायकर्मजम् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति सकृच्चक्रांकदर्शनात् .. 67 ..
म्लेच्छ देशे शुभे वापि चक्रांको दृश्यते यदि ..
तत्र चैव हरिक्षेत्रं मुक्तिदं नात्र संशयः .. 68 ..
मृत्युकालेऽपि सम्प्राप्ते यदि ध्यायेद्धरिं नरः ..
चक्रांकं धारयेदंगे स याति परमं पदम्..69..
हृदयस्थे च चक्रांके पूतो भवति तत्क्षणात् ..
नोपसर्पंति तं भीता दूताः कृष्णायुधं तदा ..
वैष्णवं लोकमा प्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..7.4.8.70 ..
15.8.m:
By mere touch of them, one is freed from all sins. / Having bathed at Cakratīrtha, marked with Kṛṣṇa's discus, 65.
having worshipped the discus-bearer, a person should meditate upon the eternal Hari. / That man never becomes sonless, poor, or diseased. 66.
Sin such as the killing of a brahmin, born of actions of mind, speech, or body, / all that goes to dissolution from a single darśana of the disc mark. 67.
Even in an impure barbarian land, if a disc mark is seen, / right there is a sacred field of Hari that grants liberation; of this there is no doubt. 68.
Even when the time of death has arrived, if a man meditates on Hari / and bears the disc mark on his body, he goes to the highest state. 69.
And when the disc mark is on the heart, he becomes purified in that instant. / The messengers, terrified of Kṛṣṇa's weapon, do not approach him then; / he attains the world of Viṣṇu—no doubt should be entertained here. 70.

15.8.s:
api pāpasamācāraḥ kiṃ punardhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ..
gomatī saṃgame snātvā cakratīrthe tathaiva ca ..
mucyate pātakairghorai rmānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ..71..
rājasāḥ sattvamāyāṃti viṣṇudharmaṃ sanātanam ..
kṣetrasya tasya māhātmyātsatyametatprakīrtitam .. 72 ..
tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ cāpi yatkiñcidviṣṇupūjane ..
tacca sattvatvamāyāti nimnagā ca yathārṇave .. 73 ..
durlabhā dvārakā vipra durlabhaṃ gomatījalam ..
durlabhaṃ jāgaro rātrau durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam .. 74 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatyudadhi saṃgamasnānādimāhātmyapūrvaka cakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 8 .. ..
15.8.d:
अपि पापसमाचारः किं पुनर्धार्मिकः शुचिः ..
गोमती संगमे स्नात्वा चक्रतीर्थे तथैव च ..
मुच्यते पातकैर्घोरै र्मानवो नात्र संशयः ..71..
राजसाः सत्त्वमायांति विष्णुधर्मं सनातनम् ..
क्षेत्रस्य तस्य माहात्म्यात्सत्यमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् .. 72 ..
तामसं राजसं चापि यत्किञ्चिद्विष्णुपूजने ..
तच्च सत्त्वत्वमायाति निम्नगा च यथार्णवे .. 73 ..
दुर्लभा द्वारका विप्र दुर्लभं गोमतीजलम् ..
दुर्लभं जागरो रात्रौ दुर्लभं कृष्णदर्शनम् .. 74 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमत्युदधि संगमस्नानादिमाहात्म्यपूर्वक चक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टमोऽध्यायः .. 8 .. ..
15.8.m:
Even one of sinful conduct—how much more one who is righteous and pure!— / having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī and likewise at Cakratīrtha, / that human is freed from dreadful sins; of this there is no doubt. 71.
Passionate beings attain purity and the eternal religious duty of Viṣṇu. / This has been proclaimed as true by virtue of the māhātmya of that sacred field. 72.
Whatever is dark or passionate in the worship of Viṣṇu, / that too attains the state of purity, just as a river enters the ocean. 73.
Dvārakā is hard to attain, O brahmin; the water of the Gomatī is hard to attain; / keeping vigil through the night is hard to attain; the darśana of Kṛṣṇa is hard to attain. 74.
Thus, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the fourth Dvārakāmāhātmya, the eighth chapter named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Cakratīrtha Preceded by the Māhātmya of Bathing at the Confluence of the Gomatī and the Ocean.' 8.

15.9.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ saptakuṇḍānsuviśrutān ..
sarvapāpapraśamanānṛddhibuddhivivarddhanān..1..
15.9.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सप्तकुण्डान्सुविश्रुतान् ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनानृद्धिबुद्धिविवर्द्धनान्..1..
15.9.m: Prahlāda said: / Then one should go, O best of brahmins, to the seven celebrated pools, / which quell all sins and increase prosperity and wisdom. 1.

15.9.s:
ārādhitaḥ sa ca yadā harirāvirbabhūva ha ..
saṃstūyamāno munibhirlakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ .. 2 ..
15.9.d:
आराधितः स च यदा हरिराविर्बभूव ह ..
संस्तूयमानो मुनिभिर्लक्ष्म्या सह जगत्पतिः .. 2 ..
15.9.m: When Hari was worshipped, he indeed manifested, / the Lord of the universe, being praised by the sages together with Lakṣmī. 2.

15.9.s:
arhaṇaṃ ca tadā cakrurharaye suragaṅgayā ..
vāmapārśve sthitāṃ padmāmabhiṣektuṃ samudyatām .. 3 ..
15.9.d:
अर्हणं च तदा चक्रुर्हरये सुरगङ्गया ..
वामपार्श्वे स्थितां पद्मामभिषेक्तुं समुद्यताम् .. 3 ..
15.9.m: Then they offered worship to Hari with the heavenly Gaṅgā, / and to Padmā standing at his left side, who was prepared to be consecrated. 3.

15.9.s:
sanakādyā brahmasutāḥ saptaite manasā dvijāḥ ..
pṛthakpṛthagghradānkṛtvā siṣicuḥ sāgarodbhavām .. 4 ..
15.9.d:
सनकाद्या ब्रह्मसुताः सप्तैते मनसा द्विजाः ..
पृथक्पृथग्घ्रदान्कृत्वा सिषिचुः सागरोद्भवाम् .. 4 ..
15.9.m: These seven sons of Brahmā born of his mind, the brahmins led by Sanaka, / having made separate pools, sprinkled the one born of the ocean. 4.

15.9.s:
tato lakṣmīhradāḥ proktā devyā nātraiva saṃjñitāḥ ..
prāpte tu dvāparasyāṃte rukmiṇīsaṃśrayeṇa tu .. 5 ..
15.9.d:
ततो लक्ष्मीह्रदाः प्रोक्ता देव्या नात्रैव संज्ञिताः ..
प्राप्ते तु द्वापरस्यांते रुक्मिणीसंश्रयेण तु .. 5 ..
15.9.m: Therefore they were called Lakṣmīhradas, designated by the goddess's name. / But when the end of Dvāpara arrived, through association with Rukmiṇī, 5.

15.9.s:
rukmiṇīhradamityevaṃ kalau khyātiṃ gatāḥ punaḥ ..
bhṛguṇā sevitaṃ yasmādbhṛgutīrthamiti smṛtam .. 6 ..
15.9.d:
रुक्मिणीह्रदमित्येवं कलौ ख्यातिं गताः पुनः ..
भृगुणा सेवितं यस्माद्भृगुतीर्थमिति स्मृतम् .. 6 ..
15.9.m: they attained fame in the Kali age again as Rukmiṇīhrada. / Because it was frequented by Bhṛgu, it is remembered as Bhṛgutīrtha. 6.

15.9.s:
tasmingatvā mahābhāgāḥ prakṣālya caraṇau mṛdā ..
ācamya ca kuśāngṛhya prāṅmukho niyataḥ śuciḥ .. 7 ..
15.9.d:
तस्मिन्गत्वा महाभागाः प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ मृदा ..
आचम्य च कुशान्गृह्य प्राङ्मुखो नियतः शुचिः .. 7 ..
15.9.m: Having gone there, O fortunate ones, having washed both feet with earth, / having sipped water, holding kuśa grasses, facing east, self-restrained and pure, 7.

15.9.s:
saṃpūrṇaṃ cārghyamādāya phalapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ..
rajataṃ ca śire kṛtvā mantrametamudīrayet .. 8 ..
15.9.d:
संपूर्णं चार्घ्यमादाय फलपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः ..
रजतं च शिरे कृत्वा मन्त्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 8 ..
15.9.m: and taking a complete arghya offering with fruits, flowers, unbroken grains, and the like, / and placing silver on the head, one should recite this mantra: 8.

15.9.s:
bhaktyā cārghyaṃ pradāsyāmi hrade rukmiṇisaṃjñite ..
sarvapāpavināśāya rukmiṇyāḥ prīṇanāya ca .. 9 ..
15.9.d:
भक्त्या चार्घ्यं प्रदास्यामि ह्रदे रुक्मिणिसंज्ञिते ..
सर्वपापविनाशाय रुक्मिण्याः प्रीणनाय च .. 9 ..
15.9.m: 'With devotion I shall offer arghya in the pool called Rukmiṇī, / for the destruction of all sins and for the pleasure of Rukmiṇī.' 9.

15.9.s:
snānaṃ kuryyāttato viprāḥ kṛtvā śirasi tārakam ..
devānmanupyānsantarpya pitṝnatha viśeṣataḥ .. 7.4.9.10 ..
15.9.d:
स्नानं कुर्य्यात्ततो विप्राः कृत्वा शिरसि तारकम् ..
देवान्मनुप्यान्सन्तर्प्य पितॄनथ विशेषतः .. 7.4.9.10 ..
15.9.m: Then one should bathe, O brahmins, having placed the seed syllable on the head. / Having satiated the gods, humans, and especially the ancestors, 10.

15.9.s:
śrāddhaṃ tataḥ prakurvīta viprānāhūya bhaktitaḥ ..
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyādrajataṃ rukmameva ca .. 11 ..
15.9.d:
श्राद्धं ततः प्रकुर्वीत विप्रानाहूय भक्तितः ..
दक्षिणां च ततो दद्याद्रजतं रुक्ममेव च .. 11 ..
15.9.m: one should then perform a śrāddha, having summoned brahmins with devotion. / And one should then give a sacrificial fee, silver and gold. 11.

15.9.s:
viśeṣataḥ pradeyāni phalāni rasavanti ca ..
dampatyorbhojanaṃ dadyānmiṣṭānnena dvijottamāḥ .. 12..
15.9.d:
विशेषतः प्रदेयानि फलानि रसवन्ति च ..
दम्पत्योर्भोजनं दद्यान्मिष्टान्नेन द्विजोत्तमाः .. 12..
15.9.m: Juicy fruits should be given in particular. / One should provide a meal of sweet food to a married couple, O best of brahmins. 12.

15.9.s:
viprapatnyastu saṃpūjyāḥ striyaścānyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ ..
kañcukai raktavastraiśca rukmiṇī prīyatāmiti .. 13 ..
15.9.d:
विप्रपत्न्यस्तु संपूज्याः स्त्रियश्चान्याः स्वशक्तितः ..
कञ्चुकै रक्तवस्त्रैश्च रुक्मिणी प्रीयतामिति .. 13 ..
15.9.m: The wives of brahmins should be worshipped, and other women according to one's means, / with blouses and red garments, saying, 'May Rukmiṇī be pleased.' 13.

15.9.s:
evaṃ kṛte dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 14 ..
15.9.d:
एवं कृते द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 14 ..
15.9.m: When this is done, O best of brahmins, a person becomes one who has accomplished his purpose. / He attains all desires and goes to the world of Viṣṇu. 14.

15.9.s:
vasate ca sadā gehe lakṣmīstasya na saṃśayaḥ ..
ārogyaṃ manasastuṣṭirna codvegaḥ kadācana .. 15 ..
15.9.d:
वसते च सदा गेहे लक्ष्मीस्तस्य न संशयः ..
आरोग्यं मनसस्तुष्टिर्न चोद्वेगः कदाचन .. 15 ..
15.9.m: And Lakṣmī constantly resides in his home; of this there is no doubt. / There is health, satisfaction of mind, and never any anxiety. 15.

15.9.s:
pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptiḥ prajā bhavati niścalā ..
hīnasattvo naiva bhaveddīrghāyuśca bhavennaraḥ .. 16 ..
15.9.d:
पितॄणामक्षया तृप्तिः प्रजा भवति निश्चला ..
हीनसत्त्वो नैव भवेद्दीर्घायुश्च भवेन्नरः .. 16 ..
15.9.m: There is imperishable satisfaction for his ancestors; his offspring becomes steadfast. / A person never becomes deficient in vitality, and he becomes long-lived. 16.

15.9.s:
āḍhyo bhavati sarvatra yaḥ snāto rukmiṇī hrade ..
na lakṣmyā mucyate viprā nālakṣmyā vriyate naraḥ .. 17 ..
15.9.d:
आढ्यो भवति सर्वत्र यः स्नातो रुक्मिणी ह्रदे ..
न लक्ष्म्या मुच्यते विप्रा नालक्ष्म्या व्रियते नरः .. 17 ..
15.9.m: He who has bathed in Rukmiṇīhrada becomes wealthy everywhere. / He is not forsaken by Lakṣmī, O brahmins, nor is that man chosen by misfortune. 17.

15.9.s:
na vairaṃ kalahastasya yaḥ snāto rukmiṇīhrade ..
gamanāgamanaṃ na syātsaṃsārabhramaṇaṃ tathā .. 18 ..
15.9.d:
न वैरं कलहस्तस्य यः स्नातो रुक्मिणीह्रदे ..
गमनागमनं न स्यात्संसारभ्रमणं तथा .. 18 ..
15.9.m: He who has bathed in Rukmiṇīhrada has no enmity or quarrel. / There will be no going and coming, nor wandering in transmigration. 18.

15.9.s:
duḥkhaśokau kutastasya yaḥ snāto rukmiṇīhrade ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto mahābhayavivarjitaḥ .. 19 ..
15.9.d:
दुःखशोकौ कुतस्तस्य यः स्नातो रुक्मिणीह्रदे ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो महाभयविवर्जितः .. 19 ..
15.9.m: Whence could there be sorrow and grief for him who has bathed in Rukmiṇīhrada? / Freed from all sins, rid of great fear, 19.

15.9.s:
sarvānkāmāniha prāpya yāti viṣṇupadaṃ naraḥ .. 7.4.9.20 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakā māhātmye rukmiṇīhradamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 9 .. .. cha ..
15.9.d:
सर्वान्कामानिह प्राप्य याति विष्णुपदं नरः .. 7.4.9.20 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारका माहात्म्ये रुक्मिणीह्रदमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवमोऽध्यायः .. 9 .. .. छ ..
15.9.m:
having attained all desires here, a person goes to the abode of Viṣṇu. 20.
Thus, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the fourth Dvārakāmāhātmya, the ninth chapter named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Rukmiṇīhrada.' 9.

15.10.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
kṛkalāsamiti khyātaṃ nṛgatīrthamanuttamam .. 1 ..
15.10.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
कृकलासमिति ख्यातं नृगतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
15.10.m: Prahlāda said: / Then, O best of brahmins, one should go to the sacred ford that destroys sin, / known as Kṛkalāsa, the unsurpassed Nṛgatīrtha, 1.

15.10.s:
nṛgo yatra mahīpālaḥ kṛkalāsavapurdharaḥ ..
kṛṣṇena saha saṃgatya saṃprāpa paramāṃ gatim .. 2 .. ; ..
15.10.d:
नृगो यत्र महीपालः कृकलासवपुर्धरः ..
कृष्णेन सह संगत्य संप्राप परमां गतिम् .. 2 .. ; ..
15.10.m: where King Nṛga, bearing the form of a chameleon, / met with Kṛṣṇa and attained the supreme goal. 2.

15.10.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
nṛgo nāma nṛpaḥ ko'yaṃ kathaṃ kṛṣṇena saṃgataḥ ..
karmaṇā kṛkalāsatvaṃ kena tadvada vistarāt .. 3 ..
15.10.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
नृगो नाम नृपः कोऽयं कथं कृष्णेन संगतः ..
कर्मणा कृकलासत्वं केन तद्वद विस्तरात् .. 3 ..
15.10.m: The seers said: / Who was this king named Nṛga, and how did he meet with Kṛṣṇa? / By what action did he become a chameleon? Tell that in detail. 3.

15.10.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
nṛgo nāma nṛpo viprāḥ sārvabhaumo balānvitaḥ ..
buddhimāndhṛtimāndakṣaḥ śrīmānsarvaguṇānvitaḥ .. 4 ..
15.10.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
नृगो नाम नृपो विप्राः सार्वभौमो बलान्वितः ..
बुद्धिमान्धृतिमान्दक्षः श्रीमान्सर्वगुणान्वितः .. 4 ..
15.10.m:
Prahlāda said:
O brahmins, there was a king named Nṛga, a universal emperor endowed with power, / intelligent, resolute, skillful, glorious, and endowed with all virtues.

15.10.s:
anekaśatasāhasrā bhūmipā api tadvaśāḥ .. . .
hastyaśvarathasaṃghaiśca pattibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
15.10.d:
अनेकशतसाहस्रा भूमिपा अपि तद्वशाः .. . .
हस्त्यश्वरथसंघैश्च पत्तिभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः .. 5 ..
15.10.m: Even many hundreds of thousands of earthly kings were under his sway. / He was surrounded by hosts of elephants, horses, and chariots, and by many foot-soldiers.

15.10.s:
sainyaṃ ca tasya nṛpateḥ kośaṃ caivākṣayaṃ tathā ..
sa nityaṃ gurubhaktaśca devatārādhane rataḥ .. 6 ..
15.10.d:
सैन्यं च तस्य नृपतेः कोशं चैवाक्षयं तथा ..
स नित्यं गुरुभक्तश्च देवताराधने रतः .. 6 ..
15.10.m: That king possessed an army and an inexhaustible treasury. / He was always devoted to his guru and intent upon the worship of the deities.

15.10.s:
mahā dānāni viprendrā dadātyanudinaṃ nṛpaḥ ..
śaśvatsa gosahasraṃ tu dadāti nṛpasattamaḥ .. 7 ..
15.10.d:
महा दानानि विप्रेन्द्रा ददात्यनुदिनं नृपः ..
शश्वत्स गोसहस्रं तु ददाति नृपसत्तमः .. 7 ..
15.10.m: The king gave great gifts day after day, O foremost of brahmins. / That best of kings constantly gave a thousand cows.

15.10.s:
prakṣālya caraṇau bhaktyā hyupaviśyāsane śubhe ..
paridhāpya śubhe kṣaume sugandhenopalipya ca .. 8 ..
15.10.d:
प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ भक्त्या ह्युपविश्यासने शुभे ..
परिधाप्य शुभे क्षौमे सुगन्धेनोपलिप्य च .. 8 ..
15.10.m: Having washed their feet with devotion and seated them on an auspicious seat, / having clothed them in fine linen and anointed them with fragrant paste,

15.10.s:
saṃpūjya puṣpamālābhi dhūpena ca sugandhinā ..
dadau dakṣiṇayā sārddhaṃ prativiprāya gāṃ tadā ..
tāṃbūlasahitāṃ bhaktyā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 9 ..
15.10.d:
संपूज्य पुष्पमालाभि धूपेन च सुगन्धिना ..
ददौ दक्षिणया सार्द्धं प्रतिविप्राय गां तदा ..
तांबूलसहितां भक्त्या विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति .. 9 ..
15.10.m: having worshiped them with flower-garlands and fragrant incense, / he then gave each brahmin a cow along with a sacrificial fee / accompanied by betel, with devotion, [saying,] “May Viṣṇu be pleased with me!”

15.10.s:
evaṃ pradadatastasya yajataśca tathā makhaiḥ ..
yayau kālo dvijaśreṣṭhā bhogāṃścaivānubhuñjataḥ .. 7.4.10.10 ..
15.10.d:
एवं प्रददतस्तस्य यजतश्च तथा मखैः ..
ययौ कालो द्विजश्रेष्ठा भोगांश्चैवानुभुञ्जतः .. 7.4.10.10 ..
15.10.m: As he was thus giving and also sacrificing with rites, / time passed, O best of the twice-born, while he also enjoyed pleasures.

15.10.s:
ekadā tu dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ jaiminiṃ saṃśitavratam ..
śraddhayā taṃ ca nṛpatiḥ pratigrahaparāṅmukham ..
uvāca vākyaṃ nṛpatiḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 11 ..
15.10.d:
एकदा तु द्विजश्रेष्ठं जैमिनिं संशितव्रतम् ..
श्रद्धया तं च नृपतिः प्रतिग्रहपराङ्मुखम् ..
उवाच वाक्यं नृपतिः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 11 ..
15.10.m: Once, however, to the best of the twice-born, Jaimini, who was strict in his vows / and averse to receiving gifts, the king, with faith, / standing with folded hands, addressed these words:

15.10.s:
māmuddhara mahābhāga kṛpāṃ kuru taponidhe ..
gṛhāṇa gāṃ mayā dattāṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .. 12 ..
15.10.d:
मामुद्धर महाभाग कृपां कुरु तपोनिधे ..
गृहाण गां मया दत्तां दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .. 12 ..
15.10.m: “Deliver me, O noble one! Have mercy, O treasure of austerity! / Accept the cow given by me, showing compassion to me.”

15.10.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya anicchannapi gauravāt ..
nṛpasya cābravīdvipra evamastviti lajjitaḥ .. 13 ..
15.10.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य अनिच्छन्नपि गौरवात् ..
नृपस्य चाब्रवीद्विप्र एवमस्त्विति लज्जितः .. 13 ..
15.10.m: Hearing his word, the brahmin, though unwilling, out of respect / for the king, said bashfully, “So be it.”

15.10.s:
avanijya tataḥ pādau śirasā dhārayajjalam ..
suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ raupyakhuravibhūṣitām .. 14 ..
15.10.d:
अवनिज्य ततः पादौ शिरसा धारयज्जलम् ..
सुवर्णशृंगसहितां रौप्यखुरविभूषिताम् .. 14 ..
15.10.m: Then, having washed his feet, [the king] bore the water upon his head. / [A cow] having golden horns, adorned with silver hooves,

15.10.s:
ratnapucchāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ sitavastrāvaguṃṭhitām ..
samabhyarcya ca viprendraṃ dadau dakṣiṇayānvitām .. 15 ..
15.10.d:
रत्नपुच्छां कांस्यदोहां सितवस्त्रावगुंठिताम् ..
समभ्यर्च्य च विप्रेन्द्रं ददौ दक्षिणयान्विताम् .. 15 ..
15.10.m: with a jeweled tail, a bronze milking vessel, covered in white cloth— / having worshiped that foremost of brahmins, he gave it endowed with a sacrificial fee.

15.10.s:
āsīmāntamanuvrajya hṛṣṭo rājā babhūva ha ..
taruṇīṃ haṃsavarṇāṃ ca haṃsīnāmeti viśrutām .. 16 ..
15.10.d:
आसीमान्तमनुव्रज्य हृष्टो राजा बभूव ह ..
तरुणीं हंसवर्णां च हंसीनामेति विश्रुताम् .. 16 ..
15.10.m: Having accompanied him as far as the boundary, the king was delighted. / [The cow] was young, white as a swan, and known by the name Haṃsī.

15.10.s:
gāṃ gṛhya svagṛhaṃ prāpto dāmnā baddhāṃ savatsakām ..
sa tasyai yavasaṃ cārdraṃ dadau brāhmaṇasattamaḥ .. 17 .. ..
15.10.d:
गां गृह्य स्वगृहं प्राप्तो दाम्ना बद्धां सवत्सकाम् ..
स तस्यै यवसं चार्द्रं ददौ ब्राह्मणसत्तमः .. 17 .. ..
15.10.m: Taking the cow, bound with a tether and accompanied by her calf, that best of brahmins arrived at his home; / and he gave her fresh grass.

15.10.s:
sutṛptā yavasenaiva madhyāhne tṛṣitāṃ tadā ..
gṛhītvā niryayau vipro dāmabaddhāṃ jalāśayam .. 18 ..
15.10.d:
सुतृप्ता यवसेनैव मध्याह्ने तृषितां तदा ..
गृहीत्वा निर्ययौ विप्रो दामबद्धां जलाशयम् .. 18 ..
15.10.m: When she was well satiated with the grass, she grew thirsty at midday; / taking her, tied with a rope, the brahmin set out for a pool of water.

15.10.s:
mārge gajāśvasaṃbādhe trastā sā uṣṭradarśanāt ..
hastādācchidya sā dhenurbrāhmaṇasya yayau tadā .. 19 ..
15.10.d:
मार्गे गजाश्वसंबाधे त्रस्ता सा उष्ट्रदर्शनात् ..
हस्तादाच्छिद्य सा धेनुर्ब्राह्मणस्य ययौ तदा .. 19 ..
15.10.m: On the road congested with elephants and horses, frightened by the sight of a camel, / that cow, tearing herself away from the brahmin's hand, ran away then.

15.10.s:
vicinvansakalāmurvīṃ nāpaśyattāṃ dvijarṣabhaḥ ..
sā yayau vidrutā dhenustanmahadrājagodhanam .. .. 7.4.10.20 ..
15.10.d:
विचिन्वन्सकलामुर्वीं नापश्यत्तां द्विजर्षभः ..
सा ययौ विद्रुता धेनुस्तन्महद्राजगोधनम् .. .. 7.4.10.20 ..
15.10.m: Searching the whole earth, the bull among the twice-born did not see her. / That cow, having fled, went to that king's great herd of cattle.

15.10.s:
dvitīye'hni punarvipramāhūya nṛpasattamaḥ ..
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 21 ..
15.10.d:
द्वितीयेऽह्नि पुनर्विप्रमाहूय नृपसत्तमः ..
संपूज्य विधिवद्भक्त्या वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः .. 21 ..
15.10.m: On the second day, having summoned another brahmin, that best of kings, / having worshiped him according to rule with devotion, with garments, ornaments, and decorations,

15.10.s:
vidhivadgāṃ dadau tāṃ ca sa nṛpaḥ somaśarmaṇe ..
gṛhītvā rājabhavanānniryayau gāṃ dvijarṣabhaḥ .. 22 ..
15.10.d:
विधिवद्गां ददौ तां च स नृपः सोमशर्मणे ..
गृहीत्वा राजभवनान्निर्ययौ गां द्विजर्षभः .. 22 ..
15.10.m: that king gave that very cow according to rule to Somaśarman. / Taking the cow from the royal palace, the bull among the twice-born departed,

15.10.s:
āśaṃsamāno rājānaṃ dharmajñamiti kovidam ..
sa ca vipro vicinvānaḥ sarvato gāṃ suduḥkhitaḥ .. .. 23 ..
15.10.d:
आशंसमानो राजानं धर्मज्ञमिति कोविदम् ..
स च विप्रो विचिन्वानः सर्वतो गां सुदुःखितः .. .. 23 ..
15.10.m: praising the king as knowledgeable of dharma and wise. / And that [first] brahmin, searching for the cow everywhere, deeply distressed,

15.10.s:
dadarśa pathi gacchantīṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ somaśarmaṇaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ gāṃ ca sa munirjaiministamabhāṣata .. 24 ..
15.10.d:
ददर्श पथि गच्छन्तीं पृष्ठतः सोमशर्मणः ..
दृष्ट्वा तां गां च स मुनिर्जैमिनिस्तमभाषत .. 24 ..
15.10.m: saw her walking on the road behind Somaśarman. / Seeing that cow, that sage Jaimini said to him:

15.10.s:
mama gāṃ cāpi hṛtvā tvaṃ nayase dasyuvatkatham ..
sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vismayaṃ dasyukīrttanāt .. 25 ..
15.10.d:
मम गां चापि हृत्वा त्वं नयसे दस्युवत्कथम् ..
स तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मयं दस्युकीर्त्तनात् .. 25 ..
15.10.m: “Having seized my cow, how can you lead her away like a robber?” / Hearing his word, astounded by being called a robber, [Somaśarman said:]

15.10.s:
rājato hi mayā labdhāṃ gāṃ nayāmi svamandiram ..
gohartteti ca māṃ kasmādbravīṣi dvijasattama .. 26 ..
15.10.d:
राजतो हि मया लब्धां गां नयामि स्वमन्दिरम् ..
गोहर्त्तेति च मां कस्माद्ब्रवीषि द्विजसत्तम .. 26 ..
15.10.m: “I am leading to my own house a cow obtained from the king! / Why do you call me a cow-stealer, O best of the twice-born?”

15.10.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
mayāpi rājato labdhā mameyaṃ gaurna saṃśayaḥ ..
kathaṃ nayasi vipra tvaṃ mayi jīvati mandiram .. 27 ..
15.10.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
मयापि राजतो लब्धा ममेयं गौर्न संशयः ..
कथं नयसि विप्र त्वं मयि जीवति मन्दिरम् .. 27 ..
15.10.m:
The [first] brahmin said:
“I too obtained her from the king; she is mine, no doubt. / While I am alive, how can you lead her to your house, O brahmin?”

15.10.s:
so'bravīdadya me labdhā kathaṃ māṃ vadase mṛṣā ..
so'bravīddhyo mayā labdhā balānnetuṃ tvamicchasi .. 28 ..
15.10.d:
सोऽब्रवीदद्य मे लब्धा कथं मां वदसे मृषा ..
सोऽब्रवीद्ध्यो मया लब्धा बलान्नेतुं त्वमिच्छसि .. 28 ..
15.10.m: He said, “She was obtained by me today; why do you speak falsely to me?” / The other said, “She was obtained by me yesterday; you wish to take her by force!”

15.10.s:
mameyamiti saṃkruddhaḥ somaśarmā'bravīdvacaḥ ..
prajvalatkrodharaktākṣo mameyamiti so'paraḥ .. 29 ..
15.10.d:
ममेयमिति संक्रुद्धः सोमशर्माऽब्रवीद्वचः ..
प्रज्वलत्क्रोधरक्ताक्षो ममेयमिति सोऽपरः .. 29 ..
15.10.m: “She is mine!” said Somaśarman furiously; / “She is mine!” said the other, his eyes red with blazing anger.

15.10.s:
vivadatau tathā viprau rājadvāramupāgatau ..
kurvāṇau kalahaṃ ghoraṃ tyaktukāmau svajīvitam .. 7.4.10.30 ..
15.10.d:
विवदतौ तथा विप्रौ राजद्वारमुपागतौ ..
कुर्वाणौ कलहं घोरं त्यक्तुकामौ स्वजीवितम् .. 7.4.10.30 ..
15.10.m: Thus disputing, the two brahmins arrived at the palace gate, / making a terrible quarrel, ready to give up their own lives.

15.10.s:
saṃkruddhau brāhmaṇau dṛṣṭvā śapantau tau parasparam ..
rājñe nivedayāmāsa dvāsthaṃ praṇayapūrvakam .. 31 ..
15.10.d:
संक्रुद्धौ ब्राह्मणौ दृष्ट्वा शपन्तौ तौ परस्परम् ..
राज्ञे निवेदयामास द्वास्थं प्रणयपूर्वकम् .. 31 ..
15.10.m: Seeing the two enraged brahmins cursing each other, / [a guard] politely reported to the gatekeeper for the king.

15.10.s:
avajñāya tadā viprau vivadantau ruṣānvitau ..
kāmavyākulacetasko na bahirniḥsṛto nṛpaḥ .. 32 ..
15.10.d:
अवज्ञाय तदा विप्रौ विवदन्तौ रुषान्वितौ ..
कामव्याकुलचेतस्को न बहिर्निःसृतो नृपः .. 32 ..
15.10.m: Disregarding the two brahmins who were then quarreling in anger, / the king, his mind distracted by desire, did not come outside.

15.10.s:
evaṃ vivadamānau tau trirātraṃ samupasthitau ..
avajñātau nṛpeṇātha rājānaṃ prati ca krudhā .. 33 ..
15.10.d:
एवं विवदमानौ तौ त्रिरात्रं समुपस्थितौ ..
अवज्ञातौ नृपेणाथ राजानं प्रति च क्रुधा .. 33 ..
15.10.m: Thus disputing, the two stayed for three nights. / Having been slighted by the king, then, in anger toward the king,

15.10.s:
ūcatuḥ kupito vākyaṃ sāmarṣau nṛpatiṃ prati ..
avamanyase nau yasmāttvaṃ na nirgacchasi mandirāt .. 34 ..
15.10.d:
ऊचतुः कुपितो वाक्यं सामर्षौ नृपतिं प्रति ..
अवमन्यसे नौ यस्मात्त्वं न निर्गच्छसि मन्दिरात् .. 34 ..
15.10.m: infuriated, filled with indignation, they spoke words against the king: / “Since you disregard the two of us and do not come out of the palace,

15.10.s:
śāstā bhavānprajānāṃ hi na nyāyena niyokṣyati ..
bhaviṣyati bhavāṃstasmātkṛkalāso na saṃśayaḥ .. 35 ..
15.10.d:
शास्ता भवान्प्रजानां हि न न्यायेन नियोक्ष्यति ..
भविष्यति भवांस्तस्मात्कृकलासो न संशयः .. 35 ..
15.10.m: you, as ruler, will surely not govern the subjects with justice! / Therefore, you will become a chameleon, there is no doubt!”

15.10.s:
evaṃ śaptvā tadā viprāvanyasmai gāṃ pradāya tau ..
kṣudhitau khedasaṃyuktau svagṛhaṃ gantumudyatau ..36..
15.10.d:
एवं शप्त्वा तदा विप्रावन्यस्मै गां प्रदाय तौ ..
क्षुधितौ खेदसंयुक्तौ स्वगृहं गन्तुमुद्यतौ ..36..
15.10.m: Having cursed him thus, giving the cow to someone else, / hungry and distressed, the two brahmins set out to go to their own homes.

15.10.s:
prasthitau tau nṛgo dvāra āgatya samupasthitaḥ ..
daṃḍavatpraṇipatyā''śu kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata .. 37 ..
15.10.d:
प्रस्थितौ तौ नृगो द्वार आगत्य समुपस्थितः ..
दंडवत्प्रणिपत्या'ऽशु कृतांजलिरभाषत .. 37 ..
15.10.m: As they were departing, Nṛga, coming to the gate, approached them; / bowing low like a stick, he quickly spoke with folded hands:

15.10.s:
amoghavacanā yūyaṃ tattathā na tadanyathā ..
mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā śāpāṃta upadiśyatām .. 38 ..
15.10.d:
अमोघवचना यूयं तत्तथा न तदन्यथा ..
ममोपरि कृपां कृत्वा शापांत उपदिश्यताम् .. 38 ..
15.10.m: “Your words are unfailing; that is so, it cannot be otherwise. / Showing compassion toward me, please instruct me as to the end of the curse!”

15.10.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ūcaturvacanaṃ nṛpam ..
dvāparasya yugasyāntaṃ bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ .. 39 ..
15.10.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऊचतुर्वचनं नृपम् ..
द्वापरस्य युगस्यान्तं भगवान्देवकीसुतः .. 39 ..
15.10.m: Hearing that word of his, the two spoke words to the king: / “At the end of the Dvāpara age, the blessed Son of Devakī,

15.10.s:
vasudevagṛhe rājanharirāvirbhaviṣyati ..
tasya saṃsparśanādeva śāpamuktirbhaviṣyati .. 7.4.10.40 ..
15.10.d:
वसुदेवगृहे राजन्हरिराविर्भविष्यति ..
तस्य संस्पर्शनादेव शापमुक्तिर्भविष्यति .. 7.4.10.40 ..
15.10.m: Hari, will appear in the house of Vasudeva, O king. / By his very touch, there will be release from the curse!”

15.10.s:
ityuktvā tau tadā viprau prayātau svaniveśanam ..
rājā bahuvidhānbhogānbhuktvā dattvā ca bhūriśaḥ .. .. 41 ..
15.10.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तौ तदा विप्रौ प्रयातौ स्वनिवेशनम् ..
राजा बहुविधान्भोगान्भुक्त्वा दत्त्वा च भूरिशः .. .. 41 ..
15.10.m: Having spoken thus, the two brahmins then departed to their own dwellings. / The king, having enjoyed various pleasures and given abundantly,

15.10.s:
iṣṭvā ca vividhairyajñaiḥ kāladharmamupeyivān ..
tataḥ sa gatavānviprā dharmarājaniveśanam .. 42 ..
15.10.d:
इष्ट्वा च विविधैर्यज्ञैः कालधर्ममुपेयिवान् ..
ततः स गतवान्विप्रा धर्मराजनिवेशनम् .. 42 ..
15.10.m: and having sacrificed with various sacrifices, attained the state subject to time. / Then he went, O brahmins, to the abode of the King of Dharma.

15.10.s:
satkṛtyokto yamenātha svāgatena nṛpottamaḥ ..
prathamaṃ sukṛtaṃ rājannathavā duṣkṛtaṃ tvayā ..
bhoktavyamiti me brūhi tatte saṃpādyate mayā .. 43 ..
15.10.d:
सत्कृत्योक्तो यमेनाथ स्वागतेन नृपोत्तमः ..
प्रथमं सुकृतं राजन्नथवा दुष्कृतं त्वया ..
भोक्तव्यमिति मे ब्रूहि तत्ते संपाद्यते मया .. 43 ..
15.10.m: Having honored him with a welcome, the best of kings was then addressed by Yama: / “Is your good deed to be experienced first, O king, or your bad deed? / Tell me, so that it may be brought about for you by me.”

15.10.s:
.. nṛga uvāca .. ..
yadyasti duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcitprathamaṃ pratipādaya ..
anujñāto yamenaivaṃ kṛkalāso bhaveti vai ..
tato varṣasahasrāṇi kṛkalāsatvamāptavān .. 44 ..
15.10.d:
.. नृग उवाच .. ..
यद्यस्ति दुष्कृतं किंचित्प्रथमं प्रतिपादय ..
अनुज्ञातो यमेनैवं कृकलासो भवेति वै ..
ततो वर्षसहस्राणि कृकलासत्वमाप्तवान् .. 44 ..
15.10.m:
Nṛga said:
“If there is any bad deed, assign it first.” / Permitted thus by Yama with the words, “Become a chameleon,” / he then underwent the state of being a chameleon for thousands of years.

15.10.s:
ekasmindivase viprāḥ sarve yadukumārakāḥ ..
vanaṃ jagmurmṛgānhantuṃ sarve kṛṣṇasamanvitāḥ .. 45 ..
15.10.d:
एकस्मिन्दिवसे विप्राः सर्वे यदुकुमारकाः ..
वनं जग्मुर्मृगान्हन्तुं सर्वे कृष्णसमन्विताः .. 45 ..
15.10.m: One day, O brahmins, all the young Yadu princes, / accompanied by Kṛṣṇa, went to the forest to hunt deer.

15.10.s:
tṛṣārdditāśca madhyāhne vicinvaṃto jalaṃ hrade ..
satvaṃ ca sumahattatra kṛkalāsaṃ ca saṃsthitam .. 46 ..
15.10.d:
तृषार्द्दिताश्च मध्याह्ने विचिन्वंतो जलं ह्रदे ..
सत्वं च सुमहत्तत्र कृकलासं च संस्थितम् .. 46 ..
15.10.m: Tormented by thirst at midday, searching for water in a pool, / [they saw] a huge creature, a chameleon, dwelling there.

15.10.s:
cakruścoddharaṇe tasya yatnaṃ yadukumārakāḥ ..
ākṛṣyamāṇaḥ sa tadā gurutvānna cacāla ha .. 47 ..
15.10.d:
चक्रुश्चोद्धरणे तस्य यत्नं यदुकुमारकाः ..
आकृष्यमाणः स तदा गुरुत्वान्न चचाल ह .. 47 ..
15.10.m: The young Yadu princes made an effort to pull it out. / Being pulled, it did not stir on account of its heavy weight.

15.10.s:
yadā na śekuste sarva ācakhyuḥ kṛṣṇarāmayoḥ ..
dadarśa taṃ tadā kṛṣṇo nṛgaṃ matvā hasanniva .. 48 ..
15.10.d:
यदा न शेकुस्ते सर्व आचख्युः कृष्णरामयोः ..
ददर्श तं तदा कृष्णो नृगं मत्वा हसन्निव .. 48 ..
15.10.m: When they were unable, they all told Kṛṣṇa and Rāma. / Kṛṣṇa then looked upon it, knowing [him] to be Nṛga, as if smiling.

15.10.s:
cikṣepa vāmahastena līlayaiva jagatpatiḥ ..
sa saṃspṛṣṭo bhagavatā vimuktaḥ śāpabaṃdhanāt ..49..
15.10.d:
चिक्षेप वामहस्तेन लीलयैव जगत्पतिः ..
स संस्पृष्टो भगवता विमुक्तः शापबंधनात् ..49..
15.10.m: The Lord of the Universe cast it up with his left hand in mere sport. / Touched by the Lord, he was freed from the bond of the curse.

15.10.s:
tyaktvā kalevaraṃ rājā divyamālyānulepanaḥ ..
kṛtāṃjaliruvācedaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ .. 7.4.10.50 ..
15.10.d:
त्यक्त्वा कलेवरं राजा दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपनः ..
कृतांजलिरुवाचेदं भक्त्या परमया युतः .. 7.4.10.50 ..
15.10.m: Having shed the body, the king, adorned with celestial garlands and unguents, / joined his palms and spoke thus, filled with supreme devotion:

15.10.s:
namaste jagadādhāra sargasthityaṃtakāriṇe ..
sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe'naṃtaśaktaye .. 51 ..
15.10.d:
नमस्ते जगदाधार सर्गस्थित्यंतकारिणे ..
सहस्रशिरसे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणेऽनंतशक्तये .. 51 ..
15.10.m: "Salutations to you, O support of the universe, cause of creation, maintenance, and destruction! / To you of a thousand heads, to Brahman of infinite power!"

15.10.s:
evaṃ saṃstuvataḥ prāha bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ ..
dadāmi te varaṃ tuṣṭo yatte manasi varttate .. 52 ..
15.10.d:
एवं संस्तुवतः प्राह भगवान्देवकीसुतः ..
ददामि ते वरं तुष्टो यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते .. 52 ..
15.10.m: To him thus praising, the Lord, the son of Devakī, said: / "Being pleased, I grant you a boon, whatever is in your heart.

15.10.s:
yāhi puṇyakṛtām̐llokāndarśanātsparśanācca me ..
evamuktaḥ sa devena saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ .. 53 ..
15.10.d:
याहि पुण्यकृताम्̐ल्लोकान्दर्शनात्स्पर्शनाच्च मे ..
एवमुक्तः स देवेन संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः .. 53 ..
15.10.m: Go to the worlds of the meritorious through seeing and touching me." / Thus addressed by the God, his bodily hair stood on end with delight.

15.10.s:
uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si yadi deyo varo mama ..
gartteyaṃ mama nāmnā tu khyātiṃ gacchatu keśava .. 54 ..
15.10.d:
उवाच यदि तुष्टोऽसि यदि देयो वरो मम ..
गर्त्तेयं मम नाम्ना तु ख्यातिं गच्छतु केशव .. 54 ..
15.10.m: He said: "If you are pleased, if a boon is to be given to me, / then let this pit become renowned by my name, O Keśava!

15.10.s:
yaḥ snātvā parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati ..
tvatprasādena goviṃda viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchatu .. 55 ..
15.10.d:
यः स्नात्वा परया भक्त्या पितॄन्संतर्पयिष्यति ..
त्वत्प्रसादेन गोविंद विष्णुलोकं स गच्छतु .. 55 ..
15.10.m: Whoever, having bathed with supreme devotion, shall satiate the ancestors, / let him, by your grace, O Govinda, go to the world of Viṣṇu."

15.10.s: evamuktvā sa bhagavānpunardvārāvatīmagāt .. 56 ..
15.10.d: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्पुनर्द्वारावतीमगात् .. 56 ..
15.10.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord went back to Dvārāvatī.

15.10.s:
sa ca rājā vimānena divyamālyānulepanaḥ ..
jagāma bhavanaṃ viṣṇorvibudhairanusaṃstutaḥ .. 57 ..
15.10.d:
स च राजा विमानेन दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपनः ..
जगाम भवनं विष्णोर्विबुधैरनुसंस्तुतः .. 57 ..
15.10.m: And the king, adorned with celestial garlands and unguents, / went by aerial chariot to the abode of Viṣṇu, praised by the gods.

15.10.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tadāprabhṛti vipreṃdrāḥ sa kūpo nṛgasaṃjñayā ..
varadānācca kṛṣṇasya pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām .. .. 58 ..
15.10.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तदाप्रभृति विप्रेंद्राः स कूपो नृगसंज्ञया ..
वरदानाच्च कृष्णस्य पावनः सर्वदेहिनाम् .. .. 58 ..
15.10.m: Prahlāda said: / From then on, O best of brahmins, that well, called by the name of Nṛga / and by virtue of Kṛṣṇa's boon, is a purifier of all embodied beings.

15.10.s:
tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭhā hyarghyaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi ..
phalapuṣpākṣatairyuktaṃ caṃdanena ca bhūsurāḥ .. 59 ..
15.10.d:
तत्र गत्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठा ह्यर्घ्यं दद्याद्यथाविधि ..
फलपुष्पाक्षतैर्युक्तं चंदनेन च भूसुराः .. 59 ..
15.10.m: Going there, O best of the twice-born, one should offer the arghya according to rule, / accompanied by fruits, flowers, unbroken grains, and sandalwood, O earthly gods:

15.10.s:
namaste viśvarūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane ..
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa kūpe'sminnṛgasaṃjñake .. 7.4.10.60 ..
15.10.d:
नमस्ते विश्वरूपाय विष्णवे परमात्मने ..
अर्घ्यं गृहाण देवेश कूपेऽस्मिन्नृगसंज्ञके .. 7.4.10.60 ..
15.10.m: "Salutations to you of universal form, to Viṣṇu, the Supreme Self! / Accept the arghya, O Lord of gods, at this well named after Nṛga."

15.10.s:
tataḥ snāyāddvijaśreṣṭhā mṛdamālipya pāṇinā ..
saṃtarpayetpitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathākramāt .. .. 61 ..
15.10.d:
ततः स्नायाद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा मृदमालिप्य पाणिना ..
संतर्पयेत्पितॄन्देवान्मनुष्यांश्च यथाक्रमात् .. .. 61 ..
15.10.m: Then one should bathe, O best of the twice-born, smearing clay with the hand, / and satiate the ancestors, the gods, and humans in due order.

15.10.s:
tataḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyāddakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ .. 62 ..
15.10.d:
ततः श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत पितॄणां श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
विप्रेभ्यो भोजनं दद्याद्दक्षिणां च स्वशक्तितः .. 62 ..
15.10.m: Then, endowed with faith, one should perform the śrāddha of the ancestors. / One should give food to brahmins and a sacrificial fee according to one's capacity.

15.10.s:
viśeṣataḥ pradātavyā savatsā gauḥ svalaṃkṛtā ..
śayyā sopaskarāṃ dadyādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 63 ..
15.10.d:
विशेषतः प्रदातव्या सवत्सा गौः स्वलंकृता ..
शय्या सोपस्करां दद्याद्विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति .. 63 ..
15.10.m: Especially, a well-adorned cow along with its calf should be given, / and a bed with its furnishings should be given, [saying,] 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me.'

15.10.s:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca sadā tattīravāsinām ..
dadyāddānaṃ svaśaktyā ca vitta śāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..64..
15.10.d:
दीनांधकृपणानां च सदा तत्तीरवासिनाम् ..
दद्याद्दानं स्वशक्त्या च वित्त शाठ्यविवर्जितः ..64..
15.10.m: And to the poor, the blind, and the wretched who always dwell on its banks, / one should give gifts according to one's means, free from miserliness in wealth.

15.10.s:
snānamātreṇa viprendrā labhedgodānajaṃ phalam..
pitṛṇāṃ śrāddhadānena viyoniṃ na ca gacchati ..65..
15.10.d:
स्नानमात्रेण विप्रेन्द्रा लभेद्गोदानजं फलम्..
पितृणां श्राद्धदानेन वियोनिं न च गच्छति ..65..
15.10.m: By mere ablution, O best of brahmins, one obtains the fruit born of the gift of a cow. / By offering the śrāddha to the ancestors, one does not go to a degraded womb.

15.10.s:
kṛkalāse kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yenaiva tarpaṇaṃ tathā ..
sa gacchedviṣṇulokaṃ tu pitṛbhiḥ sahito naraḥ .. 66 ..
15.10.d:
कृकलासे कृतं श्राद्धं येनैव तर्पणं तथा ..
स गच्छेद्विष्णुलोकं तु पितृभिः सहितो नरः .. 66 ..
15.10.m: By whomsoever the śrāddha as well as the libation is performed at Kṛkalāsa, / that man shall go to the world of Viṣṇu together with his ancestors.

15.10.s:
tathā manorathāvāptiryātrā ca saphalā bhavet ..
sarvatīrthaphalāvāptiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 67 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kṛkalāsāparanāmakanṛga tīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 10 .. .. cha ..
15.10.d:
तथा मनोरथावाप्तिर्यात्रा च सफला भवेत् ..
सर्वतीर्थफलावाप्तिं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 67 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये कृकलासापरनामकनृग तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम दशमोऽध्यायः .. 10 .. .. छ ..
15.10.m:
Likewise, the attainment of desires and a fruitful pilgrimage shall take place; / he obtains the fruit of all sacred fords; there is no doubt in this.
Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled "Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford of Nṛga, Otherwise Named Kṛkalāsa," in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.11.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ viṣṇupadodbhavam ..
yasya darśanamātreṇa gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet .. 1 ..
15.11.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तीर्थं विष्णुपदोद्भवम् ..
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण गंगास्नानफलं लभेत् .. 1 ..
15.11.m: Prahlāda said: / Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go to the sacred ford arisen from the foot of Viṣṇu, / by the mere sight of which one obtains the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā;

15.11.s:
yasyotpattirmayā pūrvaṃ kathitā dvijasattamāḥ ..
yasya saṃsmaraṇādeva kīrtanātpāpanāśanam .. 2 ..
15.11.d:
यस्योत्पत्तिर्मया पूर्वं कथिता द्विजसत्तमाः ..
यस्य संस्मरणादेव कीर्तनात्पापनाशनम् .. 2 ..
15.11.m: whose origin was told by me previously, O best of the twice-born; / by the mere remembering and extolling of which comes the destruction of sin;

15.11.s:
hariṇā yā samānītā rukmiṇyarthe mahātmanā ..
yasyā gaṇḍūṣamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
15.11.d:
हरिणा या समानीता रुक्मिण्यर्थे महात्मना ..
यस्या गण्डूषमात्रेण हयमेधफलं लभेत् .. 3 ..
15.11.m: which was brought by the noble Hari for the sake of Rukmiṇī, / by a mere mouthful of whose [water] one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice;

15.11.s:
viṣṇoḥ pādaprasūtāyā vaiṣṇavīti ca viśrutā ..
tatra gatvā mahābhāga gṛhītvā'rghyaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 4 ..
15.11.d:
विष्णोः पादप्रसूताया वैष्णवीति च विश्रुता ..
तत्र गत्वा महाभाग गृहीत्वाऽर्घ्यं विधानतः .. 4 ..
15.11.m: born from the foot of Viṣṇu and renowned as Vaiṣṇavī. / Going there, O highly fortunate one, taking the arghya according to the precept:

15.11.s:
namasye tvāṃ bhagavati viṣṇupādatalodbhave ..
gṛhāṇārghyamidaṃ devi gaṃge tvaṃ hariṇā saha .. 5 ..
15.11.d:
नमस्ये त्वां भगवति विष्णुपादतलोद्भवे ..
गृहाणार्घ्यमिदं देवि गंगे त्वं हरिणा सह .. 5 ..
15.11.m: "I bow to you, O divine one, arisen from beneath the foot of Viṣṇu! / Accept this arghya, O goddess Gaṅgā, together with Hari!"

15.11.s:
ityuccārya dvijaśreṣṭhā mṛdamālabhya pāṇinā ..
prāṅmukhaḥ saṃyato bhūtvā snānaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ .. 6 ..
15.11.d:
इत्युच्चार्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा मृदमालभ्य पाणिना ..
प्राङ्मुखः संयतो भूत्वा स्नानं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः .. 6 ..
15.11.m: Uttering this, O best of the twice-born, smearing clay with the hand, / facing east and restrained, one should bathe unweariedly.

15.11.s:
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpitavyaṃ tilākṣataiḥ ..
upahṛtyopahārāṃśca hyāhūya brāhmaṇāṃstataḥ .. 7 ..
15.11.d:
देवान्पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च तर्पितव्यं तिलाक्षतैः ..
उपहृत्योपहारांश्च ह्याहूय ब्राह्मणांस्ततः .. 7 ..
