15.11.m: The gods, ancestors, and humans are to be satiated with sesame seeds and unbroken grains. / Then, presenting offerings and having invited brahmins,

15.11.s:
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
yathoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 8 ..
15.11.d:
श्रद्धया परया युक्तः श्राद्धं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
यथोक्तां दक्षिणां दद्यात्सुवर्णं रजतं तथा .. 8 ..
15.11.m: the wise man, endowed with supreme faith, should perform the śrāddha. / He should give the prescribed sacrificial fee, as well as gold and silver.

15.11.s:
dīnāndha kṛpaṇānāñca dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ ..
viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ suvarṇaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 9 ..
15.11.d:
दीनान्ध कृपणानाञ्च दानं देयं स्वशक्तितः ..
विशेषतः प्रदातव्यं सुवर्णं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 9 ..
15.11.m: A gift is to be given to the poor, the blind, and the wretched according to one's capacity. / Gold should especially be given, O best of the twice-born.

15.11.s:
upānahau tato deye jalakumbhaṃ dvijātaye ..
dadhyodanaṃ salavaṇaṃ śākajīrakasaṃyutam .. 7.4.11.10 ..
15.11.d:
उपानहौ ततो देये जलकुम्भं द्विजातये ..
दध्योदनं सलवणं शाकजीरकसंयुतम् .. 7.4.11.10 ..
15.11.m: Then sandals and a water-pot should be given to a twice-born, / [and] curd-rice with salt, accompanied by vegetables and cumin.

15.11.s:
raktavastraiḥ kaṃcukībhī rukmiṇīṃ paridhāpayet ..
viprapatnīśca viprāṃśca viṣṇurmeprīyatāmiti.. 11 ..
15.11.d:
रक्तवस्त्रैः कंचुकीभी रुक्मिणीं परिधापयेत् ..
विप्रपत्नीश्च विप्रांश्च विष्णुर्मेप्रीयतामिति.. 11 ..
15.11.m: One should clothe Rukmiṇī, the wives of brahmins, and the brahmins / with red garments and bodices, [saying,] 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me.'

15.11.s:
evaṃ kṛte dvija śreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ..
pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirgayāśrāddhena vai yathā .. 12 ..
15.11.d:
एवं कृते द्विज श्रेष्ठाः कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः..
पितॄणामक्षया तृप्तिर्गयाश्राद्धेन वै यथा .. 12 ..
15.11.m: When this is done, O best of the twice-born, a person becomes one who has achieved his purpose; / there is inexhaustible satisfaction for the ancestors, just as by a śrāddha at Gayā.

15.11.s:
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāyānti pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ ..
jīvate sa śriyāyuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 13 ..
15.11.d:
वैष्णवं लोकमायान्ति पितरस्त्रिकुलोद्भवाः ..
जीवते स श्रियायुक्तः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः .. 13 ..
15.11.m: The ancestors born of three families attain the Vaiṣṇava world. / He lives endowed with fortune, accompanied by sons and grandsons.

15.11.s:
prītaḥ sadā bhavettasya rukmiṇyā saha keśavaḥ ..
yacchate vāñchitānsarvānaihikāmuṣmikānprabhuḥ .. 14 ..
15.11.d:
प्रीतः सदा भवेत्तस्य रुक्मिण्या सह केशवः ..
यच्छते वाञ्छितान्सर्वानैहिकामुष्मिकान्प्रभुः .. 14 ..
15.11.m: Keśava along with Rukmiṇī will always be pleased with him; / the Lord bestows all desires, both of this world and the next.

15.11.s:
etanmāhātmyamatulaṃ viṣṇupādodbhavaṃ tathā ..
yaḥ śṛṇoti harau bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyate .. 15 ..
15.11.d:
एतन्माहात्म्यमतुलं विष्णुपादोद्भवं तथा ..
यः शृणोति हरौ भक्त्या सर्वपापैः स मुच्यते .. 15 ..
15.11.m: Whoever hears with devotion to Hari this matchless greatness born of Viṣṇu's foot, / he is released from all sins.

15.11.s:
śrutvā'dhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 16 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye viṣṇupadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāya... .. 11 ..
15.11.d:
श्रुत्वाऽध्यायमिमं पुण्यं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 16 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये विष्णुपदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकादशोऽध्याय... .. 11 ..
15.11.m:
Having heard this sacred chapter, he is completely freed from all sins.
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled "Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford of Viṣṇupada," in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.12.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā gopracāramataḥ param ..
yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhedgodānajaṃ phalam .. 1 ..
15.12.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा गोप्रचारमतः परम् ..
यत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या लभेद्गोदानजं फलम् .. 1 ..
15.12.m: Prahlāda said: / Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go next to Gopracāra, / where a person, bathing with devotion, obtains the fruit born of the gift of a cow;

15.12.s:
yatra snāto jagannātho nabhasye daivatairvṛtaḥ ..
kaṭadānaṃ ca tatproktaṃ dvādaśyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 2 ..
15.12.d:
यत्र स्नातो जगन्नाथो नभस्ये दैवतैर्वृतः ..
कटदानं च तत्प्रोक्तं द्वादश्यां द्विजसत्तमाः .. 2 ..
15.12.m: where the Lord of the Universe bathed in the month of Nabhasya, surrounded by deities. / And that gift of a mat is prescribed on the twelfth day, O best of the twice-born.

15.12.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ tu tatra daityendrā'bhavadvai gopracārakam ..
tīrthaṃ kathaya tattvena yatra snāto janārddanaḥ .. 3 ..
15.12.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं तु तत्र दैत्येन्द्राऽभवद्वै गोप्रचारकम् ..
तीर्थं कथय तत्त्वेन यत्र स्नातो जनार्द्दनः .. 3 ..
15.12.m: The seers said: / How indeed, O lord of Daityas, did the sacred ford Gopracāraka arise there? / Tell truly of the sacred ford where Janārdana bathed. (3)

15.12.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
hate kaṃse bhojarāje kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā ..
ugrasene cābhiṣikte madhupuryyāṃ mahātmanā .. 4 ..
15.12.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
हते कंसे भोजराजे कृष्णेनामिततेजसा ..
उग्रसेने चाभिषिक्ते मधुपुर्य्यां महात्मना .. 4 ..
15.12.m: Prahlāda said: / When Kaṃsa, king of the Bhojas, was slain by Kṛṣṇa of boundless splendour, / and Ugrasena was consecrated in Madhupurī by the great-souled one, (4)

15.12.s:
uddhavaṃ preṣayāmāsa gokule gokulapriyaḥ ..
suhṛdāṃ priyakāmārthaṃ gopagopījanasya ca .. 5 ..
15.12.d:
उद्धवं प्रेषयामास गोकुले गोकुलप्रियः ..
सुहृदां प्रियकामार्थं गोपगोपीजनस्य च .. 5 ..
15.12.m: he who loved Gokula sent Uddhava to Gokula / for the sake of bringing joy to his friends and to the cowherds and cowherdesses. (5)

15.12.s:
namaskṛtya ca govidaṃ prayayau naṃdagokulam ..
sa tatsadṛśaveṣeṇa vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 6 ..
15.12.d:
नमस्कृत्य च गोविदं प्रययौ नंदगोकुलम् ..
स तत्सदृशवेषेण वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः .. 6 ..
15.12.m: Bowing to Govinda, he set forth for Nanda's Gokula, / wearing an appearance like his, with garments and jewelled ornaments. (6)

15.12.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā divasasyāṃte goviṃdānucaraṃ priyam ..
uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsa vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 7 ..
15.12.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा दिवसस्यांते गोविंदानुचरं प्रियम् ..
उद्धवं पूजयामास वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः .. 7 ..
15.12.m: Seeing that beloved attendant of Govinda at the end of the day, / [Nanda] honoured Uddhava with garments and jewelled ornaments. (7)

15.12.s:
taṃ bhuktavaṃtaṃ viśrāṃtaṃ yaśodā putravatsalā ..
ānaṃdabāṣpapūrṇākṣī papracchānāmayaṃ hareḥ .. 8 ..
15.12.d:
तं भुक्तवंतं विश्रांतं यशोदा पुत्रवत्सला ..
आनंदबाष्पपूर्णाक्षी पप्रच्छानामयं हरेः .. 8 ..
15.12.m: When he had eaten and rested, Yaśodā, affectionate toward her son, / with eyes filled with tears of joy, asked after Hari's welfare: (8)

15.12.s:
kacciddhi staḥ sukhaṃ putrau rāmakṛṣṇau yadūttamau ..
kaccitsmarati goviṃdo vayasyāngopabālakān .. 9 ..
15.12.d:
कच्चिद्धि स्तः सुखं पुत्रौ रामकृष्णौ यदूत्तमौ ..
कच्चित्स्मरति गोविंदो वयस्यान्गोपबालकान् .. 9 ..
15.12.m: "Are our two sons, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, best of the Yadus, well? / Does Govinda remember his friends, the cowherd boys? (9)

15.12.s:
kaccideṣyati goviṃdo gokulaṃ madhureśvaraḥ ..
tārayiṣyati putro'sau gokulaṃ vṛjinārṇavāt .. 7.4.12.10 ..
15.12.d:
कच्चिदेष्यति गोविंदो गोकुलं मधुरेश्वरः ..
तारयिष्यति पुत्रोऽसौ गोकुलं वृजिनार्णवात् .. 7.4.12.10 ..
15.12.m: Will Govinda, the lord of Mathurā, come to Gokula? / Will that son carry Gokula across the ocean of sorrow?" (10)

15.12.s:
ityuktvā bāṣpapūrṇākṣau yaśodā naṃda eva ca ..
dīrghaṃ rurudaturdīnau putrasnehavaśaṃgatau .. 11 ..
15.12.d:
इत्युक्त्वा बाष्पपूर्णाक्षौ यशोदा नंद एव च ..
दीर्घं रुरुदतुर्दीनौ पुत्रस्नेहवशंगतौ .. 11 ..
15.12.m: Having said this, with eyes filled with tears, both Yaśodā and Nanda / wept aloud, wretched, overcome with love for their son. (11)

15.12.s:
uddhavastau tato dṛṣṭvā prāṇasaṃśayamāgatau ..
madhuraiḥ kṛṣṇasaṃdeśaiḥ snehayuktairajīvayat .. 12 ..
15.12.d:
उद्धवस्तौ ततो दृष्ट्वा प्राणसंशयमागतौ ..
मधुरैः कृष्णसंदेशैः स्नेहयुक्तैरजीवयत् .. 12 ..
15.12.m: Seeing them both brought to the brink of losing their lives, / Uddhava then revived them with sweet, loving messages from Kṛṣṇa: (12)

15.12.s:
namaskaroti bhavatīṃ bhavaṃtaṃ ca sahāgrajaḥ ..
anāmayaṃ pṛṣṭavāṃśca tau ca kṣemeṇa tiṣṭhataḥ .. 13 ..
15.12.d:
नमस्करोति भवतीं भवंतं च सहाग्रजः ..
अनामयं पृष्टवांश्च तौ च क्षेमेण तिष्ठतः .. 13 ..
15.12.m: "He bows to you, [mother,] and to you, [father,] together with his elder brother; / he has asked after your welfare, and the two of them are faring well. (13)

15.12.s:
kṣiprameṣyati dāśārho rāmeṇa sahito vibhuḥ ..
atrāgatya jagannātho vidhāsyati ca vo hitam .. 14 ..
15.12.d:
क्षिप्रमेष्यति दाशार्हो रामेण सहितो विभुः ..
अत्रागत्य जगन्नाथो विधास्यति च वो हितम् .. 14 ..
15.12.m: The all-pervading Dāśārha will soon come together with Rāma; / having arrived here, the Lord of the World will bring about your welfare." (14)

15.12.s:
ityevaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃdeśaiḥ samāśvāsyoddhavastadā ..
sukhaṃ suṣvāpa śayane nandādyairabhinaṃditaḥ .. 15 ..
15.12.d:
इत्येवं कृष्णसंदेशैः समाश्वास्योद्धवस्तदा ..
सुखं सुष्वाप शयने नन्दाद्यैरभिनंदितः .. 15 ..
15.12.m: Comforting them thus with Kṛṣṇa's messages, Uddhava then / slept comfortably in bed, praised by Nanda and the others. (15)

15.12.s:
gopyastadā rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvāre naṃdasya vismitāḥ ..
ko'yaṃ ko'yamiti prāhuḥ kṛṣṇāgamanaśaṃkayā .. 16 ..
15.12.d:
गोप्यस्तदा रथं दृष्ट्वा द्वारे नंदस्य विस्मिताः ..
कोऽयं कोऽयमिति प्राहुः कृष्णागमनशंकया .. 16 ..
15.12.m: Then the cowherdesses, seeing the chariot at Nanda's door, were astonished. / Suspecting Kṛṣṇa had arrived, they said, "Who is this? Who is this?" (16)

15.12.s:
gopālarājasya gṛhe rathenādityavarcasā ..
samāgato mahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇaveṣānugastathā .. 17 ..
15.12.d:
गोपालराजस्य गृहे रथेनादित्यवर्चसा ..
समागतो महाबाहुः कृष्णवेषानुगस्तथा .. 17 ..
15.12.m: "At the house of the king of cowherds, by means of a chariot radiant like the sun, / a mighty-armed one has arrived, dressed just like Kṛṣṇa." (17)

15.12.s:
parasparaṃ samāgamya sarvāstā vrajayoṣitaḥ ..
vivikte kṛṣṇadūtaṃ taṃ papracchuḥ śokakarṣitāḥ .. 18 .. ..
15.12.d:
परस्परं समागम्य सर्वास्ता व्रजयोषितः ..
विविक्ते कृष्णदूतं तं पप्रच्छुः शोककर्षिताः .. 18 .. ..
15.12.m: Coming together, all those women of Vraja, / emaciated by grief, questioned Kṛṣṇa's messenger in private: (18)

15.12.s:
śrīgopya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmāttvamiha saṃprāptaḥ kiṃ te kāryyamihādya vai ..
dasyurūpapraticchanno hyasmānsaṃhartumicchasi .. 19 ..
15.12.d:
श्रीगोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मात्त्वमिह संप्राप्तः किं ते कार्य्यमिहाद्य वै ..
दस्युरूपप्रतिच्छन्नो ह्यस्मान्संहर्तुमिच्छसि .. 19 ..
15.12.m: The venerable cowherdesses said: / "Why have you arrived here? What is your business here today? / Disguised in the form of a bandit, do you wish to destroy us? (19)

15.12.s:
pūrvameva hataṃ tena kṛṣṇena hṛdayādikam..
pāyayitvā'dharaviṣaṃ yoṣidvrātaṃ palāyitaḥ .. 7.4.12.20 ..
15.12.d:
पूर्वमेव हतं तेन कृष्णेन हृदयादिकम्..
पाययित्वाऽधरविषं योषिद्व्रातं पलायितः .. 7.4.12.20 ..
15.12.m: Already by that Kṛṣṇa our hearts and all were slain; / having made this flock of women drink the poison of his lips, he fled." (20)

15.12.s:
ityevamuktvā tā gopyo mumuhuḥ śokavihvalāḥ ..
īkṣaṃtyaḥ kṛṣṇadāsaṃ taṃ nipeturdharaṇītale .. 21 ..
15.12.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा ता गोप्यो मुमुहुः शोकविह्वलाः ..
ईक्षंत्यः कृष्णदासं तं निपेतुर्धरणीतले .. 21 ..
15.12.m: Having spoken thus, those cowherdesses swooned, overwhelmed by sorrow; / gazing upon that servant of Kṛṣṇa, they fell to the ground. (21)

15.12.s:
uddhavastaṃ janaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasnehahṛtāśayam ..
āśvāsayāmāsa tadā vākyaiḥ śrotrasukhāvahaiḥ .. 22 ..
15.12.d:
उद्धवस्तं जनं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णस्नेहहृताशयम् ..
आश्वासयामास तदा वाक्यैः श्रोत्रसुखावहैः .. 22 ..
15.12.m: Seeing those people whose minds were robbed by love for Kṛṣṇa, / Uddhava comforted them then with words pleasing to the ears: (21)

15.12.s:
.. uddhava uvāca .. ..
bhagavānapi dāśārhaḥ kandarpaśarapīḍitaḥ ..
na bhuṃkte na svapiti ca cintayanvastvaharniśam .. 23 ..
15.12.d:
.. उद्धव उवाच .. ..
भगवानपि दाशार्हः कन्दर्पशरपीडितः ..
न भुंक्ते न स्वपिति च चिन्तयन्वस्त्वहर्निशम् .. 23 ..
15.12.m: Uddhava said: / "The Blessed Lord Dāśārha too is afflicted by the arrows of the god of love; / thinking of you day and night, he does not eat and does not sleep." (23)

15.12.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya lalitā krodhamūrchitā ..
uddhavaṃ tāmranayanā provāca rudatī tadā .. 24 ..
15.12.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य ललिता क्रोधमूर्छिता ..
उद्धवं ताम्रनयना प्रोवाच रुदती तदा .. 24 ..
15.12.m: Hearing his words, Lalitā, faint with rage, / her eyes reddened, said weeping to Uddhava then: (24)

15.12.s:
.. lalitovāca .. ..
asatyo bhinnamaryyādaḥ krūraḥ krūrajanapriyaḥ ..
tvaṃ mā kṛthā naḥ purataḥ kathāṃ tasyā'kṛtātmanaḥ .. 25 ..
15.12.d:
.. ललितोवाच .. ..
असत्यो भिन्नमर्य्यादः क्रूरः क्रूरजनप्रियः ..
त्वं मा कृथा नः पुरतः कथां तस्याऽकृतात्मनः .. 25 ..
15.12.m: Lalitā said: / "Untruthful, a breaker of bounds, cruel, fond of cruel people— / do not speak in front of us the story of that base-minded one! (25)

15.12.s:
dhigdhikpāpasamācāro dhigdhigvai niṣṭhurāśayaḥ ..
hitvā yaḥ strījanaṃ mūḍho gato dvāravatīṃ hariḥ .. 26 .. ..
15.12.d:
धिग्धिक्पापसमाचारो धिग्धिग्वै निष्ठुराशयः ..
हित्वा यः स्त्रीजनं मूढो गतो द्वारवतीं हरिः .. 26 .. ..
15.12.m: Fie, fie on that one of sinful conduct! Fie, fie on that one of cruel intention! / That fool Hari who, abandoning the women, went to Dvāravatī!" (26)

15.12.s:
.. śyāmalovāca .. ..
kiṃ tasya mandabhāgyasya alpapuṇyasya durmateḥ ..
mā kurudhvaṃ kathāḥ sādhvyaḥ kathāṃ kathayatā'parām .. 27 .. ..
15.12.d:
.. श्यामलोवाच .. ..
किं तस्य मन्दभाग्यस्य अल्पपुण्यस्य दुर्मतेः ..
मा कुरुध्वं कथाः साध्व्यः कथां कथयताऽपराम् .. 27 .. ..
15.12.m: Śyāmalā said: / "What of that ill-fated one of little merit and wicked mind? / Do not tell stories of him, good ladies; tell another story!" (27)

15.12.s:
.. dhanyovāca .. ..
kenāyaṃ hi samānīto dūto duṣṭajanasya ca ..
yātu tena pathā pāpaḥ punarnāyāti yena ca ..28..
15.12.d:
.. धन्योवाच .. ..
केनायं हि समानीतो दूतो दुष्टजनस्य च ..
यातु तेन पथा पापः पुनर्नायाति येन च ..28..
15.12.m: Dhanyā said: / "By whom was this messenger of a wicked person brought here? / Let the wretch go by that same path by which he does not return again!" (28)

15.12.s:
.. viśākhovāca .. ..
na śīlaṃ na kulaṃ yasya nāsti pāpakṛtaṃ bhayam ..
tasya strīhanane sādhvyo jñāyate janma karma ca ..
hīnasya puruṣārthena tena saṃgo nirarthakaḥ .. 29 .. ..
15.12.d:
.. विशाखोवाच .. ..
न शीलं न कुलं यस्य नास्ति पापकृतं भयम् ..
तस्य स्त्रीहनने साध्व्यो ज्ञायते जन्म कर्म च ..
हीनस्य पुरुषार्थेन तेन संगो निरर्थकः .. 29 .. ..
15.12.m: Viśākhā said: / "He who has neither good conduct nor noble birth, and in whom there is no fear born of sin— / his birth and deeds are known in his slaying of women, O virtuous ladies; / association with him, devoid of human virtue, is useless." (29)

15.12.s:
.. rādhovāca .. ..
bhūtānāṃ ghātane yasya nāsti pāpakṛtaṃ bhayam ..
tasya strīhanane sādhvyaḥ śaṃkā kāpi na vidyate .. 7.4.12.30 ..
15.12.d:
.. राधोवाच .. ..
भूतानां घातने यस्य नास्ति पापकृतं भयम् ..
तस्य स्त्रीहनने साध्व्यः शंका कापि न विद्यते .. 7.4.12.30 ..
15.12.m: Rādhā said: / "He who has no fear born of sin in slaying living beings— / for him there is no hesitation whatsoever in slaying women, O virtuous ladies." (30)

15.12.s:
.. śaibyovāca .. ..
satyaṃ brūhi mahābhāga kiṃ karoti yadūttamaḥ ..
saṃgato nāgarastrībhirasmākaṃ kiṃ kathāṃ smaret .. 31 ..
15.12.d:
.. शैब्योवाच .. ..
सत्यं ब्रूहि महाभाग किं करोति यदूत्तमः ..
संगतो नागरस्त्रीभिरस्माकं किं कथां स्मरेत् .. 31 ..
15.12.m: Śaibyā said: / "Speak truly, O fortunate one: what is the best of Yadus doing? / United with urban women, would he remember any talk of us?" (31)

15.12.s:
.. padmovāca .. ..
kadoddhava mahābhāga nāgarījanavallabhaḥ ..
sameṣyatīha dāśārhaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ .. 32 ..
15.12.d:
.. पद्मोवाच .. ..
कदोद्धव महाभाग नागरीजनवल्लभः ..
समेष्यतीह दाशार्हः पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणः .. 32 ..
15.12.m: Padmā said: / "When, O fortunate Uddhava, will that Dāśārha, / the darling of city women, whose eyes are long like lotus petals, come here?" (32)

15.12.s:
.. bhadrovāca .. ..
hā kṛṣṇa hā gopavara hā gopījanavallabha ..
samuddhara mahābāho gopīḥ saṃsārasāgarāt.. 33 ..
15.12.d:
.. भद्रोवाच .. ..
हा कृष्ण हा गोपवर हा गोपीजनवल्लभ ..
समुद्धर महाबाहो गोपीः संसारसागरात्.. 33 ..
15.12.m: Bhadrā said: / "Ah, Kṛṣṇa! Ah, best of cowherds! Ah, beloved of the cowherdesses! / O mighty-armed one, rescue the cowherdesses from the ocean of worldly existence!" (33)

15.12.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
iti tā vividhairvākyairvilapaṃtyo vrajastriyaḥ ..
ruruduḥ susvaraṃ devyaḥ smaraṃtyaḥ kṛṣṇa ceṣṭitam .. 34 ..
15.12.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इति ता विविधैर्वाक्यैर्विलपंत्यो व्रजस्त्रियः ..
रुरुदुः सुस्वरं देव्यः स्मरंत्यः कृष्ण चेष्टितम् .. 34 ..
15.12.m: Prahlāda said: / Thus lamenting with diverse words, those women of Vraja, / the divine ladies, wept in a sweet voice, remembering the deeds of Kṛṣṇa. (34)

15.12.s:
tāsāṃ tadruditaṃ śrutvā bhaktisnehasamanvitaḥ ..
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā sādhusādhviti cābravīt .. 35 ..
15.12.d:
तासां तद्रुदितं श्रुत्वा भक्तिस्नेहसमन्वितः ..
विस्मयं परमं गत्वा साधुसाध्विति चाब्रवीत् .. 35 ..
15.12.m: Hearing their weeping, filled with devotion and love, / [Uddhava] experienced supreme astonishment and said, "Well done! Well done!" (35)

15.12.s:
.. uddhava uvāca .. ..
yaṃ na brahmā na ca haro na devā na maharṣayaḥ ..
svabhāvamanugacchaṃti sarvā dhanyā vrajastriyaḥ .. 36 ..
15.12.d:
.. उद्धव उवाच .. ..
यं न ब्रह्मा न च हरो न देवा न महर्षयः ..
स्वभावमनुगच्छंति सर्वा धन्या व्रजस्त्रियः .. 36 ..
15.12.m: Uddhava said: / "He whose nature neither Brahmā, nor Hara, nor the gods, nor the great seers can follow— / blessed are all the women of Vraja! (36)

15.12.s:
sarvāsāṃ saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ yauvanaṃ dhanam ..
yāsāṃ bhavedbhagavati bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī .. 37 ..
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
sādhu darśaya goviṃdaṃ sādhu darśaya vallabham ..
nayāsmānsādhu tatraiva yatra tiṣṭhati so'cyutaḥ .. 37 ..
15.12.d:
सर्वासां सफलं जन्म जीवितं यौवनं धनम् ..
यासां भवेद्भगवति भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी .. 37 ..
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
साधु दर्शय गोविंदं साधु दर्शय वल्लभम् ..
नयास्मान्साधु तत्रैव यत्र तिष्ठति सोऽच्युतः .. 37 ..
15.12.m:
Fruitful is the birth, life, youth, and wealth of all those / who possess unwavering devotion to the Blessed Lord." (37)
The cowherdesses said: / "Please, show us Govinda; please, show us our beloved! / Please, lead us right there where that Acyuta stays!" (38)

15.12.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tāsāṃ tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā tathā vilapitaṃ bahu ..
bāḍhamityeva tā ūca uddhavaḥ snehavihvalāḥ .. 39 ..
15.12.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तासां तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा तथा विलपितं बहु ..
बाढमित्येव ता ऊच उद्धवः स्नेहविह्वलाः .. 39 ..
15.12.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing their speech and their much lamenting, / Uddhava said, "So be it," to those women overwhelmed by love. (39)

15.12.s:
uddhavena samaṃ sarvāstatastā vrajayoṣitaḥ ..
anujagmurmudā yuktāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ .. 7.4.12.40 ..
15.12.d:
उद्धवेन समं सर्वास्ततस्ता व्रजयोषितः ..
अनुजग्मुर्मुदा युक्ताः कृष्णदर्शनलालसाः .. 7.4.12.40 ..
15.12.m: Then all those women of Vraja, together with Uddhava, / followed along, filled with joy, longing for the sight of Kṛṣṇa. (40)

15.12.s:
gāyantyaḥ priyagītāni tadbālacaritāni ca ..
jagmuḥ sahaiva śanakairuddhavena vrajāṃganāḥ .. 41 ..
15.12.d:
गायन्त्यः प्रियगीतानि तद्बालचरितानि च ..
जग्मुः सहैव शनकैरुद्धवेन व्रजांगनाः .. 41 ..
15.12.m: Singing favourite songs and his deeds as a child, / the women of Vraja went slowly along together with Uddhava. (41)

15.12.s:
yadupuryyāṃ tato dṛṣṭvā udyānavipināvalīḥ ..
adya devaṃ prapaśyāmaḥ kṛṣṇākhyaṃ naṃdanaṃdanam .. .. 42 ..
15.12.d:
यदुपुर्य्यां ततो दृष्ट्वा उद्यानविपिनावलीः ..
अद्य देवं प्रपश्यामः कृष्णाख्यं नंदनंदनम् .. .. 42 ..
15.12.m: Then, seeing rows of gardens and groves in the city of the Yadus, [they thought:] / "Today we shall see the god named Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda!" (42)

15.12.s:
dvāravatyāṃ tu gamanāddhyānāllakṣmīpatestadā ..
aśeṣakalmaṣānmuktā vidhvastākhilabandhanāḥ .. 43 ..
15.12.d:
द्वारवत्यां तु गमनाद्ध्यानाल्लक्ष्मीपतेस्तदा ..
अशेषकल्मषान्मुक्ता विध्वस्ताखिलबन्धनाः .. 43 ..
15.12.m: By going to Dvāravatī and meditating upon the Lord of Lakṣmī, / they were then freed from all sin, their every bond shattered.

15.12.s:
saṃprāptāstāstataḥ sarvāstīre mayasarasya ca ..
praṇipatyoddhavaḥ prāha gopikāḥ kṛṣṇadevatāḥ .. 44 ..
15.12.d:
संप्राप्तास्तास्ततः सर्वास्तीरे मयसरस्य च ..
प्रणिपत्योद्धवः प्राह गोपिकाः कृष्णदेवताः .. 44 ..
15.12.m: All of them then arrived at the bank of the lake of Maya. / Having bowed down, Uddhava said to the cowherd women whose deity was Kṛṣṇa:

15.12.s:
sthīyatāṃ mātaraścātrātraiveṣyati mahābhujaḥ ..
kṛṣṇaḥ kamalapatrākṣo vidhāsyati ca vo hitam .. 45 ..
15.12.d:
स्थीयतां मातरश्चात्रात्रैवेष्यति महाभुजः ..
कृष्णः कमलपत्राक्षो विधास्यति च वो हितम् .. 45 ..
15.12.m: "Mothers, stay here; right here the mighty-armed one will come. / Kṛṣṇa, whose eyes are like lotus petals, will bring about your welfare."

15.12.s:
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasyoddhava idaṃ cātra saraḥ sārasaśobhitam ..
saṃpūrṇaṃ paṃkajaiścitraiḥ kalhārakumudotpalaiḥ .. 46 .. ..
15.12.d:
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
कस्योद्धव इदं चात्र सरः सारसशोभितम् ..
संपूर्णं पंकजैश्चित्रैः कल्हारकुमुदोत्पलैः .. 46 .. ..
15.12.m:
The cowherd women said:
"Uddhava, whose is this lake adorned with cranes, / filled with wondrous lotuses—white water lilies, night-blooming lotuses, and blue lotuses?"

15.12.s:
.. uddhava uvāca .. ..
mayo nāma mahādaityo māyāvī lokaviśrutaḥ ..
kṛtaṃ tena saraḥ śubhraṃ tasya nāmnā ca viśrutam .. 47 ..
15.12.d:
.. उद्धव उवाच .. ..
मयो नाम महादैत्यो मायावी लोकविश्रुतः ..
कृतं तेन सरः शुभ्रं तस्य नाम्ना च विश्रुतम् .. 47 ..
15.12.m:
Uddhava said:
"There was a great Daitya named Maya, a master of illusion famed throughout the world. / By him this clear lake was made, and it is known by his name."

15.12.s:
.. śrīgopya ūcuḥ .. ..
śīghramānaya goviṃdaṃ sādhu darśaya cācyutam..
nayanānaṃdajananaṃ tāpatrayavināśanam .. 48 ..
15.12.d:
.. श्रीगोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
शीघ्रमानय गोविंदं साधु दर्शय चाच्युतम्..
नयनानंदजननं तापत्रयविनाशनम् .. 48 ..
15.12.m:
The cowherd women said:
"Bring Govinda quickly, and show us Acyuta, / the giver of joy to the eyes, the destroyer of the three miseries."

15.12.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tāsāṃ gopikānāṃ tadoddhavaḥ ..
dūtaiḥ samānayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śīghrayāyibhiḥ .. 49 ..
15.12.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तासां गोपिकानां तदोद्धवः ..
दूतैः समानयामास श्रीकृष्णं शीघ्रयायिभिः .. 49 ..
15.12.m: Hearing that statement of the cowherd women, Uddhava then / brought Śrī Kṛṣṇa through messengers traveling swiftly.

15.12.s:
āyāṃtaṃ śīghrayānena dṛṣṭvā devakinaṃdanam ..
bhrājamānaṃ suvapuṣā vanamālāvibhūṣitam .. .. 7.4.12.50 ..
15.12.d:
आयांतं शीघ्रयानेन दृष्ट्वा देवकिनंदनम् ..
भ्राजमानं सुवपुषा वनमालाविभूषितम् .. .. 7.4.12.50 ..
15.12.m: Seeing the son of Devakī arriving in a swift vehicle, / shining with a beautiful body, adorned with a garland of forest flowers,

15.12.s:
jvalatkirīṭamukuṭaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam..
śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābāhuṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam .. 51 ..
15.12.d:
ज्वलत्किरीटमुकुटं स्फुरन्मकरकुण्डलम्..
श्रीवत्सांकं महाबाहुं पीतकौशेयवाससम् .. 51 ..
15.12.m: with a blazing tiara and crown, with glittering makara-shaped earrings, / marked with the Śrīvatsa, mighty-armed, wearing yellow silk garments,

15.12.s:
ātapatrairvṛtaṃ mūrdhni saṃvṛtaṃ vṛṣṇipuṃgavaiḥ ..
saṃstutaṃ baṃdimukhyaiśca gītavāditranisvanaiḥ .. 52 ..
15.12.d:
आतपत्रैर्वृतं मूर्ध्नि संवृतं वृष्णिपुंगवैः ..
संस्तुतं बंदिमुख्यैश्च गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः .. 52 ..
15.12.m: covered overhead with parasols, surrounded by the foremost of the Vṛṣṇis, / praised by the chief bards with sounds of songs and musical instruments,

15.12.s:
paurajānapadairlokairvaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvato vṛtam ..
paśyantaṃ haṃsamithunaiḥ saraḥ sārasaśobhitam ..53 ..
15.12.d:
पौरजानपदैर्लोकैर्वैष्णवैः सर्वतो वृतम् ..
पश्यन्तं हंसमिथुनैः सरः सारसशोभितम् ..53 ..
15.12.m: surrounded on all sides by urban citizens, country folk, and Vaiṣṇavas, / gazing at the lake adorned with cranes and pairs of geese—

15.12.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā'cyutamāyāṃtaṃ lokakāṃtaṃ manoharam ..
priyaṃ priyāścirāddṛṣṭvā mumuhustā vrajāṃganāḥ .. 54 ..
15.12.d:
तं दृष्ट्वाऽच्युतमायांतं लोककांतं मनोहरम् ..
प्रियं प्रियाश्चिराद्दृष्ट्वा मुमुहुस्ता व्रजांगनाः .. 54 ..
15.12.m: seeing him, Acyuta, arriving, beloved of the world, captivating the mind, / seeing their beloved after a long time, the women of Vraja fainted.

15.12.s:
cirāya saṃjñāṃ saṃprāpya vilepuśca suduḥkhitāḥ ..
hā nātha kāṃta hā kṛṣṇa hā vrajeśa manohara ..55 ..
15.12.d:
चिराय संज्ञां संप्राप्य विलेपुश्च सुदुःखिताः ..
हा नाथ कांत हा कृष्ण हा व्रजेश मनोहर ..55 ..
15.12.m:
Having regained consciousness after a long time, deeply afflicted, they wailed:
"Ah, master! Ah, lover! Ah, Kṛṣṇa! Ah, charming lord of Vraja!

15.12.s:
saṃvardhito'si yairbālye krīḍito vatsapālakaiḥ ..
te'pi tvayā parityaktāḥ kathaṃ duṣṭo'si nirghṛṇaḥ .. 56 ..
15.12.d:
संवर्धितोऽसि यैर्बाल्ये क्रीडितो वत्सपालकैः ..
तेऽपि त्वया परित्यक्ताः कथं दुष्टोऽसि निर्घृणः .. 56 ..
15.12.m: By whom you were reared in childhood, [with whom] you played as cowherd boys— / they too have been abandoned by you! How have you become cruel and wicked?

15.12.s:
na te dharmo na sauhārddaṃ na satyaṃ sakhyameva ca ..
pitṛmātṛparityāgī kathaṃ yāsyasi sadgatim .. 57 ..
15.12.d:
न ते धर्मो न सौहार्द्दं न सत्यं सख्यमेव च ..
पितृमातृपरित्यागी कथं यास्यसि सद्गतिम् .. 57 ..
15.12.m: You have no righteousness, no affection, no truth, and no friendship. / Abandoning mother and father, how will you attain a good destination?

15.12.s:
svāminbhaktaparityāgaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu garhitaḥ ..
tyajatā'smānvane vīra dharmo nāvekṣitastvayā .. 58 ..
15.12.d:
स्वामिन्भक्तपरित्यागः सर्वशास्त्रेषु गर्हितः ..
त्यजताऽस्मान्वने वीर धर्मो नावेक्षितस्त्वया .. 58 ..
15.12.m: Lord, the abandonment of devotees is condemned in all sacred texts. / In abandoning us in the forest, hero, righteousness was not regarded by you."

15.12.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
śrutvā tāsāṃ vilapitaṃ gopīnāṃ naṃda naṃdana.
ananyaśaraṇāḥ sarvā bhāvajño bhagavānvibhuḥ..
sāṃtvayāmāsa vacanairvrajeśastā vrajāṃganāḥ.. 59..
15.12.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा तासां विलपितं गोपीनां नंद नंदन.
अनन्यशरणाः सर्वा भावज्ञो भगवान्विभुः..
सांत्वयामास वचनैर्व्रजेशस्ता व्रजांगनाः.. 59..
15.12.m:
Prahlāda said:
Having heard the wailing of those cowherd women, O son of Nanda,
knowing their inner feelings, the Lord, the all-pervading ruler of Vraja, / comforted those women of Vraja with words, for they had no other refuge.

15.12.s: adhyātmaśikṣayā gopīḥ prabhustā anvaśikṣayat.. 7.4.12.60..
15.12.d: अध्यात्मशिक्षया गोपीः प्रभुस्ता अन्वशिक्षयत्.. 7.4.12.60..
15.12.m: The Lord instructed those cowherd women with spiritual instruction:

15.12.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca..
bhavatīnāṃ viyogo me na hi sarvātmanā kvacit..
vasāmi hṛdaye śaśvadbhūtānāmaviśeṣataḥ..61..
15.12.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच..
भवतीनां वियोगो मे न हि सर्वात्मना क्वचित्..
वसामि हृदये शश्वद्भूतानामविशेषतः..61..
15.12.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
"There is indeed never any separation for you from me, as the Self of all. / I abide constantly in the hearts of living beings without distinction.

15.12.s:
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo matto devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ .. 62 ..
15.12.d:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तो देवाः सवासवाः ..
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे मरुद्गणाः .. 62 ..
15.12.m: I am the source of everything; from me come the gods together with Indra, / the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Sādhyas, the Viśvedevas, and the hosts of Maruts.

15.12.s:
brahmā rudraśca viṣṇuśca sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ ..
iṃdriyāṇi mano buddhistathā sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ .. 63 ..
15.12.d:
ब्रह्मा रुद्रश्च विष्णुश्च सनकाद्या महर्षयः ..
इंद्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिस्तथा सत्त्वं रजस्तमः .. 63 ..
15.12.m: Brahmā, Rudra, and Viṣṇu, the great seers beginning with Sanaka, / the senses, the mind, the intellect, as well as purity, passion, and darkness,

15.12.s:
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho'haṃkāra eva ca ..
etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa matto gopyaḥ pravarttate .. 64 ..
15.12.d:
कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च मोहोऽहंकार एव च ..
एतत्सर्वमशेषेण मत्तो गोप्यः प्रवर्त्तते .. 64 ..
15.12.m: desire, anger, greed, delusion, and egoism— / all this, O cowherd women, proceeds entirely from me.

15.12.s:
etajjñātvā mahābhāgā mā sma kṛdhvaṃ manaḥ śuci ..
sarvabhūteṣu māṃ nityaṃ bhāvayadhvamakalmaṣāḥ.. 65 ..
15.12.d:
एतज्ज्ञात्वा महाभागा मा स्म कृध्वं मनः शुचि ..
सर्वभूतेषु मां नित्यं भावयध्वमकल्मषाः.. 65 ..
15.12.m: Knowing this, highly fortunate ones, do not be sorrowful; make your mind pure. / Free from sin, constantly contemplate me in all beings."

15.12.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tāḥ kṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā gopyo vidhvastabandhanāḥ ..
vimuktasaṃśayakleśā darśanānandasaṃplutāḥ..
ūcuśca gopavadhvastāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nirmalamānasāḥ .. 66 .. ..
15.12.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ताः कृष्णवचनं श्रुत्वा गोप्यो विध्वस्तबन्धनाः ..
विमुक्तसंशयक्लेशा दर्शनानन्दसंप्लुताः..
ऊचुश्च गोपवध्वस्ताः कृष्णं निर्मलमानसाः .. 66 .. ..
15.12.m:
Prahlāda said:
Having heard Kṛṣṇa's words, the cowherd women, their bonds destroyed, / their doubts and afflictions removed, flooded with joy at his darśana, / those cowherd wives, with minds made spotless, spoke to Kṛṣṇa:

15.12.s:
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma adya naḥ saphalā dṛśaḥ ..
yattvāṃ paśyāma govinda nāgarījanavallabham .. 67 ..
15.12.d:
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
अद्य नः सफलं जन्म अद्य नः सफला दृशः ..
यत्त्वां पश्याम गोविन्द नागरीजनवल्लभम् .. 67 ..
15.12.m:
The cowherd women said:
"Today our birth is fruitful; today our eyes are fruitful, / since we behold you, Govinda, beloved of townswomen.

15.12.s:
puṇyahīnā na paśyaṃti kṛṣṇākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ param ..
vākyairhetvarthasaṃyuktairyadi saṃbodhitā vayam ..
tathāpi māyā hṛdayānnāpaiti madhusūdana .. 68 ..
15.12.d:
पुण्यहीना न पश्यंति कृष्णाख्यं पुरुषं परम् ..
वाक्यैर्हेत्वर्थसंयुक्तैर्यदि संबोधिता वयम् ..
तथापि माया हृदयान्नापैति मधुसूदन .. 68 ..
15.12.m: Those devoid of merit do not see the Supreme Person named Kṛṣṇa. / Even though we have been instructed by words endowed with reason and purpose, / nevertheless, Madhusūdana, illusion does not depart from our heart."

15.12.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
darśanātsparśanāccāsya vimuktā'śeṣabandhanāḥ ..
snātvā ca sakalānkāmānavāpsyatha vrajāṃganāḥ .. 69 ..
15.12.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
दर्शनात्स्पर्शनाच्चास्य विमुक्ताऽशेषबन्धनाः ..
स्नात्वा च सकलान्कामानवाप्स्यथ व्रजांगनाः .. 69 ..
15.12.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
"From seeing and touching this [lake], freed from all bonds, / and having bathed, women of Vraja, you will obtain all desires."

15.12.s:
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
adbhuto hi prabhāvaste saraso'sya udāhṛtaḥ ..
vidhiṃ brūhi jagannātha vistarādvṛṣṇinandana .. 7.4.12.70 ..
15.12.d:
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
अद्भुतो हि प्रभावस्ते सरसोऽस्य उदाहृतः ..
विधिं ब्रूहि जगन्नाथ विस्तराद्वृष्णिनन्दन .. 7.4.12.70 ..
15.12.m:
The cowherd women said:
"Wondrous indeed is the power of this lake described by you. / Tell us the ritual procedure in detail, Lord of the universe, son of the Vṛṣṇis."

15.12.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhavatīnāṃ mayā sārddhaṃ sañjātamatra darśanam ..
tasmānmayā sadā hyatra snātavyaṃ niyamena hi .. 71 ..
15.12.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
भवतीनां मया सार्द्धं सञ्जातमत्र दर्शनम् ..
तस्मान्मया सदा ह्यत्र स्नातव्यं नियमेन हि .. 71 ..
15.12.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
"Your darśana with me took place here; / therefore, a bath should indeed always be taken by me here according to rule.

15.12.s:
yaḥ snātvā parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsantarpayiṣyati ..
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ .. 72 ..
15.12.d:
यः स्नात्वा परया भक्त्या पितॄन्सन्तर्पयिष्यति ..
श्रावणस्य सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां नियतः शुचिः .. 72 ..
15.12.m: Whoever, having bathed with supreme devotion, shall propitiate the ancestors, / restrained and pure on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa,

15.12.s:
dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktyā ca māmuddiśya tathā pitṝn ..
labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 73 ..
15.12.d:
दत्त्वा दानं स्वशक्त्या च मामुद्दिश्य तथा पितॄन् ..
लभते वैष्णवं लोकं पितृभिः परिवारितः .. 73 ..
15.12.m: and having given gifts according to one's means, dedicated to me and to the ancestors, / attains the world of Viṣṇu, surrounded by his ancestors.

15.12.s:
maya tīrthaṃ samāsādya kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān ..
phalamekaṃ gṛhītvā tu mantreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet !. 74 ..
15.12.d:
मय तीर्थं समासाद्य कृत्वा च करयोः कुशान् ..
फलमेकं गृहीत्वा तु मन्त्रेणार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् !. 74 ..
15.12.m: Approaching the Maya tīrtha, placing kuśa grass in both hands, / and taking a single fruit, one should offer the arghya with the mantra:

15.12.s:
gṛhāndhakūpe patitaṃ māyā pāśaśatairvṛtam ..
māmuddhara mahīnātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te .. 75 ..
15.12.d:
गृहान्धकूपे पतितं माया पाशशतैर्वृतम् ..
मामुद्धर महीनाथ गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते .. 75 ..
15.12.m: 'Fallen into the dark well of household life, surrounded by hundreds of fetters of illusion, / deliver me, Lord of the earth! Accept this arghya; homage to you!'

15.12.s:
.. arghyamantraḥ .. ..
snātvā yaḥ parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsaṃtarpya bhāvataḥ ..
kuryācchrāddhaṃ ca parayā pitṛbhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 76 ..
15.12.d:
.. अर्घ्यमन्त्रः .. ..
स्नात्वा यः परया भक्त्या पितॄन्संतर्प्य भावतः ..
कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं च परया पितृभक्त्या समन्वितः .. 76 ..
15.12.m:
[This is] the mantra for the arghya.
Whoever, having bathed with supreme devotion and properly satisfied the ancestors with feeling, / performs a śrāddha, endowed with supreme devotion to the ancestors,

15.12.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyādrajataṃ rukmameva ca ..
viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ca saśarkaram .. 77 ..
15.12.d:
दक्षिणां च ततो दद्याद्रजतं रुक्ममेव च ..
विशेषतः प्रदातव्यं पायसं च सशर्करम् .. 77 ..
15.12.m: and should then give a priestly gift of silver and gold; / in particular, sweet rice milk mixed with sugar should be offered,

15.12.s:
navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ chatraṃ kaṃbalājinameva ca ..
bhavatībhiḥ samaṃ yasmātsaṃjātaṃ mama darśanam ..
āgaṃtavyaṃ mayā tasmātsadā hyasmiñjalāśaye .. 78 ..
15.12.d:
नवनीतं घृतं छत्रं कंबलाजिनमेव च ..
भवतीभिः समं यस्मात्संजातं मम दर्शनम् ..
आगंतव्यं मया तस्मात्सदा ह्यस्मिञ्जलाशये .. 78 ..
15.12.m: fresh butter, clarified butter, a parasol, a blanket, and an antelope skin. / Because my meeting with you took place [here], / I must therefore always come to this body of water.

15.12.s:
yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute mayasya sarasi priyāḥ ..
gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ tasya viṣṇulokastathā'kṣayaḥ .. 79 ..
15.12.d:
योऽत्र स्नानं प्रकुरुते मयस्य सरसि प्रियाः ..
गंगास्नानफलं तस्य विष्णुलोकस्तथाऽक्षयः .. 79 ..
15.12.m: Whoever takes a bath here in the lake of Maya, O beloved ones, / obtains the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā and the imperishable world of Viṣṇu.

15.12.s:
muktiṃ prayāṃti tasyaiva pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ ..
putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ..
yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā cānte haripuraṃ vrajet .. 7.4.12.80 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye mayanirmitasaromāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..12 ..
15.12.d:
मुक्तिं प्रयांति तस्यैव पितरस्त्रिकुलोद्भवाः ..
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तो धनधान्यसमन्वितः ..
यावज्जीवं सुखं भुक्त्वा चान्ते हरिपुरं व्रजेत् .. 7.4.12.80 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये मयनिर्मितसरोमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः ..12 ..
15.12.m:
His ancestors born in three lineages attain liberation. / Endowed with sons and grandsons, accompanied by wealth and grain, / having enjoyed happiness as long as he lives, he goes to the city of Hari at the end."
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Lake Built by Maya,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.13.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā gopyaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
tasminmayasare snātvā vimuktā'śeṣabandhanāḥ .. 1 ..
15.13.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इति कृष्णवचः श्रुत्वा गोप्यः संहृष्टमानसाः ..
तस्मिन्मयसरे स्नात्वा विमुक्ताऽशेषबन्धनाः .. 1 ..
15.13.m:
Śrī Prahlāda said:
Hearing these words of Kṛṣṇa, the gopīs rejoiced in their minds. / Having bathed in that lake of Maya, freed from all bondages, 1

15.13.s:
kṛṣṇadarśanasaṃjātaparamānandasaṃplutāḥ ..
ūcuśca vacanaṃ gopyo madhuraṃ mādhavaṃ prati .. 2 ..
15.13.d:
कृष्णदर्शनसंजातपरमानन्दसंप्लुताः ..
ऊचुश्च वचनं गोप्यो मधुरं माधवं प्रति .. 2 ..
15.13.m: and flooded with supreme bliss born of the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, / the gopīs addressed sweet words to Mādhava: 2

15.13.s:
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
dhanyaḥ sa daityapravaro mayo yena kṛtaṃ saraḥ ..
yasmiṃstvaṃ devataiḥ sārddhaṃ sameṣyasi jagatpate .. 3 ..
15.13.d:
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
धन्यः स दैत्यप्रवरो मयो येन कृतं सरः ..
यस्मिंस्त्वं देवतैः सार्द्धं समेष्यसि जगत्पते .. 3 ..
15.13.m:
The gopīs said:
Blessed is Maya, that foremost of Daityas, by whom this lake was made, / in which you will gather together with the gods, O Lord of the Universe. 3

15.13.s:
yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavannanugrāhyā vayaṃ yadi ..
asmākamapi vārṣṇeya kārayasva sarottamam .. 4 ..
15.13.d:
यदि तुष्टोऽसि भगवन्ननुग्राह्या वयं यदि ..
अस्माकमपि वार्ष्णेय कारयस्व सरोत्तमम् .. 4 ..
15.13.m: If you are pleased, O Blessed One, if we are to be favored, / then for us too, O descendant of Vṛṣṇi, have an excellent lake made. 4

15.13.s:
kīrttanānmṛtyuloke'smiṃstava saṃdarśanena hi ..
aharniśaṃ tava dhyānādyāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim .. 5 ..
15.13.d:
कीर्त्तनान्मृत्युलोकेऽस्मिंस्तव संदर्शनेन हि ..
अहर्निशं तव ध्यानाद्यास्यामः परमां गतिम् .. 5 ..
15.13.m: By reciting [your name] in this mortal world, by your direct vision, / and by meditating on you day and night, we shall attain the highest state. 5

15.13.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kariṣye vaḥ priyaṃ sādhvyo yūyaṃ mama parigrahāḥ ..
anugrāhyā mayā nityaṃ bhaktigrāhyo'smi sarvadā .. 6 ..
15.13.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
करिष्ये वः प्रियं साध्व्यो यूयं मम परिग्रहाः ..
अनुग्राह्या मया नित्यं भक्तिग्राह्योऽस्मि सर्वदा .. 6 ..
15.13.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I will do what is dear to you, virtuous women; you are my own folk. / You are ever to be favored by me; I am always won by devotion. 6

15.13.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇo gopīnāṃ hitakāmyayā ..
sarasaḥ sannidhau tasya sarastvanyaccakāra ha .. 7 ..
15.13.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्कृष्णो गोपीनां हितकाम्यया ..
सरसः सन्निधौ तस्य सरस्त्वन्यच्चकार ह .. 7 ..
15.13.m:
Prahlāda said:
Having spoken thus, the Blessed Kṛṣṇa, desiring the welfare of the gopīs, / made another lake near that lake. 7

15.13.s:
tadagādhaṃ svacchajalaṃ nalinīdalaśobhitam ..
haṃsasārasayugmaiśca cakravākaiśca śobhitam .. 8 ..
15.13.d:
तदगाधं स्वच्छजलं नलिनीदलशोभितम् ..
हंससारसयुग्मैश्च चक्रवाकैश्च शोभितम् .. 8 ..
15.13.m: It was fathomless, with clear water, adorned with lotus leaves, / and beautified by pairs of swans and cranes, and by cakravāka birds. 8

15.13.s:
kumudotpalakahlārapadminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam ..
sevitaṃ dvijamukhyaiśca siddhavidyādharaistathā .. 9 ..
15.13.d:
कुमुदोत्पलकह्लारपद्मिनीखण्डमण्डितम् ..
सेवितं द्विजमुख्यैश्च सिद्धविद्याधरैस्तथा .. 9 ..
15.13.m: It was embellished with clusters of white water lilies, blue lotuses, red water lilies, and lotuses, / and frequented by foremost brahmins, as well as Siddhas and Vidyādharas, 9

15.13.s:
sevitaṃ yadunārībhistathā yadukumārakaiḥ ..
divārātrau susaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvairjānapadairjanaiḥ .. 7.4.13.10 ..
15.13.d:
सेवितं यदुनारीभिस्तथा यदुकुमारकैः ..
दिवारात्रौ सुसंपूर्णं सर्वैर्जानपदैर्जनैः .. 7.4.13.10 ..
15.13.m: and frequented by Yadu women and Yadu youths, / completely filled day and night with all the people from the countryside. 10

15.13.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jalakallolaiḥ susaṃpūrṇaṃ jalāśayam ..
harṣādgopījanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ provāca vacanaṃ tadā .. 11 ..
15.13.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा जलकल्लोलैः सुसंपूर्णं जलाशयम् ..
हर्षाद्गोपीजनं कृष्णः प्रोवाच वचनं तदा .. 11 ..
15.13.m: Seeing that reservoir completely filled with water-billows, / Kṛṣṇa then joyfully addressed these words to the gopīs: 11

15.13.s:
paśyadhvaṃ gopikāḥ śubhraṃ saraḥ saraṃ samīpataḥ ..
svacchamiṣṭajalāpūrṇaṃ sajjanānāṃ yathā manaḥ .. 12 ..
15.13.d:
पश्यध्वं गोपिकाः शुभ्रं सरः सरं समीपतः ..
स्वच्छमिष्टजलापूर्णं सज्जनानां यथा मनः .. 12 ..
15.13.m: “Look, O cowherd women, at the splendid lake near the [other] lake, / filled with clear and sweet water, like the mind of good people. 12

15.13.s:
kāraṇādbhavatīnāṃ ca yasmātkṛtamidaṃ saraḥ ..
bhavatīnāṃ tathā nāmnā khyātametadbhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
15.13.d:
कारणाद्भवतीनां च यस्मात्कृतमिदं सरः ..
भवतीनां तथा नाम्ना ख्यातमेतद्भविष्यति .. 13 ..
15.13.m: Because this lake was made for your sake, / it shall also become renowned by your name. 13

15.13.s:
gorvācāvācakaḥ śabdo bhavatībhirmayā saha ..
gopracāreti vai nāmnāṃ khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati .. 14 ..
15.13.d:
गोर्वाचावाचकः शब्दो भवतीभिर्मया सह ..
गोप्रचारेति वै नाम्नां ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति .. 14 ..
15.13.m: The word expressing ‘cow’ [pertains to] you along with me; / it will attain renown in the world under the name Gopracāra. 14

15.13.s:
yuṣmākaṃ priyakāmārthaṃ yasmātkṛtamidaṃ saraḥ ..
tasmādgopīsara iti khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati .. 15 ..
15.13.d:
युष्माकं प्रियकामार्थं यस्मात्कृतमिदं सरः ..
तस्माद्गोपीसर इति ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति .. 15 ..
15.13.m: Because this lake was made for the sake of your pleasure, / it will therefore attain renown in the world as Gopīsara.” 15

15.13.s:
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
anugrāhyā yadi vayamasmannāmnā kṛtaṃ saraḥ ..
anyatkimapi vārṣṇeya prārthayāmo vadasva naḥ .. 16 ..
15.13.d:
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
अनुग्राह्या यदि वयमस्मन्नाम्ना कृतं सरः ..
अन्यत्किमपि वार्ष्णेय प्रार्थयामो वदस्व नः .. 16 ..
15.13.m:
The gopīs said:
If we are to be favored, and this lake was made in our name, / we ask for something else, O descendant of Vṛṣṇi; tell us! 16

15.13.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
prārthyatāṃ yadabhipretaṃ yadvo manasi vartate ..
bhaktyā samāgatā yūyaṃ nāstyadeyaṃ tato mayā .. 17 ..
15.13.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
प्रार्थ्यतां यदभिप्रेतं यद्वो मनसि वर्तते ..
भक्त्या समागता यूयं नास्त्यदेयं ततो मया .. 17 ..
15.13.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Ask whatever is desired, whatever is in your mind. / You have come with devotion; therefore there is nothing I cannot give. 17

15.13.s:
.. gopya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavanyadi deyo varo hi naḥ ..
tasmāttvayā sadā kṛṣṇa narayānena mādhava .. 18 ..
15.13.d:
.. गोप्य ऊचुः .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि भगवन्यदि देयो वरो हि नः ..
तस्मात्त्वया सदा कृष्ण नरयानेन माधव .. 18 ..
15.13.m:
The gopīs said:
If you are pleased, O Blessed One, if indeed a boon is to be given to us, / then always, O Kṛṣṇa, O Mādhava, in a human conveyance 18

15.13.s:
atrāgatya nabhasye'sminsnātavyaṃ niyamena hi ..
yatra tvaṃ tatra devāśca yajñāstīrthāni keśava .. 19 ..
15.13.d:
अत्रागत्य नभस्येऽस्मिन्स्नातव्यं नियमेन हि ..
यत्र त्वं तत्र देवाश्च यज्ञास्तीर्थानि केशव .. 19 ..
15.13.m: you must regularly bathe coming here during this month of Nabhasya. / Where you are, there are the gods, the sacrifices, and the sacred fords, O Keśava. 19

15.13.s:
yatra tvaṃ tatra dānāni vratāni niyamāśca ye ..
oṃkāraśca vaṣaṭkāraḥ svāhākāraḥ svadhā tathā .. 7.4.13.20 ..
15.13.d:
यत्र त्वं तत्र दानानि व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये ..
ओंकारश्च वषट्कारः स्वाहाकारः स्वधा तथा .. 7.4.13.20 ..
15.13.m: Where you are, there are the gifts, the vows, and the observances, / the sound ‘Om’, the exclamation ‘Vaṣaṭ’, ‘Svāhā’, and likewise ‘Svadhā’, 20

15.13.s:
bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmaharlloko janaḥ satyaṃ tapastathā ..
tvanmayaṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ..21 ..
15.13.d:
भूर्भुवःस्वर्महर्ल्लोको जनः सत्यं तपस्तथा ..
त्वन्मयं हि जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् ..21 ..
15.13.m: the Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, Svaḥ, Maharloka, Janas, Satya, and Tapas worlds. / For the entire world, along with gods, asuras, and humans, is made of you. 21

15.13.s:
tasmāttvayi jagannāthe hyatra snāte janārdane ..
snātamatra tribhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 22 ..
15.13.d:
तस्मात्त्वयि जगन्नाथे ह्यत्र स्नाते जनार्दने ..
स्नातमत्र त्रिभुवनं भविष्यति न संशयः .. 22 ..
15.13.m: Therefore, when you, the Lord of the Universe, Janārdana, have bathed here, / the three worlds will have bathed here; of this there is no doubt. 22

15.13.s:
trailokyapāvanī gaṃgā tava pādajalaṃ hi tat ..
lakṣmīrvakṣaḥsthalasthāne mukhe devī sarasvatī .. 23 ..
15.13.d:
त्रैलोक्यपावनी गंगा तव पादजलं हि तत् ..
लक्ष्मीर्वक्षःस्थलस्थाने मुखे देवी सरस्वती .. 23 ..
15.13.m: The Gaṅgā, purifier of the three worlds, is indeed the water of your feet; / Lakṣmī is upon the region of your chest, and the goddess Sarasvatī is in your mouth. 23

15.13.s:
sarvabhūtamayaścātra tatastvaṃ jagadīśvara ..
yaddadāsi manuṣyāṇāṃ bhaviṣyāṇāṃ kalau yuge ..
tadvadasva mahābāho kṛpāṃ kṛtvā jagatpate .. 24 ..
15.13.d:
सर्वभूतमयश्चात्र ततस्त्वं जगदीश्वर ..
यद्ददासि मनुष्याणां भविष्याणां कलौ युगे ..
तद्वदस्व महाबाहो कृपां कृत्वा जगत्पते .. 24 ..
15.13.m: And you consist of all beings here; therefore, O Lord of the Universe, / what [reward] you grant to future mortals in the Kali age, / tell that, O mighty-armed one, having shown mercy, O Lord of the World! 24

15.13.s:
yātrāyāmāgatānāṃ ca atha ṣaṇmāsavāsinām ..
sadaivātra sthitānāṃ ca yatphalaṃ tadvadasva naḥ .. 25 ..
15.13.d:
यात्रायामागतानां च अथ षण्मासवासिनाम् ..
सदैवात्र स्थितानां च यत्फलं तद्वदस्व नः .. 25 ..
15.13.m: And tell us what fruit there is for those who come on pilgrimage, / or for those who dwell here for six months, and for those who reside here always. 25

15.13.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yatphalaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ snātānāṃ gopikāsare ..
tacchṛṇudhvamasaṃdigdhaṃ prasanne mayi gopikāḥ .. 26 ..
15.13.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
यत्फलं हि मनुष्याणां स्नातानां गोपिकासरे ..
तच्छृणुध्वमसंदिग्धं प्रसन्ने मयि गोपिकाः .. 26 ..
15.13.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
What fruit belongs to men who have bathed in the lake of the gopīs, / hear that without doubt, O cowherd women, since I am pleased. 26

15.13.s:
sopaskarāṃ savatsāṃ ca vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitām ..
yathoktadakṣiṇopetāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 27 ..
15.13.d:
सोपस्करां सवत्सां च वस्त्रालंकारभूषिताम् ..
यथोक्तदक्षिणोपेतां ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने .. 27 ..
15.13.m: A cow equipped with utensils, with a calf, adorned with garments and ornaments, / accompanied by the prescribed priestly fee, [given] to a householder brahmin 27

15.13.s:
sadācārāya śuddhāya daridrāyānukāriṇe ..
gāṃ dattvā phalamāpnoti snānamātreṇa tatphalam .. 28 ..
15.13.d:
सदाचाराय शुद्धाय दरिद्रायानुकारिणे ..
गां दत्त्वा फलमाप्नोति स्नानमात्रेण तत्फलम् .. 28 ..
15.13.m: who is of good conduct, pure, poor, and worthy of support— / the fruit one obtains by giving [such] a cow, that [same] fruit he attains merely by a ritual ablution. 28

15.13.s:
yāvatpadāni manujaḥ kṛṣṇena saha gacchati ..
kulāni devyastāvaṃti vasaṃti harimandire .. 29 ..
15.13.d:
यावत्पदानि मनुजः कृष्णेन सह गच्छति ..
कुलानि देव्यस्तावंति वसंति हरिमन्दिरे .. 29 ..
15.13.m: As many steps as a man walks with Kṛṣṇa, / for so many [ages], O goddesses, his lineages dwell in Hari’s mansion. 29

15.13.s:
kṛṣṇena saha gacchanti gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ..
stuvanto vividhaiḥ stotrairgoviṃdaṃ gopikāsare .. 7.4.13.30 ..
15.13.d:
कृष्णेन सह गच्छन्ति गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः ..
स्तुवन्तो विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्गोविंदं गोपिकासरे .. 7.4.13.30 ..
15.13.m: Those who walk with Kṛṣṇa with the sounds of singing and musical instruments, / praising Govinda with various hymns at the lake of the gopīs, 30

15.13.s:
na māturjaṭhare teṣāṃ yātanā jāyate nṛṇām ..
sarvānkāmānavāpyāṃte vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyuḥ .. 31 ..
15.13.d:
न मातुर्जठरे तेषां यातना जायते नृणाम् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्यांते वैष्णवं लोकमाप्नुयुः .. 31 ..
15.13.m: for those men, no torment arises in a mother's womb. / Having obtained all desires, in the end they attain the realm of Viṣṇu. 31

15.13.s:
arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena snānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena vai sādhvyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 32 ..
15.13.d:
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा विधानेन स्नानं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
मंत्रेणानेन वै साध्व्यः श्रद्धया परया युतः .. 32 ..
15.13.m: Having offered water according to the injunction, the wise man should perform a ritual ablution, / with this mantra, O virtuous women, endowed with supreme faith: 32

15.13.s:
namaste goparūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane ..
gopracāre jagannātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te .. 33 ..
15.13.d:
नमस्ते गोपरूपाय विष्णवे परमात्मने ..
गोप्रचारे जगन्नाथ गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते .. 33 ..
15.13.m: ‘Homage to you who have the form of a cowherd, to Viṣṇu, the Supreme Self! / At Gopracāra, O Lord of the Universe, accept the water offering; homage to you!’ 33

15.13.s:
arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena mṛdamālipya pāṇinā ..
snāyācchraddhāsamāyuktastarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 34 ..
15.13.d:
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा विधानेन मृदमालिप्य पाणिना ..
स्नायाच्छ्रद्धासमायुक्तस्तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 34 ..
15.13.m: Having offered water according to the injunction and smeared clay with his hand, / he should bathe endowed with faith and satisfy the ancestors and deities with water. 34

15.13.s:
śrāddhaṃ kuryyāttato bhaktyā ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
yathoktadakṣiṇā dadyādrajataṃ rukmameva ca .. 35 ..
15.13.d:
श्राद्धं कुर्य्यात्ततो भक्त्या एकचित्तः समाहितः ..
यथोक्तदक्षिणा दद्याद्रजतं रुक्ममेव च .. 35 ..
15.13.m: Then, one-pointed and composed, he should perform the śrāddha with devotion; / he should give the prescribed priestly fee, silver and indeed gold, 35

15.13.s:
viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ kajjalaṃ tathā ..
dukūlāni ca deyāni tathā kausuṃbhakāni ca .. 36 ..
15.13.d:
विशेषतः प्रदातव्यं तांबूलं कज्जलं तथा ..
दुकूलानि च देयानि तथा कौसुंभकानि च .. 36 ..
15.13.m: and especially betel should be given, as well as collyrium; / silk cloths and saffron-colored garments should be given, 36

15.13.s:
daṃpatyorvāsasī caiva bhūṣaṇāni svaśaktitaḥ ..
gāvo deyā dvijātibhyo vṛṣabhāśca dhuraṃdharāḥ ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ .. 37 ..
15.13.d:
दंपत्योर्वाससी चैव भूषणानि स्वशक्तितः ..
गावो देया द्विजातिभ्यो वृषभाश्च धुरंधराः ..
दीनांधकृपणानां च दानं देयं स्वशक्तितः .. 37 ..
15.13.m: and garments for a married couple, and ornaments according to one’s means; / cows should be given to twice-borns, and draft oxen; / and gifts should be given according to one’s means to the poor, the blind, and the wretched. 37

15.13.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyaguttamāṃ gatimāpnuyāt ..
prayāṃti paramaṃ lokaṃ pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ .. 38 ..
15.13.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरः सम्यगुत्तमां गतिमाप्नुयात् ..
प्रयांति परमं लोकं पितरस्त्रिकुलोद्भवाः .. 38 ..
15.13.m: Having acted thus, a man completely attains the highest state. / The ancestors belonging to his three lineages go to the supreme world. 38

15.13.s: labhate putrakāmastu putrāniṣṭānmanoramān .. 39 ..
15.13.d: लभते पुत्रकामस्तु पुत्रानिष्टान्मनोरमान् .. 39 ..
15.13.m: One who desires a son obtains desired, charming sons. 39

15.13.s:
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ svargamokṣādikaṃ naraḥ ..
tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti yaḥ snāti gopikāsare .. 7.4.13.40 ..
15.13.d:
यं यं कामयते कामं स्वर्गमोक्षादिकं नरः ..
तत्सर्वं समवाप्नोति यः स्नाति गोपिकासरे .. 7.4.13.40 ..
15.13.m: Whatever desire a man may desire, such as heaven and liberation, / he who bathes in the lake of the gopīs attains all of it. 40

15.13.s:
yāvallokā bhaviṣyaṃti tāvatsthāsyati vai saraḥ ..
yāvatsaro yaśastāvadbhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati .. 41 ..
15.13.d:
यावल्लोका भविष्यंति तावत्स्थास्यति वै सरः ..
यावत्सरो यशस्तावद्भवतीनां भविष्यति .. 41 ..
15.13.m: As long as the worlds shall endure, so long indeed will this lake remain; / as long as the lake [endures], so long will there be fame for you. 41

15.13.s:
yāvatkīrtirmanuṣyeṣu tāvatsvarge mahīyate ..
vimuktāḥ sakalātpāpādyāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 42 ..
15.13.d:
यावत्कीर्तिर्मनुष्येषु तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते ..
विमुक्ताः सकलात्पापाद्यास्यंति परमां गतिम् .. 42 ..
15.13.m: As long as fame remains among men, for so long one is honored in heaven. / Freed from all sin, they will go to the supreme state.” 42

15.13.s:
tatpuṇyaṃ gopīsara idaṃ jalaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadaiva hi ..
avagāhyaṃ mayā gopyo nabhasye niyamena hi .. 43 ..
15.13.d:
तत्पुण्यं गोपीसर इदं जलैः पूर्णं सदैव हि ..
अवगाह्यं मया गोप्यो नभस्ये नियमेन हि .. 43 ..
15.13.m: This holy Gopīsara is indeed constantly full of water; / O gopīs, I must regularly bathe in it during the month of Nabhasya.

15.13.s:
bhavatyaḥ patibhāvena brahmabhāvena vā punaḥ ..
ciṃtayaṃtyaḥ paraṃ māṃ hi parāgatimavāpsyatha .. 44 ..
15.13.d:
भवत्यः पतिभावेन ब्रह्मभावेन वा पुनः ..
चिंतयंत्यः परं मां हि परागतिमवाप्स्यथ .. 44 ..
15.13.m: Meditating on Me as supreme, whether with the attitude toward a husband / or with the attitude toward Brahman, you shall attain the highest state.

15.13.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
anujñātā bhagavatā tatastā gopakanyakāḥ ..
namaskṛtya ca goviṃdaṃ yayuḥ sarvā yathāgatā .. 45 ..
15.13.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
अनुज्ञाता भगवता ततस्ता गोपकन्यकाः ..
नमस्कृत्य च गोविंदं ययुः सर्वा यथागता .. 45 ..
15.13.m: Prahlāda said: / Permitted then by the Lord, those cowherd maidens, / bowing down to Govinda, all departed as they had come.

15.13.s:
bhagavānapi goviṃda uddhavena samanvitaḥ ..
visṛjya gopikāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svakaṃ maṃdiramāviśat .. 46 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gopīsarastīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 13 ..
15.13.d:
भगवानपि गोविंद उद्धवेन समन्वितः ..
विसृज्य गोपिकाः कृष्णः स्वकं मंदिरमाविशत् .. 46 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोपीसरस्तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः .. 13 ..
15.13.m:
The Lord Govinda too, accompanied by Uddhava, / having dismissed the cowherd maidens, entered His own palace, O Kṛṣṇa.
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of the Gopīsara Tīrtha, in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.14.s:
.. śrīprahrāda uvāca .. ..
saṃtyanekāni tīrthāni bahvāścaryakarāṇi ca ..
prāpte kaliyuge ghore tāni pupluvirerṇave .. 1 ..
15.14.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्राद उवाच .. ..
संत्यनेकानि तीर्थानि बह्वाश्चर्यकराणि च ..
प्राप्ते कलियुगे घोरे तानि पुप्लुविरेर्णवे .. 1 ..
15.14.m: Śrī Prahrāda said: / There are many sacred fords that work great wonders; / when the terrible Kali age arrived, they plunged into the ocean.

15.14.s:
uddeśato mayā viprāḥ kīrtyamānā nibodhata ..
saṃkṣepato vipravarā yathā teṣāṃ ca yāḥ kriyāḥ .. 2 ..
15.14.d:
उद्देशतो मया विप्राः कीर्त्यमाना निबोधत ..
संक्षेपतो विप्रवरा यथा तेषां च याः क्रियाः .. 2 ..
15.14.m: Listen, O brahmins, as they are declared in outline by me, / in brief, O best of brahmins, along with their rites, as they are.

15.14.s:
saṃhṛtya ca bhuvo bhāraṃ sādhū nsaṃsthāpya satpathe ..
dvāravatyāmagātkṛṣṇo vṛṣṇisaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ .. 3 ..
15.14.d:
संहृत्य च भुवो भारं साधू न्संस्थाप्य सत्पथे ..
द्वारवत्यामगात्कृष्णो वृष्णिसंघैः समावृतः .. 3 ..
15.14.m: Having removed the burden of the earth and established the virtuous on the path of truth, / Kṛṣṇa went to Dvāravatī surrounded by hosts of Vṛṣṇis.

15.14.s:
darśanārthaṃ tadā brahmā daivataiḥ parivāritaḥ ..
varuṇo yamavitteśau sūryyācandramasau tathā .. 4 ..
15.14.d:
दर्शनार्थं तदा ब्रह्मा दैवतैः परिवारितः ..
वरुणो यमवित्तेशौ सूर्य्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा .. 4 ..
15.14.m: Then Brahmā, surrounded by the deities— / Varuṇa, Yama, the Lord of Wealth, as well as the Sun and Moon—came for darśana.

15.14.s:
āgatya saha kṛṣṇena kāryaṃ saṃsādhya cātmanaḥ ..
vedhāścakre tadā tīrthaṃ svanāmnā kīrtitaṃ bhuvi .. 5 ..
15.14.d:
आगत्य सह कृष्णेन कार्यं संसाध्य चात्मनः ..
वेधाश्चक्रे तदा तीर्थं स्वनाम्ना कीर्तितं भुवि .. 5 ..
15.14.m: Having arrived and accomplished his purpose along with Kṛṣṇa, / the Creator then fashioned a sacred ford renowned on earth by his own name,

15.14.s:
brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham ..
tattīre sthāpayāmāsa sahasrakiraṇaṃ prabhum .. 6 ..
15.14.d:
ब्रह्मकुण्डमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् ..
तत्तीरे स्थापयामास सहस्रकिरणं प्रभुम् .. 6 ..
15.14.m: Known as Brahmakuṇḍa, auspicious and destroying all sins. / On its bank he installed the Lord of a thousand rays.

15.14.s:
mūlaṃ surāṇāṃ hi kila brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
tena saṃsthāpitaṃ yasmānmūla sthānamiti smṛtam .. 7 ..
15.14.d:
मूलं सुराणां हि किल ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
तेन संस्थापितं यस्मान्मूल स्थानमिति स्मृतम् .. 7 ..
15.14.m: Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, is indeed the root of the gods; / because it was established by him, it is remembered as Mūlasthāna.

15.14.s:
brahmatīrthaṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā candraścakre tataḥ saraḥ ..
taḍāgaṃ candranāmnā vai sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 8 ..
15.14.d:
ब्रह्मतीर्थं तु तद्दृष्ट्वा चन्द्रश्चक्रे ततः सरः ..
तडागं चन्द्रनाम्ना वै सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 8 ..
15.14.m: Seeing that sacred ford of Brahmā, the Moon then made a lake, / a pool named after the Moon, which destroys all sins.

15.14.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasā yuktaṃ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ surasattamāḥ ..
ūcuste lokasraṣṭāraṃ śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ hi naḥ .. 9 ..
15.14.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा तेजसा युक्तं संहृष्टाः सुरसत्तमाः ..
ऊचुस्ते लोकस्रष्टारं शृणुष्व वचनं हि नः .. 9 ..
15.14.m: Seeing it endowed with splendor, the best of the gods were overjoyed; / they spoke to the Creator of the world: "Listen indeed to our words:

15.14.s:
yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati ..
pūjayiṣyati deveśaṃ mūlasthānaṃ surarṣabha .. 7.4.14.10 ..
15.14.d:
योऽत्र स्नानं प्रकुरुते पितॄन्संतर्पयिष्यति ..
पूजयिष्यति देवेशं मूलस्थानं सुरर्षभ .. 7.4.14.10 ..
15.14.m: Whoever takes a ritual ablution here, satisfies the ancestors, / and worships the Lord of the gods at Mūlasthāna, O bull among the gods,

15.14.s:
sarvapāpavinirmukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ..
saptamyāṃ māghamāsasya śuklapakṣe dvijarṣabhāḥ ..
yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute mānavo bhaktisaṃyutaḥ .. 11 ..
15.14.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो धनधान्यसमन्वितः ..
सप्तम्यां माघमासस्य शुक्लपक्षे द्विजर्षभाः ..
योऽत्र स्नानं प्रकुरुते मानवो भक्तिसंयुतः .. 11 ..
15.14.m: Is freed from all sins and endowed with wealth and grain. / On the seventh day of the bright fortnight of the month of Māgha, O bulls among the twice-born, / whichever human takes a ritual ablution here endowed with devotion,

15.14.s:
mūlasthānaṃ ca deveśa saṃsnāpya pravilepayet ..
pūjayiṣyati vastrādyaiḥ svaśaktyā bhūṣaṇaistathā .. 12 ..
15.14.d:
मूलस्थानं च देवेश संस्नाप्य प्रविलेपयेत् ..
पूजयिष्यति वस्त्राद्यैः स्वशक्त्या भूषणैस्तथा .. 12 ..
15.14.m: Bathing and anointing the Lord of the gods at Mūlasthāna, / and worshiping him according to one's capacity with garments and ornaments,

15.14.s:
puṣpadhūpādibhiścaiva naivedyena ca mānavaḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 13 ..
15.14.d:
पुष्पधूपादिभिश्चैव नैवेद्येन च मानवः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 13 ..
15.14.m: As well as with flowers, incense, and other offerings, and food offerings, / that human attains all desires and goes to the world of Brahmā."

15.14.s:
sāvitrīṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā sthāpitāṃ ca vai ..
kṛtvā cāyatanaṃ divyaṃ svāṃ mūrtiṃ sanniveśya ca ..
nāma cakre tadā devyāḥ svayaṃ tasyāḥ pitāmahaḥ .. 14 ..
15.14.d:
सावित्रीं च ततो दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणा स्थापितां च वै ..
कृत्वा चायतनं दिव्यं स्वां मूर्तिं सन्निवेश्य च ..
नाम चक्रे तदा देव्याः स्वयं तस्याः पितामहः .. 14 ..
15.14.m: Then, seeing Sāvitrī installed by Brahmā— / having built a divine shrine and placed his own image there, / the Grandfather himself then bestowed a name upon the goddess—

15.14.s:
yaḥ paśyati svayaṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatpatim ..
sāvitrīṃ sa sukhī bhūtvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 15 ..
15.14.d:
यः पश्यति स्वयं भक्त्या कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा जगत्पतिम् ..
सावित्रीं स सुखी भूत्वा सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 15 ..
15.14.m: He who, having seen Kṛṣṇa the Lord of the universe, himself sees Sāvitrī with devotion, / shall become happy and attain all desires.

15.14.s:
āyurārogyamaiśvaryyaṃ putrasantānameva ca ..
na daurbhāgyaṃ bhavettasya na dāridyaṃ na mūrkhatā ..
na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tasya yaḥ paśyati vidhiṃ naraḥ .. 16 ..
15.14.d:
आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्य्यं पुत्रसन्तानमेव च ..
न दौर्भाग्यं भवेत्तस्य न दारिद्यं न मूर्खता ..
न च व्याधिभयं तस्य यः पश्यति विधिं नरः .. 16 ..
15.14.m: Longevity, health, sovereignty, and male offspring [shall be his]; / misfortune shall not befall him, nor poverty, nor foolishness, / nor fear of disease for the man who sees the ordinance.

15.14.s:
gatvā saṃsnāpayeddevīṃ kuṃkumena kusuṃbhakaiḥ ..
saṃchādya vastraiḥ saṃpūjya puṣpairnānāvidhai stathā .. 17 ..
15.14.d:
गत्वा संस्नापयेद्देवीं कुंकुमेन कुसुंभकैः ..
संछाद्य वस्त्रैः संपूज्य पुष्पैर्नानाविधै स्तथा .. 17 ..
15.14.m: Going there, one should bathe the goddess with saffron and safflower, / covering her with garments, worshiping her with various kinds of flowers,

15.14.s:
naivedyaphalatāṃbūlagrīvāsūtrakadīpakaiḥ ..
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā yātrāṃ ca saphalā labhet .. 18 ..
15.14.d:
नैवेद्यफलतांबूलग्रीवासूत्रकदीपकैः ..
संपूज्य परया भक्त्या यात्रां च सफला लभेत् .. 18 ..
15.14.m: And worshiping her with the highest devotion with food offerings, fruits, betel, neck-cords, and lamps, / one will obtain a fruitful pilgrimage.

15.14.s:
na vaidhavyaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na vaṃdhyā na mṛtaprajā ..
vidhirdṛṣṭo narairyaistu kule teṣāṃ prajāyate .. 19 ..
15.14.d:
न वैधव्यं न दौर्भाग्यं न वंध्या न मृतप्रजा ..
विधिर्दृष्टो नरैर्यैस्तु कुले तेषां प्रजायते .. 19 ..
15.14.m: No widowhood, no misfortune, no barren woman, nor one whose offspring has died / is born in the family of those men by whom the rite is seen.

15.14.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena vidhiṃ paśyetsubhāvataḥ ..
parituṣṭo bhavetkṛṣṇo yātrā ca saphalā bhavet .. 7.4.14.20 ..
15.14.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन विधिं पश्येत्सुभावतः ..
परितुष्टो भवेत्कृष्णो यात्रा च सफला भवेत् .. 7.4.14.20 ..
15.14.m: Therefore, by every effort one should observe the rite with a good disposition; / Kṛṣṇa will be pleased and the pilgrimage will be fruitful.

15.14.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ dṛṣṭvā saraḥ paramaśobhanam ..
indraścakre mahābhāgaḥ saraḥ paramaśobhanam .. 21 ..
15.14.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मणा स्थापितं दृष्ट्वा सरः परमशोभनम् ..
इन्द्रश्चक्रे महाभागः सरः परमशोभनम् .. 21 ..
15.14.m: Prahlāda said: / Seeing the exceedingly beautiful lake established by Brahmā, / the fortunate Indra made an exceedingly beautiful lake.

15.14.s:
sthāpayāmāsa deveśo liṃgamapratimaujasam ..
tasminsnātvā ca labhate yasmādindrapadaṃ naraḥ .. 22 ..
15.14.d:
स्थापयामास देवेशो लिंगमप्रतिमौजसम् ..
तस्मिन्स्नात्वा च लभते यस्मादिन्द्रपदं नरः .. 22 ..
15.14.m: The Lord of the gods installed a liṅga of peerless splendor; / because a man obtains the rank of Indra by bathing in it,

15.14.s:
tasmādindrapadaṃ nāma suprasiddhaṃ dharātale ..
indreṇa sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ yasmādbhāvanayā saha ..
prasiddhamiṃdranāmnā vā indreśvaramiti smṛtam ..23..
15.14.d:
तस्मादिन्द्रपदं नाम सुप्रसिद्धं धरातले ..
इन्द्रेण स्थापितं लिंगं यस्माद्भावनया सह ..
प्रसिद्धमिंद्रनाम्ना वा इन्द्रेश्वरमिति स्मृतम् ..23..
15.14.m: It is therefore well-known on the surface of the earth by the name Indrapada. / Because the liṅga was established by Indra with deep feeling, / it is renowned by the name of Indra, or remembered as Indreśvara,

15.14.s:
yasya prasiddhiratulā vṛddhiliṃgamiti dvijāḥ..
yasya darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 24 ..
15.14.d:
यस्य प्रसिद्धिरतुला वृद्धिलिंगमिति द्विजाः..
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 24 ..
15.14.m: Whose matchless fame, O twice-born, is as the Vṛddhiliṅga, / by the mere sight of which one is freed from all sins.

15.14.s:
pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate dvijasattamāḥ ..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ snātvā cendrapade naraḥ .. 25 ..
15.14.d:
पितॄणामक्षया तृप्तिर्जायते द्विजसत्तमाः ..
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्द्दश्यां स्नात्वा चेन्द्रपदे नरः .. 25 ..
15.14.m: Inexhaustible satisfaction of the ancestors arises, O best of the twice-born. / A man who bathes at Indrapada on the eighth and fourteenth days,

15.14.s:
indreśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya yāti muktipadaṃ naraḥ ..
viśeṣatastu saṃpūjyo makarasthe divākare .. 26 ..
15.14.d:
इन्द्रेश्वरं च संपूज्य याति मुक्तिपदं नरः ..
विशेषतस्तु संपूज्यो मकरस्थे दिवाकरे .. 26 ..
15.14.m: And worships Indreśvara, goes to the abode of liberation. / He should be worshiped especially when the sun enters Capricorn,

15.14.s:
uttarāyaṇasaṃkrāṃtau liṃgapūraṇakena hi ..
śivarātrau viśeṣeṇa saṃpūjya umayā saha ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā paramaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 27 ..
15.14.d:
उत्तरायणसंक्रांतौ लिंगपूरणकेन हि ..
शिवरात्रौ विशेषेण संपूज्य उमया सह ..
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा परमं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 27 ..
15.14.m: At the northern solstice, by filling the liṅga; / especially on Śivarātri, worshiping him together with Umā / and keeping an all-night vigil, he attains the supreme world.

15.14.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca.. ..
brahmatīrthaṃ ca taddṛṣṭvā tathā śakrasarobhavam ..
darśayanviṣṇunā sārddhamekarūpatvamāpnuyāt .. 28 ..
15.14.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच.. ..
ब्रह्मतीर्थं च तद्दृष्ट्वा तथा शक्रसरोभवम् ..
दर्शयन्विष्णुना सार्द्धमेकरूपत्वमाप्नुयात् .. 28 ..
15.14.m: Prahlāda said: / Seeing that sacred ford of Brahmā and the one arisen as the lake of Śakra, / revealing unity of form with Viṣṇu, he attains [that state].

15.14.s:
saraścakāra deveśo bhagavānpārvatīpatiḥ ..
sumṛṣṭanirmalajalaṃ nalinīdalaśobhitam .. 29 ..
15.14.d:
सरश्चकार देवेशो भगवान्पार्वतीपतिः ..
सुमृष्टनिर्मलजलं नलिनीदलशोभितम् .. 29 ..
15.14.m: The Lord of the gods, the venerable husband of Pārvatī, made a lake / with very pure, clear water, adorned with lotus leaves,

15.14.s:
utpalaiḥ sarvataśchannaṃ saraḥ sārasaśobhitam ..
tadagādhajalaṃ dṛṣṭvā svayameva pinākadhṛk ..
sabrahmaviṣṇunā sārddhaṃ snātastatra vṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 7.4.14.30 ..
15.14.d:
उत्पलैः सर्वतश्छन्नं सरः सारसशोभितम् ..
तदगाधजलं दृष्ट्वा स्वयमेव पिनाकधृक् ..
सब्रह्मविष्णुना सार्द्धं स्नातस्तत्र वृषध्वजः .. 7.4.14.30 ..
15.14.m: Covered on all sides with blue lotuses, a lake adorned with cranes. / Seeing its fathomless water, the Wielder of the Pināka, / the Bull-bannered Lord Himself bathed there together with Brahmā and Viṣṇu.

15.14.s:
te devāstatsaro dṛṣṭvā brahmaviṣṇusurā'surāḥ ..
ūcuḥ sarve susaṃhṛṣṭā vīkṣaṃtaḥ pārvatīpatim .. 31 ..
15.14.d:
ते देवास्तत्सरो दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मविष्णुसुराऽसुराः ..
ऊचुः सर्वे सुसंहृष्टा वीक्षंतः पार्वतीपतिम् .. 31 ..
15.14.m: Those gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the suras and asuras, having seen that lake, / all spoke, exceedingly delighted, looking at the husband of Pārvatī:

15.14.s:
yasmātkṛtamidaṃ devā īśvareṇa mahatsaraḥ ..
mahādeva saronāma suprasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 32 ..
15.14.d:
यस्मात्कृतमिदं देवा ईश्वरेण महत्सरः ..
महादेव सरोनाम सुप्रसिद्धं भविष्यति .. 32 ..
15.14.m: "Since this great lake was made by the Lord, O gods, / it will be well-known by the name Mahādevasaras.

15.14.s:
yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ..
śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ bhaktyā ca sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim .. 33 ..
15.14.d:
योऽत्र स्नानं प्रकुरुते पितॄणां तर्पणं तथा ..
श्राद्धं पितॄणां भक्त्या च स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् .. 33 ..
15.14.m: Whoever takes a ritual ablution here, offers libations to the ancestors, / and faithfully performs śrāddha for the ancestors, shall go to the highest state.

15.14.s:
suprasannā bhaviṣyanti sarve devā na saṃśayaḥ ..
darśanātpāpanirmukto mahādevasarasya ca .. 34 ..
15.14.d:
सुप्रसन्ना भविष्यन्ति सर्वे देवा न संशयः ..
दर्शनात्पापनिर्मुक्तो महादेवसरस्य च .. 34 ..
15.14.m: All the gods will be exceedingly pleased, without doubt; / and by darśana of Mahādevasaras, one is freed from sin."

15.14.s:
maheśasya ca taddṛṣṭvā saraḥ paramaśobhanam ..
cakāra pārvatī tatra saraścāpratimaṃ tathā .. 35 ..
15.14.d:
महेशस्य च तद्दृष्ट्वा सरः परमशोभनम् ..
चकार पार्वती तत्र सरश्चाप्रतिमं तथा .. 35 ..
15.14.m: And seeing that exceedingly beautiful lake of Maheśa, / Pārvatī made an incomparable lake there as well.

15.14.s:
gaurīsara iti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā na durgatimavāpnuyāt .. 36 ..
15.14.d:
गौरीसर इति ख्यातं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात् .. 36 ..
15.14.m: Known as Gaurīsaras, it destroys all sin; / bathing there with devotion, a man shall not come to an evil destiny.

15.14.s:
na daurbhāgyaṃ striyaścaiva na vaidhavyaṃ kadācana ..
snātvā gaurītīrthavare sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..37..
15.14.d:
न दौर्भाग्यं स्त्रियश्चैव न वैधव्यं कदाचन ..
स्नात्वा गौरीतीर्थवरे सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ..37..
15.14.m: Nor shall women suffer misfortune, nor ever widowhood; / having bathed at the excellent Gaurītīrtha, one attains all desires.

15.14.s:
varuṇaśca tato dṛṣṭvā puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ..
cakāra ca saro divyaṃ viṣṇubhaktisamanvitaḥ .. 38 ..
15.14.d:
वरुणश्च ततो दृष्ट्वा पुण्यान्यायतनानि च ..
चकार च सरो दिव्यं विष्णुभक्तिसमन्वितः .. 38 ..
15.14.m: Then Varuṇa, having seen the sacred sanctuaries, / made a divine lake, filled with devotion to Viṣṇu.

15.14.s:
nāmnā varuṇapadaṃ tacca pāpakṣayakaraṃ bhuvi ..
nabhasye paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .. 39 ..
15.14.d:
नाम्ना वरुणपदं तच्च पापक्षयकरं भुवि ..
नभस्ये पौर्णमास्यां च संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः .. 39 ..
15.14.m: Named Varuṇapada, it destroys sin on earth. / Having gratified the ancestors and gods on the full moon day of Nabhasya,

15.14.s:
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
uttamaṃ lokamāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati .. 7.4.14.40 ..
15.14.d:
श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानेन पितॄणां श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
उत्तमं लोकमाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति .. 7.4.14.40 ..
15.14.m: and performed the śrāddha for the ancestors according to rule, endowed with faith, / he attains the highest world, having gone to which he grieves not.

15.14.s:
pradadyādudakumbhāṃśca dadhyodanasamanvitān ..
gāśca vāsāṃsi ratnāni viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 41 ..
15.14.d:
प्रदद्यादुदकुम्भांश्च दध्योदनसमन्वितान् ..
गाश्च वासांसि रत्नानि विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति .. 41 ..
15.14.m: One should give water-jars accompanied by curd-rice, / cows, garments, and gems, saying: 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me.'

15.14.s:
saro dṛṣṭvā jaleśasya saraścakre dhaneśvaraḥ ..
yakṣādhipasaronāma suprasiddhaṃ dharātale .. 42 ..
15.14.d:
सरो दृष्ट्वा जलेशस्य सरश्चक्रे धनेश्वरः ..
यक्षाधिपसरोनाम सुप्रसिद्धं धरातले .. 42 ..
15.14.m: Having seen the lake of the lord of waters, the lord of wealth made a lake / named the lake of the Lord of Yakṣas, celebrated throughout the earth.

15.14.s:
tathā tatra naro bhaktyā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dadyādvastradvijātaye .. 43 ..
15.14.d:
तथा तत्र नरो भक्त्या संपूज्य पितृदेवताः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति दद्याद्वस्त्रद्विजातये .. 43 ..
15.14.m: Likewise, having worshipped the ancestors and gods there with devotion, a man / attains all desires; he should give garments to a twice-born.

15.14.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
viṣṇuṃ varapradaṃ śrutvā bhrātṝṇāṃ brahmanaṃdanāḥ ..
maṃdākinī vasiṣṭhena samānītā dharātale .. 44 ..
15.14.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
विष्णुं वरप्रदं श्रुत्वा भ्रातॄणां ब्रह्मनंदनाः ..
मंदाकिनी वसिष्ठेन समानीता धरातले .. 44 ..
15.14.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing that Viṣṇu is the giver of boons to the brothers, O sons of Brahmā, / the Mandākinī was brought to the earth by Vasiṣṭha.

15.14.s:
ambarīṣādayaḥ sarva ājagmuḥ kṛṣṇapālitām..
dvāravatyāṃ ca te dṛṣṭvā gomatīṃ sāgaraṃgamām .. 45 ..
15.14.d:
अम्बरीषादयः सर्व आजग्मुः कृष्णपालिताम्..
द्वारवत्यां च ते दृष्ट्वा गोमतीं सागरंगमाम् .. 45 ..
15.14.m: Ambarīṣa and all the others came to [the city] protected by Kṛṣṇa, / and in Dvāravatī they saw the Gomatī flowing to the ocean,

15.14.s:
tīrthāni devatānāṃ ca puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ..
tīrthaṃ paṃcanadaṃ cakruḥ prajānāṃ patayastathā .. 46 ..
15.14.d:
तीर्थानि देवतानां च पुण्यान्यायतनानि च ..
तीर्थं पंचनदं चक्रुः प्रजानां पतयस्तथा .. 46 ..
15.14.m: and the tīrthas of the deities and the sacred sanctuaries; / so the lords of creatures made the Pañcanada tīrtha.

15.14.s:
paṃca nadyaḥ samāhūtāstatrā''jagmuḥ surānvitāḥ ..
marīcaye gomatī ca lakṣmaṇā cātraye tathā .. 47 ..
15.14.d:
पंच नद्यः समाहूतास्तत्रा'ऽजग्मुः सुरान्विताः ..
मरीचये गोमती च लक्ष्मणा चात्रये तथा .. 47 ..
15.14.m: Invited, the five rivers accompanied by the gods came there: / the Gomatī for Marīci, and the Lakṣmaṇā for Atri;

15.14.s:
caṃdrabhāgā cāṃgirase pulahāya kuśāvatī ..
pāvanārthaṃ jāṃbavatī jagāma kratave tathā .. 48 ..
15.14.d:
चंद्रभागा चांगिरसे पुलहाय कुशावती ..
पावनार्थं जांबवती जगाम क्रतवे तथा .. 48 ..
15.14.m: the Candrabhāgā for Aṅgiras, and the Kuśāvatī for Pulaha; / likewise the Jāmbavatī went for Kratu for the sake of purification.

15.14.s:
tāsu snātvā mahābhāgā brahmaputrā yaśasvinaḥ ..
nāma tasya tadā cakruḥ paṃcanadyaśca tāpasāḥ ..49..
15.14.d:
तासु स्नात्वा महाभागा ब्रह्मपुत्रा यशस्विनः ..
नाम तस्य तदा चक्रुः पंचनद्यश्च तापसाः ..49..
15.14.m: Having bathed in them, the illustrious, glorious sons of Brahmā, / those ascetics, then gave it the name 'Five Rivers.'

15.14.s:
tasmātpaṃcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
snātavyaṃ tatra manujaiḥ svargamokṣārthibhistadā .. 7.4.14.50 ..
15.14.d:
तस्मात्पंचनदं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
स्नातव्यं तत्र मनुजैः स्वर्गमोक्षार्थिभिस्तदा .. 7.4.14.50 ..
15.14.m: Therefore the Pañcanada tīrtha destroys all sin; / men seeking heaven and liberation must then bathe there.

15.14.s:
tatra gatvā suniyato gṛhītvārghyaṃ phalena hi ..
maṃtreṇānena vai viprā dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 51 ..
15.14.d:
तत्र गत्वा सुनियतो गृहीत्वार्घ्यं फलेन हि ..
मंत्रेणानेन वै विप्रा दद्यादर्घ्यं विधानतः .. 51 ..
15.14.m: Having gone there, well-restrained, taking an arghya offering with fruit, / one should offer the arghya according to rule, O brahmins, with this mantra:

15.14.s:
brahmaputraiḥ samānītāḥ paṃcaitāḥ saritāṃ varāḥ ..
gṛhṇaṃtvarghyamimaṃ devyaḥ sarvapāpapraśāṃtaye ..52..
15.14.d:
ब्रह्मपुत्रैः समानीताः पंचैताः सरितां वराः ..
गृह्णंत्वर्घ्यमिमं देव्यः सर्वपापप्रशांतये ..52..
15.14.m: 'Brought by the sons of Brahmā, may these five best of rivers, / these goddesses, accept this arghya for the pacification of all sins.'

15.14.s:
.. ityarghyamantraḥ .. ..
snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitṝnsaṃtarppayennaraḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ kuryyādvidhānena śradbhayā parayā yutaḥ ..53..
15.14.d:
.. इत्यर्घ्यमन्त्रः .. ..
स्नानं कृत्वा विधानेन पितॄन्संतर्प्पयेन्नरः ..
श्राद्धं कुर्य्याद्विधानेन श्रद्भया परया युतः ..53..
15.14.m: Thus is the arghya mantra. / Having bathed according to rule, a man should gratify the ancestors; / he should perform the śrāddha according to rule, endowed with supreme faith.

15.14.s:
paṃcaratnaṃ tato deyaṃ saptadhānyaṃ dvijātaye ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ .. 54 ..
15.14.d:
पंचरत्नं ततो देयं सप्तधान्यं द्विजातये ..
दीनांधकृपणानां च दानं दद्यात्स्वशक्तितः .. 54 ..
15.14.m: Then five gems and seven grains should be given to a twice-born, / and he should give gifts according to his capacity to the poor, the blind, and the miserable.

15.14.s:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ..
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ paraṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt .. 55 ..
15.14.d:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ..
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तः परं सुखमवाप्नुयात् .. 55 ..
15.14.m: He attains all desires and goes to the world of Viṣṇu; / accompanied by sons and grandsons, he shall attain supreme happiness.

15.14.s:
pretayoniṃ gatā ye ca ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ ..
sarve te muktimāyāṃti pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ .. 56 ..
15.14.d:
प्रेतयोनिं गता ये च ये च कीटत्वमागताः ..
सर्वे ते मुक्तिमायांति पितरस्त्रिकुलोद्भवाः .. 56 ..
15.14.m: Those who have gone to the state of ghosts, and those who have become worms— / all the ancestors born in his three lineages attain liberation.

15.14.s:
śrutvā'dhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ śivaloke ca modate ..
sarvapāpa vinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padam .. 57 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye pañcanadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 14 .. .. cha ..
15.14.d:
श्रुत्वाऽध्यायमिमं पुण्यं शिवलोके च मोदते ..
सर्वपाप विनिर्मुक्तः स याति परमं पदम् .. 57 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये पञ्चनदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः .. 14 .. .. छ ..
15.14.m:
Hearing this holy chapter, he rejoices in the world of Śiva; / freed from all sin, he goes to the supreme state.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of the Pañcanada Tīrtha, in the Dvārakā-māhātmya of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses.

15.15.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca . ..
śrutvā tamāgataṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pitaraṃ svakam ..
sanakādyā namaskarttuṃ jagmuḥ sarve pitāmaham ..1..
15.15.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच . ..
श्रुत्वा तमागतं देवं ब्रह्माणं पितरं स्वकम् ..
सनकाद्या नमस्कर्त्तुं जग्मुः सर्वे पितामहम् ..1..
15.15.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing that the god Brahmā, their father, had arrived, / Sanaka and the others all went to pay homage to the grandfather.

15.15.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā lokakarttāraṃ daṇḍavatpraṇatāḥ kṣitau ..
tato dṛṣṭvā sa tanayānsaṃgṛhya pariṣasvaje ..2..
15.15.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा लोककर्त्तारं दण्डवत्प्रणताः क्षितौ ..
ततो दृष्ट्वा स तनयान्संगृह्य परिषस्वजे ..2..
15.15.m: Seeing that creator of the worlds, they bowed down on the ground like a staff; / then seeing his sons, he embraced them and held them close.

15.15.s:
pṛṣṭaścānāmayaṃ taistu pṛṣṭvā tānsamuvāca ha ..
ārādhito yairbhagavāndhanyā yūyaṃ vayaṃ tathā .. 3 ..
15.15.d:
पृष्टश्चानामयं तैस्तु पृष्ट्वा तान्समुवाच ह ..
आराधितो यैर्भगवान्धन्या यूयं वयं तथा .. 3 ..
15.15.m: And when asked about their welfare by them, he asked them in turn and said: / 'You are blessed, by whom the Lord was worshipped, and so are we.

15.15.s:
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ yātā bhagavaddarśanena hi ..
na jñātaṃ putrakāḥ samyagajñānādbālabuddhibhiḥ .. 4 ..
15.15.d:
संसिद्धिं परमां याता भगवद्दर्शनेन हि ..
न ज्ञातं पुत्रकाः सम्यगज्ञानाद्बालबुद्धिभिः .. 4 ..
15.15.m: For you have attained supreme perfection by the darśana of the Lord; / yet it was not fully understood, O children, through ignorance by your childish intellects:

15.15.s:
yenārcito mahādevastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..
anarcite nīlakaṇṭhe na gṛhṇātyarcanaṃ hariḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjyatāṃ nīlalohitaḥ.. 5..
15.15.d:
येनार्चितो महादेवस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः ..
अनर्चिते नीलकण्ठे न गृह्णात्यर्चनं हरिः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूज्यतां नीललोहितः.. 5..
15.15.m: Keśava is pleased with him by whom Mahādeva has been worshipped; / when the Blue-throated One is not worshipped, Hari does not accept the worship. / Therefore with every effort let the Blue-and-Red One be worshipped,

15.15.s:
yena saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti kṛṣṇapūjā kṛtā sadā..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā brahmaputrā yayustadā.. 6..
15.15.d:
येन संपूर्णतां याति कृष्णपूजा कृता सदा..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्या ब्रह्मपुत्रा ययुस्तदा.. 6..
15.15.m: whereby worship done constantly to Kṛṣṇa reaches completeness.' / Hearing that speech of his, the sons of Brahmā went then.

15.15.s:
devāgārāgrato gatvā yogasiddhā maharṣayaḥ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ śivabhaktipuraskṛtā.. 7..
15.15.d:
देवागाराग्रतो गत्वा योगसिद्धा महर्षयः..
लिंगं संस्थापयामासुः शिवभक्तिपुरस्कृता.. 7..
15.15.m: Going in front of the temple, the great seers perfected in yoga, / prioritizing devotion to Śiva, installed a liṅga.

15.15.s:
saṃsthāpya śivaliṃgaṃ te snānārthaṃ munisattamāḥ..
kūpaṃ cakrustataḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ .. 8 ..
15.15.d:
संस्थाप्य शिवलिंगं ते स्नानार्थं मुनिसत्तमाः..
कूपं चक्रुस्ततः सर्व ऋषयः संशितव्रताः .. 8 ..
15.15.m: Having installed the Śivaliṅga, those best of sages, / all those seers of strict vows, then made a well for the purpose of bathing.

15.15.s:
dṛṣṭvā tamamṛtaprakhyaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ sunirmalam ..
saṃhṛṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve sādhusādhviti cābruvan .. 9 ..
15.15.d:
दृष्ट्वा तममृतप्रख्यं जलपूर्णं सुनिर्मलम् ..
संहृष्टा ऋषयः सर्वे साधुसाध्विति चाब्रुवन् .. 9 ..
15.15.m: Seeing it nectar-like, full of pure water, / all the seers rejoiced and cried out: 'Well done! Well done!'

15.15.s:
sthāpitaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā prītaḥ putrāṃstadā dvijāḥ .. 7.4.15.10 ..
15.15.d:
स्थापितं शिवलिंगं च दृष्ट्वा लोकपितामहः ..
उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा प्रीतः पुत्रांस्तदा द्विजाः .. 7.4.15.10 ..
15.15.m: Seeing the installed Śivaliṅga, the grandfather of the worlds, / Brahmā, then addressed these words to his sons, O twice-born:

15.15.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
bhavadbhiryogasaṃsiddhairyasmātsaṃsthāpitaḥ śivaḥ ..
tasmātsiddheśvara iti khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati .. 11 ..
15.15.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
भवद्भिर्योगसंसिद्धैर्यस्मात्संस्थापितः शिवः ..
तस्मात्सिद्धेश्वर इति ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति .. 11 ..
