15.15.m: Brahmā said: / 'Because Śiva has been installed by you who are perfected in yoga, / he shall therefore attain renown in the world as Siddheśvara.

15.15.s:
samīpe śitikaṇṭhasya kūpoyamṛṣibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ..
ṛṣitīrthamiti khyātaṃ tasmālloke bhaviṣyati. .. 12 ..
15.15.d:
समीपे शितिकण्ठस्य कूपोयमृषिभिः कृतः ..
ऋषितीर्थमिति ख्यातं तस्माल्लोके भविष्यति. .. 12 ..
15.15.m: This well made by the seers near the White-throated One / shall therefore be renowned in the world as Ṛṣitīrtha.

15.15.s:
vinā śrāddhena viprendrā dānena pitṛtarpaṇāt ..
bhaktitaḥ snānamātreṇa pitṛbhiḥ saha mucyate .. 13 ..
15.15.d:
विना श्राद्धेन विप्रेन्द्रा दानेन पितृतर्पणात् ..
भक्तितः स्नानमात्रेण पितृभिः सह मुच्यते .. 13 ..
15.15.m: Even without a śrāddha, O best of brahmins, without gifts or tarpaṇa for ancestors, / merely by bathing with devotion, one is liberated along with the ancestors.

15.15.s:
asatyavādino ye ca paranindā parāyaṇāḥ ..
snānamātreṇa śudhyanti ṛṣitīrthe na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
15.15.d:
असत्यवादिनो ये च परनिन्दा परायणाः ..
स्नानमात्रेण शुध्यन्ति ऋषितीर्थे न संशयः .. 14 ..
15.15.m: Those who speak falsehood, and those devoted to reviling others, / are purified merely by bathing in Ṛṣitīrtha, without a doubt.

15.15.s:
snānaṃ praśastaṃ viṣuve manvādiṣu tathaiva ca ..
tathā kṛtayugādyāyāṃ māghasya dvijasattamāḥ .. 15 ..
15.15.d:
स्नानं प्रशस्तं विषुवे मन्वादिषु तथैव च ..
तथा कृतयुगाद्यायां माघस्य द्विजसत्तमाः .. 15 ..
15.15.m: Bathing is praiseworthy at the equinox, likewise on the beginnings of the manvantaras, / and also on the first day of the Kṛta age in [the month of] Māgha, O best of twice-born.

15.15.s:
śivarātrau vasedyastu liṃge siddheśasaṃjñite ..
snātvā ṛṣikṛte tīrthe kiṃ tasyānyena vai dvijāḥ ..
gatvā tatra mahābhāgā gṛhītvā phalamuttamam .. 16 ..
15.15.d:
शिवरात्रौ वसेद्यस्तु लिंगे सिद्धेशसंज्ञिते ..
स्नात्वा ऋषिकृते तीर्थे किं तस्यान्येन वै द्विजाः ..
गत्वा तत्र महाभागा गृहीत्वा फलमुत्तमम् .. 16 ..
15.15.m: He who stays on Śivarātri at the liṅga named Siddheśa, / having bathed in the tīrtha made by the seers—what need has he for another, O twice-born? / Having gone there, O blessed ones, and taken the supreme fruit,

15.15.s:
arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān ..
gṛhṇaṃtvarghyamimaṃ devā yogasiddhā maharṣayaḥ .. 17 ..
15.15.d:
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा विधानेन कृत्वा च करयोः कुशान् ..
गृह्णंत्वर्घ्यमिमं देवा योगसिद्धा महर्षयः .. 17 ..
15.15.m: offering arghya according to rule, placing kuśa grass in both hands: / 'May the gods and great seers perfected in yoga accept this arghya

15.15.s:
ṛṣitīrthe ca pāpaghne siddheśvarasamanvite ..
dattvārghyaṃ mṛdamālabhya snānaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ..18..
15.15.d:
ऋषितीर्थे च पापघ्ने सिद्धेश्वरसमन्विते ..
दत्त्वार्घ्यं मृदमालभ्य स्नानं कुर्यात्समाहितः ..18..
15.15.m: in the Ṛṣitīrtha that destroys sin, joined with Siddheśvara.' / Having offered the arghya and applied earth, one should bathe with a concentrated mind.

15.15.s:
tarpayecca pitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathākramam ..
tataḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayā'nvitaḥ .. 19 ..
15.15.d:
तर्पयेच्च पितॄन्देवान्मनुष्यांश्च यथाक्रमम् ..
ततः श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत पितॄणां श्रद्धयाऽन्वितः .. 19 ..
15.15.m: And one should offer water libations to the ancestors, gods, and men in due order; / then, endowed with faith, one should perform a śrāddha for the ancestors.

15.15.s:
tathā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
viśeṣataḥ pradeyāni phalāni rasavaṃti ca .. 7.4.15.20 ..
15.15.d:
तथा च दक्षिणां दद्याद्वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ..
विशेषतः प्रदेयानि फलानि रसवंति च .. 7.4.15.20 ..
15.15.m: And likewise, free from dishonesty regarding wealth, one should give a sacrificial fee; / especially, juicy fruits are to be given.

15.15.s:
dadyācchayāmākanīvārānvidrumaṃ cājināni ca ..
saptadhānyāni śālīṃśca saktūṃśca guḍasaṃyutān .. 21 ..
15.15.d:
दद्याच्छयामाकनीवारान्विद्रुमं चाजिनानि च ..
सप्तधान्यानि शालींश्च सक्तूंश्च गुडसंयुतान् .. 21 ..
15.15.m: One should give śyāmāka grain, wild rice, coral, and animal skins, / the seven grains, winter rice, and roasted barley meal mixed with jaggery,

15.15.s:
gaṃdhamālyāni tāṃbūlaṃ vastrāṇi ca tathā payaḥ ..
evaṃ kṛtvā samagraṃ ca kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ .. 22 ..
15.15.d:
गंधमाल्यानि तांबूलं वस्त्राणि च तथा पयः ..
एवं कृत्वा समग्रं च कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः .. 22 ..
15.15.m: fragrances, garlands, betel, garments, and likewise milk. / Having done all this completely, a man attains his purpose.

15.15.s:
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ siddheśvaramumāpatim ..
saphalaṃ janma martyasya jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam .. 23 ..
15.15.d:
पूजयित्वा महादेवं सिद्धेश्वरमुमापतिम् ..
सफलं जन्म मर्त्यस्य जीवितं च सुजीवितम् .. 23 ..
15.15.m: Having worshiped Mahādeva, the lord of perfections (Siddheśvara), the husband of Umā, / the mortal's birth bears fruit, and his life is a life well lived.

15.15.s:
yaḥ snātvā ṛṣitīrthe tu paśyetsiddheśvaraṃ śivam ..
pitarastasya tuṣyanti tuṣyanti ca pitāmahāḥ .. 24 ..
15.15.d:
यः स्नात्वा ऋषितीर्थे तु पश्येत्सिद्धेश्वरं शिवम् ..
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यन्ति तुष्यन्ति च पितामहाः .. 24 ..
15.15.m: Whoever, having bathed at Ṛṣitīrtha, beholds Siddheśvara Śiva, / his ancestors rejoice, and his grandfathers rejoice.

15.15.s:
aputrā putriṇaḥ syuste putriṇaścāpi pautriṇaḥ ..
nirdhanā dhanavaṃtaśca siddheśvararatā narāḥ .. 25 ..
15.15.d:
अपुत्रा पुत्रिणः स्युस्ते पुत्रिणश्चापि पौत्रिणः ..
निर्धना धनवंतश्च सिद्धेश्वररता नराः .. 25 ..
15.15.m: The childless shall have children, and those with children shall have grandchildren; / the poor shall become wealthy—men devoted to Siddheśvara.

15.15.s:
duṣkṛtaṃ yāti vilayaṃ sukṛtaṃ ca vivarddhate ..
bhavenmanorathāvāptiḥ praṇate siddhanāyake .. 26 ..
15.15.d:
दुष्कृतं याति विलयं सुकृतं च विवर्द्धते ..
भवेन्मनोरथावाप्तिः प्रणते सिद्धनायके .. 26 ..
15.15.m: Evil deeds go to destruction, and merit increases; / the attainment of one's wishes comes to pass when the lord of the Siddhas is bowed to.

15.15.s:
ṛṣitīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā siddheśvaraṃ haram ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 27 ..
15.15.d:
ऋषितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा सिद्धेश्वरं हरम् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 27 ..
15.15.m: A man, having bathed at Ṛṣitīrtha and seen Siddheśvara Hara, / obtains all desires; no doubt should be entertained in this matter.

15.15.s:
śivarātryāṃ viśeṣeṇa siddheśaḥ saṃprapūjitaḥ ..
yaṃyaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ dadāti na saṃśayaḥ ..
cintāmaṇisamaḥ svāmī hyathavā cākṣayo nidhiḥ ..28..
15.15.d:
शिवरात्र्यां विशेषेण सिद्धेशः संप्रपूजितः ..
यंयं कामयते कामं तं ददाति न संशयः ..
चिन्तामणिसमः स्वामी ह्यथवा चाक्षयो निधिः ..28..
15.15.m: Especially when Siddheśa is worshiped on Śivarātri, / whatever desire one desires, that he grants—there is no doubt; / the Lord is like a wish-fulfilling jewel, or indeed an imperishable treasure.

15.15.s:
śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāghaharaṇaṃ param ..
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ mānavaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ..29..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakā māhātmya ṛṣitīrthasiddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ..15..
15.15.d:
श्रुत्वाध्यायमिमं पुण्यं सर्वाघहरणं परम् ..
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं मानवः श्रद्धयान्वितः..29..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारका माहात्म्य ऋषितीर्थसिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः..15..
15.15.m:
Having heard this sacred chapter, which removes all sins and is supreme, / a human being, endowed with faith, goes to the highest realm.
Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Ṛṣitīrtha and Siddheśvara', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
